English: "Two rifts sealed, and the yard behind the barracks is finally clear of rubble. Send a hero there for a few days and they come back stronger: an attribute point, a new program. The Drill Yard room adds places. And the quest board has work off the map for anyone left at camp."

English: "This camp was an Accord hall once. The Barracks, the Infirmary and the Drill Yard can be rebuilt now, room by room, with Gold. Each level costs a little upkeep. More rooms open as the guild grows." (Guild > Accord Hall)
简体中文: “这座营地曾是盟约的一座大厅。兵营、医务室和操练场现在可以用金币一间一间地重建。每一级都要一点维护费。公会壮大后会开放更多房间。”（公会 > 盟约大厅）

简体中文: 每周两次，英雄可能会提出请求：休假、一个搭档、一道属于自己的裂隙。答应能赢得信任，也可以拒绝。

English: Opens when you complete Act I

English: Relics bend the rules of a fight for the whole guild. Equip them under Inventory > Relics; you have a few slots. Elites, shops and events sometimes hold one.
简体中文: 遗物会为整个公会改写战斗规则。在物品栏 > 遗物中装备；你只有几个栏位。精英、商店和事件有时会带来一件。

English: "The easy rifts are behind you. From now on a party carries Resolve: hard floors and hazards wear it down, rests and shrines bring it back, and a party that breaks hits softer. And what you carry is at risk: lose the boss, or run, and part of the haul stays down there."

简体中文: 裂隙大厅中的100个固定层。每层总是同一场战斗，首次通关时给予报酬。

English: An expedition now warns you when it would leave too few heroes at camp to cover for one who is ready for a Path course. Spanish and Chinese cover the founders, expeditions and fixes of 0.67.
简体中文: 若远征会让营地里剩下的英雄不足以替补一名可参加道途课程的英雄，现在会提醒你。西班牙语和中文已涵盖0.67的创始英雄、远征和修复。

English: Expedition pay was checked in a full simulation and set by the heroes you send: a job asks for what your spare heroes can do and pays what a rift at their own rank would, so a bench that can't keep up with your best four still has work, and a strong one is no longer paid more on the road than in the rifts.
简体中文: 远征报酬已在完整模拟中核对，并按你派出的英雄来定：任务要求的是你的替补英雄能做到的，报酬相当于他们自身等级的裂隙所得。这样，跟不上最强四人的替补也有活可干，而强大的替补在路上的收入也不再高于裂隙。

English: Your own founders and expeditions. A new guild signs its first three heroes from a board of six, one of every class among them, with free rerolls. From two seals the Quest board posts expeditions: jobs off the map for heroes you can spare, gone for whole days while the rifts go on without them. The odds show before they leave, every class and Path brings something on the road, and a perilous job gone wrong can leave a scar. After Act I's card you choose how many tips you want, and the Training Yard now costs Essence.
简体中文: 自选创始英雄与远征。新公会从一块六人招募板（每个职业都有）上签下最初三名英雄，可免费重抽。封印两座裂隙后，任务板会发布远征：给你腾得出手的英雄在地图之外接活，一去就是整天，裂隙那边照常进行。出发前会显示成功率，每个职业和道途在路上都有所助益，凶险任务一旦失手可能留下伤疤。看过第一幕的卡片后，你可以选择想要多少提示；训练场现在需要花费精华。

English: Fixes from a full playthrough: the hero who opens a round waits for you instead of replaying last round's move, the turn order and the action bar follow every turn, Guard picks an ally, a stunned hero loses the turn openly, foes keep their size when one is summoned, and new recruits can spend their skill points. Also: Settings and a master volume on the title screen, a crest picker, the shrine's second choice, Take buttons in treasure rooms, a bigger rift map with fewer crossings, the main portal leads to the ranked rifts, front-row heroes stand nearest the foes, a Worn filter in the inventory, banked Momentum on the map, and a cleaner Guild, Records and Library.
简体中文: 完整通关后的修复：开启回合的英雄会等待你的指令，而不是重复上一回合的行动；行动顺序和行动栏每回合都会更新；守护可以选择一名队友；被击晕的英雄会明确地失去回合；召唤出新敌人时，其余敌人保持原有大小；新招募的英雄可以花费技能点。另外：标题画面加入设置和主音量、纹章选择器、圣坛的第二个选项、宝藏房间的拿取按钮、更大且交叉更少的裂隙地图、主传送门通往阶级裂隙、前排英雄站得离敌人最近、物品栏的“已穿戴”筛选、地图上显示储存的气势，以及更清爽的公会、记录和图书馆页面。

English: Gear, simpler. The Smithy is one screen for gear's four jobs: temper what your heroes wear, combine three spare items into a better one, reforge a stat line, salvage for Essence. Relics bend rules now and nothing else: every relic is one of a kind (from finales, an elite's loot, a rift shop, events and the Tower), and stats live on gear. Rolled relics, relic levels, rerolls and the starting relic choice are gone; an old save's rolled relics and every relic level became Essence. Path relics are carried by heroes: one each, of their own Path, working while they fight, passed between them on the hero's Path tab. Offers come only for Paths your heroes walk, and declining one pays the seal's full Essence. The Relic Vault adds a relic slot at Lv1, 3 and 5; the Arcane Lab cheapens treatments and respecs and raises salvage.
简体中文: 装备更简单了。铁匠铺把装备的四件事放在一个界面：为英雄身上的装备回火、把三件多余的物品合成一件更好的、重铸一条数值、分解换取精华。遗物现在只改写规则：每件遗物都独一无二（来自终章、精英的战利品、裂隙商店、事件和试炼之塔），数值则在装备上。随机遗物、遗物等级、重随和初始遗物选择都已移除；旧存档中的随机遗物和每一级遗物等级都已转换为精华。道途遗物由英雄携带：每人一件，必须是自己的道途，在其战斗时生效，可在英雄的道途页签中转交。只会为你的英雄所走的道途提供遗物，放弃时可获得封印的全部精华。遗物库在1、3、5级各增加一个遗物栏位；奥术实验室降低治疗和重置的费用，并提高分解收益。

English: One new thing at a time. A new guild starts with heroes, rifts, fights and payday; the rest comes in turn, brought in by Wen, Dobbs or Hesper: the Training Yard and the hall's first rooms after two seals, the Smithy and relics with Act I's finale, the rival, Resolve and the haul a day into Act II, reforging and the Daily twist in Act III, the Tower in Act IV. A player whose past guild got past Act I has all of Act II's from day 1. The Accord Hall is one tree now: its 13 rooms are built with Gold, and at the end of Acts I, III and V you choose one of two wings (3 of 6 per guild), each with a new effect. Heroes on a Path can train Path Mastery for Essence: each rank makes their Path rule 4% stronger.
简体中文: 一次只来一样新东西。新公会从英雄、裂隙、战斗和发薪日开始；其余的依次到来，由Wen、Dobbs或Hesper带来：两次封印后是训练场和大厅的第一批房间，第一幕终章带来铁匠铺和遗物，第二幕开始一天后是对手、决心与战利品，第三幕是重铸和每日变奏，第四幕是试炼之塔。曾有公会通过第一幕的玩家，从第一天起就拥有第二幕及之前的一切。盟约大厅现在是一棵树：13个房间用金币建造，在第一、三、五幕结束时，你从两翼中选择一个（每个公会6选3），每一翼都有新效果。走上道途的英雄可以用精华训练道途精通：每一级让其道途规则强化4%。

English: Fixes from the review: a reload in the middle of a fight puts the party back as it stood before it, so the fight starts over fairly (and running from it afterwards costs the haul, as fleeing does). The hazard card now shows exactly what lands, Pathfinder and Scavenger included. A key left waiting in Settings no longer catches a later press; moved keys stay in fights and the hints name them. Resolve isn't sold while it doesn't count. The daily score counts Resolve only where it drains and scales with the difficulty. Phones: the map's legend wraps, Resolve shows in a fight, and the attack shows its damage on the foe. Story cards waiting to be read survive a reload. The sound effects are loudness-matched. Settings > Send feedback can share play milestones with the developer, if you tick it.
简体中文: 来自评审的修复：战斗中途重新载入会让小队回到战前的状态，战斗公平地重新开始（之后再逃跑，会像逃跑一样损失战利品）。险境卡片现在准确显示会造成什么，包括探路者和拾荒者。在设置里等待的按键不再捕获之后的按键；改过的按键只作用于战斗，提示也会显示它们。决心不计入时不再出售。每日分数只在决心会消耗时计入它，并随难度缩放。手机：地图图例会换行，战斗中显示决心，攻击会在敌人身上显示伤害。等待阅读的剧情卡片在重新载入后不会丢失。音效按响度统一。设置 > 发送反馈：勾选后可与开发者分享游戏里程碑。

English: Five Path relics now carry a drawback, as designed: Bulwark Chain, Red Tooth Torc, Brimming Chalice, Burning Psalter and Feather-Step Wraps. Each stop on the rift map says what it costs or gives back in Resolve. Hardship levels were checked in a full simulation: the Recommended power stays honest at every level.
简体中文: 五件道途遗物现在按原设计附带代价：壁垒之链、赤牙项圈、满溢圣杯、燃烧诗篇和羽步裹布。裂隙地图上的每个地点都会显示消耗或恢复多少决心。磨难各等级已通过完整模拟检验：推荐战力在每个等级下都依然可靠。

English: Deeper rifts and a busier guild. Resolve: a party sets out with 8 and loses some with every floor, elite, risky hazard and fled fight; campfires, shrines and some events give it back. At 3 or less foes strike first; at 0 the heroes also lose their Momentum. Sealing a Rank D or higher rift offers one of 30 Path relics, each bending a Path's rule (or Essence instead). The camp has 15 new events and heroes 20 new requests, twice a week, that leave quirks, bonds and titles; heroes earn titles for their deeds and can be renamed on their page. A new guild picks its difficulty: Story, Standard, or a Hardship once a guild has reached Act IV. Hovering a fight command shows the damage it would deal, and Settings > Controls moves the fight keys. About 40 new sounds. The game speaks Spanish, and Simplified Chinese on desktop (both beta). A sealed daily twist has a score you can post to the day's board.
简体中文: 更深的裂隙，更热闹的公会。决心：小队出发时有 8 点，每经过一层、每场精英战、每个冒险险境、每次逃离战斗都会失去一些；营火、圣坛和部分事件能补回。决心为 3 或更低时，敌人先手；为 0 时，英雄还会失去气势。封印 D 阶或更高的裂隙时，可从 30 件道途遗物中选择一件，每件都会改变一条道途的规则（也可改拿精华）。营地新增 15 个事件，英雄新增 20 个请求，每周两次，会留下特质、羁绊和称号；英雄会因事迹获得称号，并可在其页面改名。新公会可选择难度：剧情、标准，或在某个公会到达第四幕后开放的磨难。将鼠标悬停在战斗指令上可看到预计伤害，设置 > 操作可更改战斗按键。新增约 40 种音效。游戏现支持西班牙语，以及桌面版的简体中文（均为测试版）。封印的每日挑战会有得分，可发布到当日榜单。

English: A simpler, deeper guild. Rifts are maps now: lanes that cross (3 at the low ranks, up to 5 at the top), so you plan a route, with a campfire before every boss and new stops along the way (an anvil that tempers a piece for free, a Path's shrine, a trainer's echo); from Rank S the far floors stay unseen unless a Trapper or a Stalker scouts. The camp lives: on about a third of days a merchant, a visiting hero, a wandering recruit or a dilemma turns up, and threats like fire, fever, bandits and storms are foretold the evening before, so you can pay, send a hero, or take the loss. Breaches are held in a breach rift (fights back to back, no camp between them) instead of the tower defense, and the Defenses research is now Wardcraft, which softens them. The real-time Endless Rift is resting for now: its gate leads down the Descent. A saved Descent also remembers its depth now.
简体中文: 更简洁、更有深度的公会。裂隙现在是地图：交错的路线（低阶3条，最高5条），你需要规划路线，每个首领前都有营火，沿途还有新的停靠点（免费淬炼一件装备的铁砧、道途圣坛、训练师的回响）；从阶级S起，远处的层不可见，除非有陷阱师或潜猎者侦察。营地也活了起来：大约三分之一的日子里会出现商人、来访英雄、流浪新兵或两难抉择，而火灾、热病、盗匪和风暴等威胁会在前一晚预告，你可以付钱、派英雄处理或承受损失。裂口改在裂口裂隙中守住（连续战斗，中间没有营地），取代了塔防，防御研究现改为守御术，可削弱裂口。即时的无尽裂隙暂时休眠：它的大门通往深渊下行。存档的深渊下行现在也会记住深度。

English: Attack and skill animations no longer snap back to the stance after the blow: heroes and foes now play the motion back out, so every swing, shot and cast finishes.
简体中文: 攻击和技能动画不再在出手后直接弹回站姿：英雄和敌人会完整播放收招动作，每次挥砍、射击和施法都有始有终。

English: Attacks hit harder on screen: warriors and rogues wind up before they dash in and the blow lands with a jolt; rangers draw and the arrow leaves the bow on the release; mages and clerics gather light in the hand before the bolt flies. New attack animations: the base Ranger, Mage and Cleric, seven rangers who now raise and draw their bows, the Ashen Templar and the Hearth-Warden.
简体中文: 攻击在画面上更有打击感：战士和盗贼先蓄势再冲刺，命中时一震；游侠拉弓，箭在松弦时离弦；法师和牧师先在手中聚光再放出法弹。新攻击动画：基础游侠、法师和牧师，七名现在会举弓拉弦的游侠，灰烬圣殿骑士和炉火守卫。

English: Raising Abilities (Faster Than the Wounds, One More Round) raise a fallen ally once a fight now, at 35% and 30% HP; after that they heal. Mercy's Overflow no longer counts the party's mend, and its tree's mend nodes are lower. The Marksman's Signature is now called Held Breath, so it isn't confused with the ranger's Overwatch row bonus.
简体中文: 复活类技能（快过伤口、再来一轮）现在每场战斗复活一名倒下的盟友一次，分别以35%和30%生命复活；之后改为治疗。慈悲的溢流不再计入小队回复，其技能树的回复节点数值降低。神射手的绝技更名为屏息，以免与游侠的警戒排加成混淆。

English: A hero's page has a Path tab now: their Path's three stages side by side, the Twist, and the rank and XP bar with Evolve and training. The Skills tab is shorter, so the skill tree starts higher up. Base-class heroes animate in fights. Tuning: Called Shot hits harder, snares bite harder, Benediction heals 10% (was 15%) and Overflow turns half the overhealing into a ward.
简体中文: 英雄页面新增道途页：道途的三个阶段并列展示，还有变奏、阶级与经验条，以及进化和训练。技能页更短，技能树位置更靠上。基础职业英雄在战斗中有动画。调整：瞄准射击伤害更高，陷阱更狠，祝祷治疗10%（原为15%），溢流将一半的过量治疗转为守护。

English: Paths: heroes are hired as base classes and grow into one of 15 Paths (3 per role). Every rank is levels 1-10 now, and evolving at 10 starts the next rank at level 1 with +20% XP for two runs; raised heroes end up a little stronger than hired ones, hired ones bring more skill points. At Ranks D, B and S a hero trains at the Training Yard: stage 1 brings the Path's rule (a Bloodrager hits harder the more hurt they are, a Marksman lines up a steady shot), stage 2 a Technique in place of the role's second skill, stage 3 a once-a-fight Signature moment or the role's Legend. Every subclass bends its Path with its own Twist. New subclasses unlock with acts, Tower floors and deeds (Codex › Paths), and a new guild can carry them over with Laurels. Heroes sharing an element now Resonate in a party. Your heroes keep their subclasses; their skill points were refunded to spend again.
简体中文: 道途：英雄以基础职业受雇，并成长为15条道途之一（每个职业3条）。现在每个阶级都是1-10级，10级进化后从下一阶级1级开始，并在两次远征中获得+20%经验；培养起来的英雄最终会比雇来的略强，雇来的则带有更多技能点。在阶级D、B和S，英雄在训练场受训：第一阶段获得道途规则（血怒者越受伤打得越狠，神射手会瞄准稳射），第二阶段以技法替代职业的第二技能，第三阶段获得每场一次的绝技时刻或职业的传奇。每个子职业都以自己的变奏改变其道途。新子职业随幕章、试炼之塔层数和事迹解锁（典籍 › 道途），新公会可以用桂冠继承它们。共享元素的英雄现在会在小队中产生共鸣。你的英雄保留其子职业；技能点已退还，可重新分配。

English: Before each fight the room now shows your party's health and the foes waiting there (the same ones you'll fight), so Engage or Retreat is an informed choice.
简体中文: 每场战斗前，房间现在会显示小队的生命和等在那里的敌人（就是你将要面对的那些），让交战或撤退成为知情的选择。

English: When Essence piles up, the Grow line now also names a relic level on the Relic Altar or a Guild Management level that strengthens the party (Arcane Lab, Relic Vault, Wardstones).
简体中文: 精华堆积时，“成长”一行现在还会指出遗物祭坛上的遗物等级，或能强化小队的公会管理等级（奥术实验室、遗物库、守护石）。

English: The Guild status board's Grow line now speaks up whenever Gold or Essence is piling up, not only when the guild is stuck: it names a Forge temper, a hall wing, an evolution or a stronger recruit you can afford.
简体中文: 公会状态板的“成长”一行现在只要金币或精华堆积就会提示，而不仅是公会卡关时：它会指出你负担得起的锻炉淬炼、大厅翼楼、进化或更强的新兵。

English: Recommended power now tells the truth: at Recommended a party seals a rift about 2 times in 3. Rank E and up, and especially the act finales, used to read Even when the odds were 1 in 5 to 1 in 2, so the numbers are higher now (fights themselves are unchanged).
简体中文: 建议战力现在说实话了：在建议战力下，小队大约有三分之二的几率封印裂隙。阶级E及以上，尤其是各幕终章，过去在成功率只有五分之一到二分之一时也显示“势均力敌”，所以现在数值更高（战斗本身未变）。

English: Gold buys power now. The Forge tempers any item for Gold (up to 5 times, +6% to its stats each), from the item's pop-up or the gear slot a hero wears it in. Hall Works rebuild your guild hall wing by wing once Act I is done: War Room, Chapel, Smithy, Library, Healers' Wing and Reliquary, each a lasting bonus for the whole guild (Guild Hall > Hall Works). Your first party starts with your three heroes already in it.
简体中文: 金币现在能买到实力。锻炉可用金币淬炼任何物品（最多5次，每次属性+6%），可从物品弹窗或英雄的装备栏进行。第一幕完成后，大厅工程会逐翼重建你的公会大厅：作战室、礼拜堂、铁匠铺、图书馆、医者翼楼和圣物库，每一项都为整个公会带来永久加成（公会大厅 > 大厅工程）。你的第一支小队开局就包含你的三位英雄。

English: The credits now have a Founding Testers section: play this test build and send your feedback to have your name there. A long guild name no longer pushes the top bar off the screen.
简体中文: 制作人员名单新增“创始测试员”一栏：玩这个测试版本并发送反馈，你的名字就会出现在那里。过长的公会名不再把顶栏挤出屏幕。

English: The opening's eight pictures are redrawn in the crisp new style, from the Accord's hall to the villagers waiting for a guild.
简体中文: 开场的八幅画面以清晰的新风格重绘，从盟约大厅到等待公会的村民。

English: The title screen, the Rift Hall, the Roster, Items, Management, Medical Bay and Crafting backdrops, the rift shop and every hazard are redrawn in the crisp new style. Spoken lines now dip the music while they play, and the opening's narration is never interrupted by the camp's music or a story card.
简体中文: 标题画面、裂隙大厅、名册、物品、管理、医疗所和制作的背景、裂隙商店和所有险境都以清晰的新风格重绘。语音播放时音乐会降低，开场旁白不再被营地音乐或剧情卡打断。

English: A hero can now be dismissed from their own page in the Roster, as well as from the payroll on the Ledger.
简体中文: 现在可以在名册中英雄自己的页面解雇英雄，也可以在账簿的工资单上解雇。

English: Music: every region now has its own theme. The Shattered Vale, the Drowned Marches, the Ashen Wastes, the Glass Coast and the Inverted City each play theirs for the whole rift run, and the Endless Rift and the Descent play the Accord Hall's.
简体中文: 音乐：每个地区现在都有自己的主题曲。破碎山谷、淹没沼泽、灰烬荒原、玻璃海岸和倒悬之城在整个裂隙远征中播放各自的音乐，无尽裂隙和深渊下行则播放盟约大厅的音乐。

English: End day: a campfire button in the top bar ends the day from any camp screen, without a run. Hover it to see what tomorrow brings: payday and whether you can pay, who finishes training, who is back on their feet, and a rift about to break.
简体中文: 结束一天：顶栏的营火按钮可在任何营地界面结束当天，无需远征。悬停可查看明天的情况：发薪日以及你能否付清、谁完成训练、谁恢复了、哪个裂隙即将崩溃。

English: The Training Yard: send heroes to train Might, Agility or Focus for 1, 2 or 3 days. Each day gives +1 attribute point, longer courses also give XP (up to your best hero's level), and you can watch them drill in the camp's courtyard. Trainees sit out runs; the yard has 2 stations and grows to 4 with the Drill Yard. It replaces buying points with Gold.
简体中文: 训练场：派英雄训练力量、敏捷或专注，为期1、2或3天。每天+1属性点，较长的课程还会给予经验（最高到你最强英雄的等级），你还可以在营地庭院看他们操练。受训者不参加远征；训练场有2个位置，有了操练场可增至4个。它取代了用金币购买点数。

English: A new look: every fight now has a crisp, detailed backdrop drawn to match the heroes and foes, and the camp has become the ruins of an old Accord guild hall that your guild rebuilds as it grows, from scaffolding to a restored hall. Long sealing reports no longer stretch the screen.
简体中文: 全新面貌：每场战斗都有清晰细致、与英雄和敌人相配的背景，营地变成了一座古老盟约公会大厅的废墟，你的公会会随着成长将其重建，从脚手架到修复一新的大厅。冗长的封印报告不再撑开屏幕。

English: The haul: what a rift run earns is only safe once the party is home. If the party falls, half of it is lost; fleeing a fight drops a quarter; sealing the rift or leaving between floors keeps it all. The run bar shows the haul, and at a boss's door you see what's at stake and can still retreat. A guild's first three seals are spared.
简体中文: 战利品：裂隙远征的收获只有小队回家后才算安全。若小队覆灭，损失一半；逃离战斗损失四分之一；封印裂隙或在层间离开则全数保留。远征栏显示战利品，在首领门前你能看到赌注，仍可撤退。公会的前三次封印不受此影响。

English: Pixel-perfect fights: heroes and foes are now drawn at a whole number of screen pixels per art pixel at any window size, so no pixel comes out wider than its neighbours. Heroes use their full art canvas like the foes, so they no longer change size when they attack, and Morrow and the First Signatory fight in their own portraits.
简体中文: 像素级精准的战斗：在任何窗口尺寸下，英雄和敌人都以每个美术像素对应整数个屏幕像素来绘制，不会有像素比邻居更宽。英雄和敌人一样使用完整的画布，攻击时不再改变大小，Morrow和首位签署人以自己的立绘作战。

English: Playtest build. The Feedback report now notes when you reached each milestone (founding, first seal, first payday, each act), still only on your screen until you paste it. The Grow goal only suggests hiring or drilling once a guild is really stuck, the founding options' toggle draws properly, and narrow desktop windows no longer ask you to turn your phone.
简体中文: 测试版本。反馈报告现在会记录你达成各个里程碑的时间（创建公会、首次封印、首个发薪日、每一幕），在你粘贴之前仍只显示在你的屏幕上。“成长”目标只在公会真正卡关时才建议招募或操练，创建选项的开关显示正常，窄的桌面窗口不再要求你横置手机。

English: The guild status board now opens on three goals: the story's next step, the best way to grow stronger, and one thing worth doing on the side. New item icons for every weapon, armour and legendary, the Pearl Colossus and the Ember Whelp redrawn, and a smaller download: the game loads about a fifth faster.
简体中文: 公会状态板现在列出三个目标：剧情的下一步、变强的最佳途径，以及一件值得顺手去做的事。每种武器、护甲和传奇物品都有新图标，珍珠巨像和余烬幼龙已重绘，下载更小：游戏加载快了约五分之一。

English: Fights hit harder: every blow flashes and lands with a short pause, attacks wind up before they strike, and each way of fighting has its own effect: a cleave for warriors, a twin cut for rogues, an arrow strike, a holy strike, a burst for each mage element, and claws, spells or acid from foes. Cards have pixel corners, and icons stay crisp.
简体中文: 战斗更有打击感：每一击都有闪光和短暂停顿，攻击出手前有蓄势，每种战斗方式都有专属效果：战士的劈砍、盗贼的双刃、箭击、圣击、每种法师元素的爆发，以及敌人的爪击、法术或酸液。卡牌有像素圆角，图标保持清晰。

English: Foes face the right way: in Riftbreak they no longer walk backwards down the road, and Korrath, Captain Morrow, the Spire Oracle, the Rooftop Harrier and the Tideglass Moth turn toward your heroes. Founding a guild is calmer: name and crest up front, everything else under Founding options. Loot is mostly gear now (8 in 10 drops in Act I, 7 in 10 after), so fewer spare relics pile up.
简体中文: 敌人朝向正确：在裂隙崩溃中它们不再倒着走，Korrath、Morrow队长、尖塔神谕、屋顶掠袭者和潮玻蛾会转向你的英雄。创建公会更从容：名称和纹章在前，其余放在创建选项中。战利品现在主要是装备（第一幕10件中8件，之后7件），多余的遗物堆积更少。

English: Skip the opening and the narrator still reads the Night of Breaking to you, Hesper's version too for a guild founded on the old oath.
简体中文: 跳过开场后，旁白仍会为你讲述破碎之夜；以旧誓言创建的公会还会听到Hesper的版本。

English: The Vale has voices: the narrator reads the story cards, Wen, Dobbs and Hesper talk at the pay table, and the rival leaders read out their letters, Brannoch his memory. Settings has a Voice volume and an on/off switch, and Listen plays a scene again. English only for now.
简体中文: 山谷有了声音：旁白朗读剧情卡，Wen、Dobbs和Hesper在发薪桌旁交谈，敌对首领朗读他们的信，Brannoch讲述他的回忆。设置中有语音音量和开关，“聆听”可重播场景。目前仅限英语。

English: Four foes redrawn to match the rest of the Vale: the Mire Sniper, the Voidling Sprite, the Choir Sprite and the Falling Sky itself, each with new attacks and walks. The Glass Coast and Inverted City grounds are calmer, so heroes stand out on them.
简体中文: 四个敌人已重绘以契合山谷的其他部分：泥沼狙击手、虚空精灵、圣咏精灵和陨落之天本身，各有新的攻击和行走动画。玻璃海岸和倒悬之城的地面更素净，英雄站在上面更醒目。

English: Every hero now has new art: the clerics in white and gold and the rogues in dark violet join the warriors, rangers and mages, each with a new portrait, new attack, hit and skill animations and a new Endless Rift walk. Champions swing, flinch and cast as themselves instead of turning into a plain warrior mid-fight. Every skill has its own icon, the Tower's and the Endless Rift's legendary relics have theirs, the Glass Coast and the Inverted City have their own ground, the Open Hollow has a picture, and two heroes of the same kind keep their role's colour.
简体中文: 每位英雄都有新美术：白金衣装的牧师和深紫衣装的盗贼加入了战士、游侠和法师的行列，每人都有新立绘、新的攻击、受击和技能动画，以及新的无尽裂隙行走动画。勇者在战斗中以自己的形象挥砍、受击和施法，不再变成普通战士。每个技能都有专属图标，试炼之塔和无尽裂隙的传奇遗物也有了图标，玻璃海岸和倒悬之城有了自己的地面，开启的空洞有了插图，两名同类英雄会保留各自职业的颜色。

English: New portraits for every warrior, ranger and mage, in their role colours: red tabards on the warriors, green cloaks on the rangers, blue robes on the mages. Each has new attack, hit and skill animations and a new walk in the Endless Rift. Clerics and rogues are next.
简体中文: 每位战士、游侠和法师都有新立绘，采用职业配色：战士红色罩袍，游侠绿色斗篷，法师蓝色长袍。每人都有新的攻击、受击和技能动画，以及无尽裂隙中的新行走动画。牧师和盗贼紧随其后。

English: The story has pictures: every act, the big choices and every ending now open on an illustration, from the rift splitting the Vale to the last door between the worlds.
简体中文: 剧情有了插图：每一幕、重大抉择和每个结局现在都以一幅插画开场，从撕裂山谷的裂隙到两个世界之间的最后一道门。

English: The Terms, Act IV's finale, has its own shape at last: the Grandmaster's, written in green ink. The rival guilds' leaders have their own portraits, Morrow included, and Wen, Dobbs and Hesper have faces at the pay table.
简体中文: 第四幕终章“条款”终于有了自己的形象：大团长的形象，以绿墨书写。敌对公会的首领有了各自的立绘，包括Morrow，Wen、Dobbs和Hesper在发薪桌旁也有了面孔。

English: New art for the Sky Beneath: all 30 foes of the Glass Coast and the Inverted City, with their own attacks and walks, and six new battle backgrounds. Hesper and Vaelith have their own portraits as champions, with a walk and a signature move in the Endless Rift; Morrow and the First Signatory have theirs when they join your guild; and the seven Accord halls have pictures on the Keepers of the Vale tab.
简体中文: 《下方之天》新美术：玻璃海岸和倒悬之城的全部30个敌人，各有攻击和行走动画，另有六张新战斗背景。Hesper和Vaelith作为勇者有了立绘，以及无尽裂隙中的行走和招牌动作；Morrow和首位签署人加入公会时也有；七座盟约大厅在“山谷守护者”页面有了插图。

English: When a guild is stuck on an act's objectives because its heroes are too weak, the Act panel now says what would help after a week, not only once the finale is open. And Act III's wardens stop hiding: while Korrath or Drevok is still to be beaten, a rift in his region always ends with him.
简体中文: 当公会因英雄太弱而卡在某一幕的目标上时，幕章面板现在会在一周后就提示什么有帮助，而不是等终章开启后。第三幕的守卫也不再躲藏：在Korrath或Drevok尚未被击败时，其所在地区的裂隙总会以他收尾。

English: A new choice at the Drowned Spire: carry out the Accord's archive or save Hollin, the village down the hill. Every guild meets it, and both sides come back later. Choices you already make come back too: the crossings you let through and Brannoch's door change Book II's ending, keeping quiet or holding the Royal Charter changes Book II, and Vaelith, Ezra's lantern, Mother Ilse and Morrow each turn up again. Holding the Charter, the Crown pays double for turning crossings back.
简体中文: 淹没尖塔的新抉择：运出盟约的档案，或拯救山下的村庄Hollin。每个公会都会遇到，两边都会在之后回响。你已做出的抉择也会回响：你放行的越界者和Brannoch的门会改变第二卷的结局，保持沉默或持有王室特许状会改变第二卷，Vaelith、Ezra的灯笼、Ilse嬷嬷和Morrow都会再次出现。持有特许状时，王冠为遣返越界者支付双倍报酬。

English: When a finale is out of reach, the Act panel now says what would help, with costs: evolve this hero, hire that recruit, build the Drill Yard, level your champion. A finished guild can endow the next one with its spare Gold, and a lost tide costs half as much. The Vale remembers more: heirs of remembered heroes, Accord-Sworn and Tide-Hardened recruits after a past guild's ending, one Bestiary across guilds, banner colours earned in the Hall, rivals with a grudge, and the Hall's records.
简体中文: 当终章遥不可及时，幕章面板现在会说明什么有帮助，并附上花费：进化这位英雄、雇佣那名新兵、建造操练场、提升你的勇者等级。完成的公会可以把多余的金币赠予下一个公会，输掉一次潮汐的代价减半。山谷记得更多：被铭记英雄的后裔、前一公会结局后的盟约誓士和历潮新兵、跨公会共享的怪物图鉴、在大厅赢得的旗帜颜色、心怀宿怨的对手，以及大厅的记录。

English: Feats: every elite, boss, pillar and finale sets one optional objective that suits the fight: break a wind-up, win by round 4, bank 8 Momentum, down a named foe first, two at once, or stay on your feet. Done by hand, it pays 40% more Gold and Essence, and an elite offers a fourth boon. Also: a past guild's choices only open the story web's gates for later guilds, not for itself.
简体中文: 壮举：每个精英、首领、石柱和终章都会设定一个适合该战斗的可选目标：打断蓄力、在第4回合前获胜、积攒8点气势、先击倒指定敌人、同时击倒两个，或无人倒下。手动完成可多得40%金币和精华，精英还会额外提供第四份恩赐。另外：前一公会的抉择只会为之后的公会打开剧情网中的关口，而不会为它自己打开。

English: The Unwritten Accord, part three: the Far Side and the Witnesses. Whose Terms they really were, what knocked on the Night of Breaking, and who signed first. Kael Ashborn and the Hollow's own people tell their versions. New choices for guilds that know enough: let the Choir sing, leave Brannoch at his door or free him, and a sixth crossing. And for a player who has learned it all, an epilogue that changes the Vale for every guild after.
简体中文: 《未书之盟》第三部：彼岸与见证者。那些条款究竟属于谁，破碎之夜敲门的是什么，谁最先签了字。Kael Ashborn和空洞的居民讲述他们的版本。为知晓足够多的公会提供新抉择：让圣咏团歌唱、把Brannoch留在门前或解放他，以及第六次越界。而对于已了解一切的玩家，还有一段会为之后每个公会改变山谷的尾声。

English: The Unwritten Accord, part two: the Key and the Lantern. Who opens the rifts, who pays for it, and what Essence really is. Mother Ilse, Captain Morrow and Ser Aldric tell their own versions in their letters. New choices for guilds that know enough: buy Morrow, buy the Crown's hearing, keep or break the key, pour your echoes into Ezra's lantern. And two charters a truth opens: Vaelith's Rangers and the Ninth Lamp.
简体中文: 《未书之盟》第二部：钥匙与灯笼。是谁打开了裂隙，谁为此付出代价，精华到底是什么。Ilse嬷嬷、Morrow队长和Aldric爵士在信中讲述各自的版本。为知晓足够多的公会提供新抉择：收买Morrow、买通王冠的听证、保留或折断钥匙、将你的回响注入Ezra的灯笼。还有两份由真相开启的特许状：Vaelith的游侠团与第九盏灯。

English: The Unwritten Accord, part one: the Vale's story now spreads across your guilds. Fragments turn up in rifts, on relics, in rival letters and at the pay table, and every later guild keeps them. Any two of a truth's fragments make it known (Library > Codex > Truths), and witnesses' claims are struck through or confirmed as you learn. Some truths open choices a first guild never gets.
简体中文: 《未书之盟》第一部：山谷的故事现在贯穿你的历代公会。残片会出现在裂隙中、遗物上、对手的信里和发薪桌旁，之后的每个公会都会保留它们。集齐一个真相的任意两块残片即可得知（图书馆 > 典籍 > 真相），随着你的了解，见证者的说法会被划掉或证实。有些真相会开启第一个公会永远得不到的抉择。

English: Text that matches the game: the Mercenary and Temple charters say how much more or less Gold they start with, the Break ending describes its weekly tides, the Warded boss and some Awakened Abilities say what they really do, and the Laurels count lists every source.
简体中文: 文本与游戏一致：佣兵与圣殿特许状写明了开局多或少多少金币，“决裂”结局描述了每周的潮汐，受守护首领和部分觉醒技能如实描述其效果，桂冠计数列出了所有来源。

English: The Accord Hall's finale grows less with every lost champion you free (2% each, was 5%), and when a finale is beyond your best party, the Act panel says how far, and what raises your power.
简体中文: 你每解放一位失落的勇者，盟约大厅的终章就会减弱一些（每位2%，原为5%），当终章超出你最强小队的能力时，幕章面板会说明差距多少，以及如何提升战力。

English: The Sky Beneath, continued: the real-time Endless Rift can now be run on the Glass Coast and in the Inverted City once you reach them, Hollow-born heroes look like they came from the far side, and the Hall of Guilds remembers whether a guild kept the doors open.
简体中文: 《下方之天》续：抵达玻璃海岸和倒悬之城后，即时无尽裂隙也可在那里进行，空洞出生的英雄看起来像来自彼岸，公会大厅会记住一个公会是否让大门保持敞开。

English: Book II, the Sky Beneath: after the Accord's ending (any of the three), a reply turns up on the ledger's last page, and two more acts open under the Accord Hall. Act V, the Glass Coast; Act VI, the Inverted City. 30 new foes, crossings to answer, a gate to hold, and one more choice at the end. (The new regions use recoloured art for now; their own art is coming.)
简体中文: 第二卷《下方之天》：在盟约的结局之后（三种中任意一种），账簿最后一页会出现一封回信，盟约大厅之下将开启另外两幕。第五幕，玻璃海岸；第六幕，倒悬之城。30个新敌人、需要回应的越界、一道需要坚守的大门，以及最后的又一个抉择。（新地区暂时使用重新着色的美术；专属美术即将到来。）

English: New systems now arrive more gradually: the rival's moves at the third sealed rift, Crafting at the fifth, and the Daily twist at the seventh, after Act I's finale.
简体中文: 新系统现在逐步解锁：对手动向在第三次封印裂隙时，制作在第五次，每日变奏在第七次、第一幕终章之后。

English: The Grandmaster's ledger no longer hides behind bad luck: after three sealed rifts without a page (while one is waiting in the current act), the next one finds it.
简体中文: 大团长的账簿不再被坏运气埋没：连续封印三个裂隙都没找到一页（且本幕仍有一页未找到）时，下一次必定找到。

English: For playtesters: the founding screen can skip Act I, so you start with it done and can try the middle game straight away (champions, Riftbreaks, the rival's moves).
简体中文: 致测试者：创建界面可以跳过第一幕，让你直接从第一幕完成的状态开始，立即体验中期内容（勇者、裂隙崩溃、对手动向）。

English: There is more to Hesper's story than she has told you. Each guild that finishes Act III hears a little more of it, and those who hear all of it, from guilds that have both kept and broken the Accord, may find a third way to end it.
简体中文: Hesper的故事远不止她告诉你的那些。每个完成第三幕的公会都会多听到一点，而那些听完全部的人——来自既守护过也打破过盟约的公会——或许能找到结束它的第三条路。

English: The Vale this year: after your first guild, each new one is founded in a different year. Two of eight year modifiers (a dry year, restless rifts, the Hollow stirring in one region, a hard winter...) each change the campaign one way for better and one for worse, and the rival has a temperament: hiring, boasting or undercutting. Roll the year again for 2 Laurels; Guild > Records shows it.
简体中文: 今年的山谷：在你的第一个公会之后，每个新公会都会在不同的年份创建。八种年份修正中的两种（旱年、躁动的裂隙、空洞在某地区蠢动、严冬……）各以一好一坏的方式改变战役，对手也有性情：重招募、好吹嘘或爱压价。花2桂冠可重抽年份；在公会 > 记录中查看。

English: The Descent: a new way into the Endless Rift, turn-based, with your heroes. Go down depth after depth, each harder and better paid; every second depth ends at a pillar where a lost champion waits. Climb out any time and keep everything. Pillars also turn up on Rank B and higher rifts, and the real-time Endless Rift is still there for your champions. Act IV now asks you to free a lost champion by any of the three.
简体中文: 深渊下行：进入无尽裂隙的新方式，回合制，由你的英雄出战。一层层往下，每层更难、报酬更高；每隔一层的尽头都有一根石柱，一位失落的勇者在那里等待。随时可以爬出并保留一切。石柱也会出现在阶级B及以上的裂隙中，即时无尽裂隙仍为你的勇者保留。第四幕现在要求你以三种方式中任意一种解放一位失落的勇者。

English: Two new founding gifts for your next guild (Laurels): Veteran start begins with Act I already done, with the heroes, gear and Gold a guild has by then; Old contacts puts two Rank C recruits on the first board.
简体中文: 为下一个公会新增两份创建赠礼（桂冠）：“老兵开局”以第一幕已完成的状态开始，拥有届时公会应有的英雄、装备和金币；“旧日人脉”在首张招募板上放置两名阶级C新兵。

English: Tidewalls: a guild that broke the Accord can raise walls against the Open Hollow (Guild > Management). Each makes every tide 6% weaker against the guild, and costs more than the last; Gold and Essence finally have somewhere to go in that postgame.
简体中文: 潮墙：打破盟约的公会可以筑墙抵御开启的空洞（公会 > 管理）。每道墙使每次潮汐对公会的威力降低6%，且造价逐次升高；金币和精华终于在终局后有了去处。

English: Postgame tuning: the old Accord halls cost about half as much (all seven: 45,000 Gold and 40,000 Essence). Tides of the Open Hollow now really break every week, with three days' warning, and grow 15% stronger only with each tide you hold: losing one doesn't make the next harder.
简体中文: 终局后调整：古老盟约大厅的花费约减半（全部七座：45,000金币和40,000精华）。开启的空洞的潮汐现在真的每周爆发，提前三天预警，且只在你每守住一次后增强15%：失守不会让下一次更难。

English: Hesper, Wen and Dobbs remember your past guilds: on a quiet payday the talk at the pay table can turn to one of them, and to the heroes it left behind.
简体中文: Hesper、Wen和Dobbs记得你过去的公会：在平静的发薪日，发薪桌旁的话题可能转向其中一个，以及它留下的英雄。

English: Your past guilds' banners now hang in camp, either side of the Guild Hall. Hover one for its record; click it for the Hall of Guilds.
简体中文: 你过去公会的旗帜现在悬挂在营地中，位于公会大厅两侧。悬停查看其记录；点击进入公会名人堂。

English: After your first guild: found the next one under a charter (Mercenary Company, Temple Order, the Lantern's Smugglers, Last of the Accord) and swear oaths for more Laurels. And the ending now sets the postgame: Keepers of the Vale restore the old Accord halls; a guild that broke the Accord holds back a tide of the Open Hollow every week. The Chronicle lists what a guild can still finish.
简体中文: 第一个公会之后：在特许状下创建下一个公会（佣兵团、圣殿骑士团、灯笼走私者、盟约遗孤），并立下誓言以获得更多桂冠。结局现在决定终局后内容：山谷守护者修复古老的盟约大厅；打破盟约的公会每周抵挡一次开启的空洞的潮汐。编年史会列出公会还能完成的内容。

English: Legacy: when your guild chooses the Accord's ending (or retires, from Act III on, under Guild > Records), it joins the Hall of Guilds. Up to two of its heroes come back as champions in your later guilds, waiting to be freed in the Endless Rift, and it leaves Laurels to spend on gifts when you found the next one.
简体中文: 传承：当你的公会选择盟约的结局（或从第三幕起在公会 > 记录中退隐）时，它将进入公会名人堂。最多两名英雄会在之后的公会中以勇者身份回归，在无尽裂隙中等待被解放，它还会留下桂冠，供你创建下一个公会时兑换赠礼。

English: Captain Morrow is a real fight now: tougher than other bosses of his rank, and he whistles up his sellswords twice, at two-thirds and again at one-third health.
简体中文: Morrow队长现在是一场真正的战斗：比同阶级的其他首领更强韧，他会两次吹哨召来佣兵，分别在三分之二和三分之一生命时。

English: Party Assembly is simpler: your party stands on four slots facing the foes. Press + on a slot to pick a hero, or drag one from the roster onto it (onto someone to swap). Each hero has a small F/B switch for the Front or Back row.
简体中文: 小队编组更简单：你的小队站在面对敌人的四个位置上。在位置上按+选择英雄，或从名册拖一名到位置上（拖到某人身上则交换）。每位英雄都有一个小小的前/后开关，切换前排或后排。

English: The boon after an elite is now a pop-up too: one card per boon in its family's colours, with the set it would complete, Take (or keys 1-3) and Skip.
简体中文: 精英战后的恩赐现在也是弹窗：每份恩赐一张卡，使用其系列的配色，显示它能凑成的套装，以及“拿取”（或按键1-3）和“跳过”。

English: After a won fight, choosing your reward is now its own pop-up: the loot as cards with every stat on its own line, who it suits, and a Take button (or keys 1-3).
简体中文: 战斗胜利后，选择奖励现在有独立弹窗：战利品以卡牌呈现，每项属性单独一行，显示适合谁，还有“拿取”按钮（或按键1-3）。

English: Move a guild between devices: Settings > Backup > Send to another device gives a short code and a QR code. Scan it with your phone, or choose Receive a guild on the title screen and type the code. A code works once, for 15 minutes.
简体中文: 在设备间转移公会：设置 > 备份 > 发送到其他设备，会生成短代码和二维码。用手机扫描，或在标题画面选择“接收公会”并输入代码。代码仅可使用一次，有效期15分钟。

English: Easier to read: the game's text is now set in Lato, wider and clearer at 1080p and below, and the opening's captions sit on a dark plate in a sturdier book face. Back on Settings works again after pressing the gear a second time.
简体中文: 更易阅读：游戏文本现在使用Lato字体，在1080p及以下更宽更清晰，开场字幕以更稳重的书体置于深色底板上。再次按下齿轮后，设置中的“返回”恢复正常。

English: The Hollow Crown Company strikes back: expose them and from Act III their sellswords ambush your rifts, and Captain Morrow waits at the bottom of a Rank C+ rift with the key he opens rifts with. A kept echo can now touch a hero who recognises what's in it (Echo-Touched); the third echo brings Ezra the Pale, and the campaign's end says what the Vale remembers. A hero's fiftieth rift gets a line in the Chronicle.
简体中文: 空洞王冠佣兵团反击了：揭发他们后，从第三幕起他们的佣兵会伏击你的裂隙，Morrow队长带着他用来打开裂隙的钥匙，在阶级C+裂隙的底部等候。保留的回响现在可能触动一位认出其中内容的英雄（回响触动）；第三个回响会带来苍白者Ezra，战役结尾会讲述山谷记住了什么。英雄的第五十次裂隙会在编年史中留下一笔。

English: New sound effects throughout (free CC0 sounds, picked by ear). The Charter War comes to a head: as Act III opens, Mother Ilse brings proof the Hollow Crown Company opens rifts for profit. Expose them or keep quiet; when Act III ends, the Crown grants its Royal Charter to the guild with the most Renown. Wen now writes a line for every hero on the Memorial, and a scene when a bond reaches its peak.
简体中文: 全新音效（免费CC0音效，凭耳朵挑选）。特许状之争到达高潮：第三幕开始时，Ilse嬷嬷带来证据，证明空洞王冠佣兵团为牟利而打开裂隙。揭发他们或保持沉默；第三幕结束时，王冠会将王室特许状授予声望最高的公会。Wen现在会为纪念碑上的每位英雄写一句话，羁绊达到顶点时还会有一段场景。

English: The opening is narrated now, over its own music, with two new scenes: the Accord sealing a rift, and the villagers waiting for a guild. Watch it again from Settings or the Chronicle.
简体中文: 开场现在有了旁白和专属音乐，并新增两个场景：盟约封印裂隙，以及等待公会的村民。可在设置或编年史中重看。

English: An opening cinematic: the Night of Breaking, how the old guilds of the Accord vanished, ending on your own guild. It plays when you found a guild; watch it again from Settings or Library > Codex > Chronicle.
简体中文: 开场动画：破碎之夜，盟约的古老公会如何消失，最后落在你自己的公会上。创建公会时播放；可在设置或图书馆 > 典籍 > 编年史中重看。

English: From Act II a sealed rift sometimes leaves an echo: Essence that holds something the Hollow took from someone. Give it back to the village, or keep it. Stranger, gentler things now turn up in rifts too. And when a hero first reaches Rank B, the guild marks their new calling with a scene of its own.
简体中文: 从第二幕起，封印的裂隙有时会留下回响：一份精华，里面承载着空洞从某人身上夺走的东西。把它还给村庄，或留下它。裂隙中也会出现更奇异、更温和的事物。当英雄首次达到阶级B时，公会会以专属场景纪念其新的使命。

English: Act IV: the Accord Hall. After Sythrane, the posts are tiring, and the Terms of the old bargain wait at the bottom of the Endless Rift (stronger for every post you've emptied). Beat them and choose how the story ends: renew the Accord, or break it. Guilds that already finished Act III can start it now.
简体中文: 第四幕：盟约大厅。在Sythrane之后，驻守者们已疲惫不堪，旧约的条款在无尽裂隙底部等待（你每清空一个岗位，它就更强）。击败它们，并选择故事如何结束：续订盟约，或将其打破。已完成第三幕的公会现在即可开始。

English: The guild has people now. Wen the Chronicler, Dobbs the Quartermaster and Old Hesper, the last of an Accord guild, talk at the pay table every payday (see the Ledger). The rival's leader signs every move with a letter of their own, and the Crown has promised a Royal Charter to the best guild. Freeing a champion in the Endless Rift leaves a post empty: the next Riftbreak comes sooner.
简体中文: 公会现在有了人。编年史官Wen、军需官Dobbs和老Hesper——某个盟约公会的最后一人——每个发薪日都会在发薪桌旁交谈（见账簿）。对手首领的每次行动都附有亲笔信，王冠承诺将王室特许状授予最好的公会。在无尽裂隙中解放勇者会空出一个岗位：下一次裂隙崩溃会来得更早。

English: The story has a past now: the Broken Accord. Why the old guilds vanished on the Night of Breaking, what the champions remember of it, and pages of the Grandmaster's ledger to find in sealed rifts. Read it all in Library > Codex > Chronicle.
简体中文: 剧情现在有了过往：破碎的盟约。古老的公会为何在破碎之夜消失，勇者们还记得什么，以及在封印的裂隙中寻找大团长账簿的残页。在图书馆 > 典籍 > 编年史中阅读全部内容。

English: Recruiting is a board now: new faces arrive every day and wait a few days before moving on, payday fills it, and the rival may sign your best offer first. Each card shows the recruit's attributes and born quirk. Rerolls double in price until payday. Party screens have three saved loadouts: save a party with its rows, load it in one click.
简体中文: 招募现在是一块告示板：每天都有新面孔到来，停留几天后离开，发薪日会补满，对手可能抢先签下你最好的人选。每张卡显示新兵的属性和天生特质。重抽价格翻倍，直到发薪日。小队界面有三个保存的配置：保存含站位的小队，一键载入。

English: The Guild Ledger runs the payroll now: put a hero on half pay to save Gold (it costs morale) or give a bonus to keep them Inspired, see the vault against payday at a glance, and who would go unpaid. Skills aimed at one foe ask which: click the foe. Any save can be deleted from Load Game.
简体中文: 公会账簿现在管理工资单：让英雄领半薪以节省金币（会降低士气），或发奖金让他们保持振奋，一眼看清金库与发薪日的对比，以及谁会领不到薪水。针对单个敌人的技能会询问目标：点击敌人即可。任何存档都可以在“载入游戏”中删除。

English: A lighter interface: cards and buttons lose their outlines (an edge now means something needs you), the main tabs moved into the header, lists and ledgers sit on a calm background, the hero page says each number once, and notices stack less. Key numbers on fight buttons are a setting now (Settings > Key hints).
简体中文: 更轻盈的界面：卡牌和按钮去掉了描边（现在有边框表示需要你处理），主标签页移到了页眉，列表和账簿置于沉静的背景上，英雄页每个数字只出现一次，通知堆叠更少。战斗按钮上的按键编号现在是一项设置（设置 > 按键提示）。

English: Act finales are real climaxes: each is built on the rank you sealed to reach it, a step harder (they had fallen below it, and a quarter of finale fights ended in the first round). The Recommended power on the party screen follows. Champion cards line up in an even grid.
简体中文: 各幕终章成为真正的高潮：每个终章都基于你为抵达它而封印的阶级，难度再高一档（它们曾低于该阶级，四分之一的终章战在第一回合就结束了）。小队界面的建议战力随之调整。勇者卡排列成整齐的网格。

English: Inventory and Guild Management open straight on their contents: the room's art is a slim strip with its sections as buttons, and each opens where you left it.
简体中文: 物品栏和公会管理现在直接打开其内容：房间美术是一条细长横幅，各分区作为按钮，每个分区都会在你上次离开的地方打开。

English: Cleaner screens on a laptop: shops, treasure, events and hazards no longer sit under the path map (it shows while you choose a path), Victory puts the rewards beside the results, the quest board fits every note, pre-fight art is shorter, and notices moved to the bottom right.
简体中文: 笔记本屏幕更清爽：商店、宝藏、事件和险境不再位于路线图下方（选择路线时才显示），胜利界面将奖励放在结果旁边，任务板能放下每张便条，战前插图更短，通知移到右下角。

English: Recruits: commission a hero of the role you want (3 rerolls' Gold), and each offer shows power, HP and wage. Hazards now hurt in line with the rift's rank and always pay about a fight's worth, with a chance of double. Agility gives +1.5% dodge a point (was 0.8%).
简体中文: 招募：委托招募你想要的职业英雄（花费3次重抽的金币），每个人选都显示战力、生命和薪水。险境的伤害现在与裂隙阶级相符，且总能给予约一场战斗的报酬，有几率翻倍。敏捷每点+1.5%闪避（原为0.8%）。

English: From player feedback: click a foe to target it (click again to attack). Auto lasts one fight. Quick fight also opens for a Favored party and says why when it can't. Every Ability shows its numbers. Shield Bash can't stun the same foe two rounds running. Fixed Legendary relics no longer take Essence for levels (refunded). Items say which slot they take. The party screen remembers your last party and rows. Clearer Medical Bay, rewards, run summary and skill tree.
简体中文: 来自玩家反馈：点击敌人选为目标（再次点击攻击）。自动持续一场战斗。快速战斗现在也对占优小队开放，不可用时会说明原因。每个技能都显示数值。盾击无法连续两回合眩晕同一敌人。固定的传奇遗物升级不再消耗精华（已退还）。物品会注明占用哪个栏位。小队界面会记住你上次的小队和站位。医疗所、奖励、远征总结和技能树更清晰。

English: The bonus for winning by hand (+30% Gold and Essence, no one down) now pays on elites, bosses and every fight on a rank you haven't sealed: the fights where playing by hand matters.
简体中文: 手动获胜的奖励（+30%金币和精华，无人倒下）现在适用于精英、首领以及你尚未封印过的阶级中的每场战斗：也就是手动操作真正重要的战斗。

English: Fights: Quick fight now opens on a rank once you've sealed it, so a new rank and the act finales are fought where you can see them. Auto pauses when a hero is about to fall. The bonus for winning by hand shows before every fight.
简体中文: 战斗：快速战斗现在在你封印某阶级后才对该阶级开放，因此新阶级和各幕终章都在你眼前进行。英雄即将倒下时自动战斗会暂停。手动获胜的奖励会在每场战斗前显示。

English: Balance: from Rank E up, monsters hit harder and last longer, so a party at Recommended power now seals about 3 rifts in 5 and Deadly means it. Hero wages are 50% higher, so a big roster has to earn its keep.
简体中文: 平衡：从阶级E起，怪物攻击更重、更耐打，建议战力下的小队现在大约五次封印三次，“致命”名副其实。英雄薪水提高50%，庞大的名册必须物有所值。

English: A new guild meets its systems one at a time: Quests after your first seal, Management after the second, then Crafting, the daily twist and the rival's moves after the third. A broke guild with fewer than 3 heroes now gets free volunteers at payday.
简体中文: 新公会逐一接触各个系统：首次封印后开放任务，第二次后开放管理，第三次后开放制作、每日变奏和对手动向。英雄少于3名的破产公会现在会在发薪日获得免费志愿者。

English: Phones: no keyboard hints where there's no keyboard, and a larger turn-your-phone prompt.
简体中文: 手机：没有键盘时不再显示按键提示，横置手机的提示更大。

English: Phones: hold your phone sideways and the game now fits, with larger text and buttons and the whole fight on one screen. Press and hold anything to read what it does. A fight won by hand with no one down now pays +30% Essence as well as Gold.
简体中文: 手机：横握手机，游戏现在会自适应，文字和按钮更大，整场战斗在一屏内。长按任何东西可查看其作用。手动获胜且无人倒下，现在除金币外还会额外给予+30%精华。

English: A guild now holds 6 heroes from the start (a party is 4), so there's a bench to choose from. Act I and Act II have new goals. The Feedback report now includes how long you've played and how your fights and runs went.
简体中文: 公会开局即可容纳6名英雄（小队为4人），因此有替补可选。第一幕和第二幕有了新目标。反馈报告现在包含你的游戏时长以及战斗和远征的情况。

English: Fixes from a full play-through: a foe that has wound up keeps its red warning until the blow lands, the first fight's lessons come in order, the rival's contract grab can't point at a contract that's gone, rift bosses belong to their region (no Act III boss in the Vale), and the rival keeps pace in the Renown race. New: Add strongest on the party screen.
简体中文: 完整通关后的修复：已蓄力的敌人会保持红色警告直到攻击落下，第一场战斗的教学按顺序出现，对手抢夺契约时不会指向已消失的契约，裂隙首领属于其所在地区（山谷中不会出现第三幕首领），对手在声望竞赛中跟得上节奏。新增：小队界面的“添加最强”。

English: New foes and stories: six new monsters, two per region (Blight Hound, Lantern Wight, Tide Caller, Mudscale Brute, Cinder Hound, Obsidian Sentinel) in six new designed fights, and 21 new rift events, some found only in one region. Upgrading a facility, hiring a hero, levelling a champion or buying from a shop now lands with a banner and a burst of sparks.
简体中文: 新敌人与新故事：六种新怪物，每个地区两种（枯萎猎犬、灯笼尸妖、唤潮者、泥鳞蛮兽、余烬猎犬、黑曜哨兵），分布于六场新设计的战斗中，另有21个新的裂隙事件，部分只在特定地区出现。升级设施、雇佣英雄、提升勇者等级或在商店购买现在会伴随横幅和一阵火花。

English: The rival acts: once a week it may court one of your heroes, dare you to seal a rift by payday, or go for a posted contract, and you decide how to answer. Hero requests and the rival's moves pop up as cards when you're home. The Ledger opens on a week board: every day to payday and what falls on it.
简体中文: 对手行动了：每周它可能拉拢你的一名英雄、挑战你在发薪日前封印一个裂隙，或争夺已发布的契约，由你决定如何回应。英雄请求和对手动向会在你回到营地时以卡牌弹出。账簿打开时显示周计划板：到发薪日的每一天及当天发生的事。

English: Fewer, clearer modes: the Daily Rift is now a daily twist on the Rift Ladder (tick it and your next ladder rift, any rank, carries the day's rule and boon for bonus Essence). Echoes are gone: the Endless Rift pays Essence, and Essence levels champions (old Echoes were converted). Renown is the one race with the rival: the monthly contest counts Renown gained, and the Renown tile turns green when you lead.
简体中文: 模式更少、更清晰：每日裂隙现在是裂隙阶梯上的每日变奏（勾选后，你的下一个阶梯裂隙，无论阶级，都会带有当天的规则和恩赐，换取额外精华）。回响已移除：无尽裂隙给予精华，精华用于提升勇者等级（旧回响已转换）。声望是与对手唯一的竞赛：每月竞赛统计获得的声望，领先时声望格变绿。

English: New loot: items roll fewer, bigger stats (two per item type), and Rare and Epic items carry a named effect such as Ambush, Thunderclap, Riposte or Renewal. Picking gear shows the Power change. Your current items are unchanged.
简体中文: 新战利品：物品的属性条数更少、数值更大（每种物品类型两条），稀有和史诗物品带有命名效果，如伏击、雷鸣、还击或复苏。挑选装备时会显示战力变化。你现有的物品不变。

English: Phase 1 of the design pass: fights fit on screen without scrolling, notices sit in the top-right corner (two at a time, click to dismiss, never over a fight), new guilds start with three heroes, one tip at a time, and a tidier Rift Hall and Ledger.
简体中文: 设计调整第一阶段：战斗无需滚动即可完整显示，通知位于右上角（每次两条，点击关闭，绝不遮挡战斗），新公会以三名英雄开局，每次一条提示，裂隙大厅和账簿更整洁。

English: Hero pages are tidier: the header is a row of chips, clicking a slot opens a pop-up of item cards (gains in green, losses in red), and the passive and build notes moved to the Skills tab.
简体中文: 英雄页面更整洁：页眉是一排标签，点击栏位会弹出物品卡（提升为绿色，下降为红色），被动和构筑说明移到了技能页。

English: Hero pages between fights: click a hero in the rift's top bar (or Hero pages) for the same page as the Roster — gear, attribute and skill points, with tabs for the whole party. It replaces the old Gear Up panel.
简体中文: 战斗间隙的英雄页面：点击裂隙顶栏中的英雄（或“英雄页面”），即可打开与名册相同的页面——装备、属性和技能点，整支小队各有标签页。它取代了旧的整备面板。

English: Riftbreak defenses have painted roads, the Defenses research stands on the war-room map, and a lost defense never touches the Gold set aside for payday. Champions' signature mods are spread evenly: each of the 12 on four champions.
简体中文: 裂隙崩溃防御有了绘制的道路，防御研究立于作战室地图上，防御失败绝不会动用为发薪日预留的金币。勇者的招牌改造分布均匀：12种各分给四位勇者。

English: Riftbreaks: from Act II a rift swells now and then, with a countdown in days. Seal a rift of its rank in time to close it, or it breaks and your guild defends: build towers on the road, post your idle heroes and steer a champion. Losing costs Gold, Essence and a damaged building. New Defenses research in Guild > Manage, paid in Gold.
简体中文: 裂隙崩溃：从第二幕起，裂隙不时会膨胀，并以天数倒计时。及时封印一个同阶级的裂隙即可关闭它，否则它会崩溃，你的公会须进行防御：在道路上建造塔、派驻空闲的英雄并指挥一位勇者。失败会损失金币、精华，并有一座建筑受损。公会 > 管理中新增防御研究，以金币支付。

English: Endless Rift level-ups are built around your champions now: each champion's signature move has two mods of its own (Aftershock, Kindled, Leech, Bulwark and more). From level 10, fuse two champions: their signatures fire together, 25% harder, and share their mods.
简体中文: 无尽裂隙的升级现在围绕你的勇者展开：每位勇者的招牌动作有两种专属改造（余震、引燃、吸血、壁垒等）。从10级起，可融合两位勇者：他们的招牌动作一同触发，威力提高25%，并共享改造。

English: Endless Rift: gentler when it first opens, and it grows stronger with every champion you free and every act you pass (the party screen shows its strength).
简体中文: 无尽裂隙：刚开放时更温和，并随着你解放的每位勇者和推进的每一幕而增强（小队界面显示其强度）。

English: Endless Rift: every champion now walks with their own animation and plays a signature move when their Call fires.
简体中文: 无尽裂隙：每位勇者现在都有专属行走动画，号令触发时会施展招牌动作。

English: Champions, reworked: 24 named champions with their own art, and each new guild meets a different 12. Three are freed by the story, nine are lost in the Endless Rift (stand in their light to free them). One oversees your rift runs with a Boon and a Call; Echoes level them up.
简体中文: 勇者重做：24位有专属美术的具名勇者，每个新公会会遇到不同的12位。三位由剧情解放，九位迷失在无尽裂隙中（站在他们的光芒中即可解放）。一位勇者以恩赐和号令督导你的裂隙远征；回响可提升其等级。

English: The Endless Rift is now the champions' rift: only champions go in, each with a signature move. It pays Echoes and a little gold, and costs the guild a day.
简体中文: 无尽裂隙现在是勇者的裂隙：只有勇者能进入，每人都有招牌动作。它给予回响和少量金币，并花费公会一天时间。

English: Türkçe (beta): Settings or the title screen. Menus, fights, tips, names and descriptions are all in Turkish.
简体中文: Türkçe（测试版）：在设置或标题画面中选择。菜单、战斗、提示、名称和描述全部为土耳其语。

English: Settings > Hearing aid: captions for sounds that tell you something (a boss arriving, a heavy blow, a hero going down, a wind-up), and the screen's edges pulse on the biggest moments.
简体中文: 设置 > 听觉辅助：为传达信息的声音提供字幕（首领到来、重击、英雄倒下、蓄力），并在最关键的时刻让屏幕边缘闪动。

English: Two heroes of the same subclass no longer look like twins: the second wears different colours, everywhere they appear.
简体中文: 两名同一子职业的英雄不再像双胞胎：第二位无论出现在哪里都会穿不同的颜色。

English: Endless Rift: fixed the field going grey after a stutter; the ground has grass, reeds, cracks and embers; the party stands out in the middle; banners no longer pile up.
简体中文: 无尽裂隙：修复了卡顿后场地变灰的问题；地面有了草、芦苇、裂缝和余烬；小队在中央更醒目；旗帜不再堆叠。

English: New look: the title, camp and Rift Hall fill the screen, with flickering torches, breathing portals, stars and fireflies; screens fade between each other and a rift opens as you step in.
简体中文: 新面貌：标题、营地和裂隙大厅铺满屏幕，有摇曳的火把、呼吸般的传送门、星星和萤火虫；界面之间淡入淡出，踏入裂隙时它会随之开启。

English: Endless Rift: waves every minute, elite packs with chests, archers, a Rift Warden at 20:00 to beat, evolutions, rift relics, terrain and braziers.
简体中文: 无尽裂隙：每分钟一波敌人，带宝箱的精英群、弓手、20:00出现的裂隙守卫等你击败，还有进化、裂隙遗物、地形和火盆。

English: Fights: the main actions fit one row (More holds the rest); hover to preview Momentum; winning by hand with no one down pays +30% Gold.
简体中文: 战斗：主要行动排成一行（“更多”收纳其余）；悬停预览气势；手动获胜且无人倒下可多得+30%金币。

English: Guild: a This-week strip in camp, hero requests to answer, a rival with a face and a monthly contest.
简体中文: 公会：营地中的“本周”栏、需要回应的英雄请求、有面孔的对手和每月竞赛。

English: New music, larger text, and rank rules shown in the rift.
简体中文: 新音乐、更大的文字，裂隙中显示阶级规则。

English: Long-range bolts at the foe furthest along the road
简体中文: 向道路上最远的敌人发射远程弩矢

English: Hurls fire that splashes and burns
Chills every foe in reach: they walk slower
简体中文: 冻寒范围内所有敌人：使其移动变慢

English: Heroes in reach take less damage
简体中文: 范围内的英雄受到的伤害降低

English: Heroes in reach mend every second
简体中文: 范围内的英雄每秒回复生命

English: The knight who asked for the deepest post, under a city nobody on our side has seen, and held its door with his shoulder for twenty years. The chains are still on his wrists; he says they help him remember why.
简体中文: 这位骑士请求驻守最深的岗位，在一座我们这边无人见过的城市之下，用肩膀抵住那扇门二十年。锁链仍在他的手腕上；他说这能帮他记住为什么。

English: shields every ally for 35% of their max HP
简体中文: 为每名盟友提供其最大生命35%的护盾

English: Lost his jaw to a rift-beast and had a better one forged. He has not stopped talking since.
简体中文: 他的下颚被裂隙兽咬掉了，于是锻造了一副更好的。从那以后他就没停过嘴。

English: the whole party hits 25% harder for the rest of the fight
简体中文: 整支小队在本场战斗剩余时间内伤害提高25%

English: He died in the Endless Rift once. It didn't take.
简体中文: 他曾在无尽裂隙中死过一次。没死成。

English: braces the party against a wipe for the rest of the fight
简体中文: 在本场战斗剩余时间内保护小队免于团灭

English: Her village sank into a rift in a single night. She walked in after it and has been walking ever since.
简体中文: 她的村庄一夜之间沉入了裂隙。她随之走了进去，从此一直走着。

English: wards the front row for 50% of their max HP
简体中文: 为前排提供其最大生命50%的守护

English: Swore to guard a rift-gate until relieved. Nobody came. He is very glad to see you.
简体中文: 他发誓守卫一道裂隙之门，直到有人换岗。没人来过。他很高兴见到你。

English: a sweep of the spear hits every foe
简体中文: 长矛一扫，击中所有敌人

English: She outran a rift-storm once. Now she can't stop running, so she brings the storm with her.
简体中文: 她曾跑赢过一场裂隙风暴。如今她停不下来，于是把风暴也带在身边。

English: arrows ride the wind, jumping between foes
简体中文: 箭矢乘风，在敌人之间弹跳

English: Raised by rift-wolves. Speaks their language better than ours, and prefers their company.
简体中文: 由裂隙狼群养大。说狼的语言比说我们的还好，也更喜欢它们的陪伴。

English: the pack falls on the weakest foe, harder the more it's hurt
简体中文: 兽群扑向最弱的敌人，它伤得越重，扑得越狠

English: The last warden of a forest the rifts swallowed. The forest is still in there; so is she.
简体中文: 一片被裂隙吞没的森林的最后一位守林人。森林还在里面；她也是。

English: thorns bind the target: it loses its next two actions (a boss, one)
简体中文: 荆棘缚住目标：使其失去接下来两次行动（首领为一次）

English: Forty years of setting snares for things that come out of rifts. Some of them are still in his cellar.
简体中文: 四十年来一直为从裂隙里出来的东西设陷阱。有些至今还关在他的地窖里。

English: springs every trap at once on the wounded foes
简体中文: 对负伤的敌人同时触发所有陷阱

English: Has never missed a shot. He will tell you this before you ask.
简体中文: 从未失手过。不等你问，他就会告诉你。

English: one perfect arrow at the weakest foe, deadlier the more it's hurt
简体中文: 对最弱的敌人射出完美一箭，它伤得越重越致命

English: Once the herald of an ash-queen, until he read what he was heralding. The embers under his skin never cooled.
简体中文: 曾是一位灰烬女王的传令官，直到他读懂了自己在宣告什么。他皮肤下的余烬从未冷却。

English: a rain of burning ash engulfs every foe
简体中文: 燃烧的灰烬如雨落下，吞没所有敌人

English: Mapped every star, then noticed new ones leaking out of the rifts. She has been following them since.
简体中文: 她绘遍了每一颗星，然后注意到有新的星从裂隙中渗出。从那以后她一直追随着它们。

English: calls down a falling star on every foe
简体中文: 召唤一颗陨星砸向所有敌人

English: Froze a rift solid to save a town. The town is fine. She has been cold for a hundred years.
简体中文: 为拯救一座城镇，她将一道裂隙冻得结结实实。城镇安然无恙。她已经冷了一百年。

English: freezes the target solid: it loses its next two actions (a boss, one)
简体中文: 将目标冻得结结实实：使其失去接下来两次行动（首领为一次）

English: Built a machine to close rifts. It opened one instead. She is working on version two.
简体中文: 造了一台机器来关闭裂隙。结果却打开了一道。她正在做第二版。

English: lightning arcs from foe to foe
Studies what the rifts take from people. Keeps some of it in the lantern, for safekeeping. He insists.
简体中文: 研究裂隙从人们身上夺走的东西。把其中一些放在灯笼里，妥善保管。他坚持这么说。

English: drains the weakest foe, healing the caster for a share of it
简体中文: 吸取最弱的敌人，按一定比例为施法者回复生命

English: Kept alive at the bottom of a drowned spire as a lantern for something that hated the dark. She still carries the light.
简体中文: 被困在淹没尖塔的底部，作为某个憎恨黑暗之物的灯火苟活。她至今仍带着那道光。

English: heals the party 55% and washes away burn, poison, chill, stun and curses
简体中文: 为小队回复55%生命，并洗去燃烧、中毒、冻寒、眩晕和诅咒

English: Lit the lamps of a city that fell into a rift. He kept lighting them. Eventually the lamps led him out.
简体中文: 他为一座坠入裂隙的城市点灯。他一直点下去。最终，那些灯把他引了出来。

English: raises a fallen ally at 60% HP (or heals the most hurt)
简体中文: 以60%生命复活一名倒下的盟友（或治疗伤势最重者）

English: Walked into the dark between rifts to find the sunrise. Came back with it.
简体中文: 走进裂隙之间的黑暗去寻找日出。带着它回来了。

English: heals the whole party for 65% of their max HP
简体中文: 为全队回复其最大生命65%的生命

English: Opened a tavern at the edge of a rift. Business was terrible. Blessings were excellent.
简体中文: 在裂隙边上开了一家酒馆。生意糟透了。祝福好极了。

English: heals the whole party for 50% of their max HP
简体中文: 为全队回复其最大生命50%的生命

English: Wears the mask so the rift can't see her face. It has been looking for her a long time.
简体中文: 戴着面具，让裂隙看不见她的脸。它已经找了她很久。

English: thick smoke: +30% dodge for the rest of the fight
简体中文: 浓烟：在本场战斗剩余时间内闪避+30%

English: An assassin who took one contract too many: on the moon. It didn't go well for either of them.
简体中文: 一名多接了一单的刺客：目标在月亮上。对双方来说结局都不太好。

English: darkness falls, and every wounded foe with it
简体中文: 黑暗降临，所有负伤的敌人随之倒下

English: Stole a key from a rift-lord's belt. The key opened the rift. Pip would like to give it back.
简体中文: 从一位裂隙领主的腰带上偷了把钥匙。那把钥匙打开了裂隙。Pip很想把它还回去。

English: +35% dodge for the rest of the fight
简体中文: 在本场战斗剩余时间内闪避+35%

English: Captained a ship that sailed off the edge of the world and into a rift. Kept the coat.
简体中文: 曾任一艘船的船长，那艘船驶出了世界的边缘，驶进了裂隙。外套留下了。

English: a spinning storm of cutlasses hits every foe
简体中文: 弯刀旋成风暴，击中所有敌人

English: Brews poisons from what bleeds out of rifts. Swears most of them are medicine.
简体中文: 用裂隙里渗出的东西熬制毒药。发誓说大多数都是良药。

English: a toxic cloud that eats at every foe for three rounds
简体中文: 毒云持续侵蚀所有敌人，为期三回合

English: An Accord ranger who walked off her post on the Night of Breaking, toward the noise. She has been holding a door open ever since.
简体中文: 一位盟约游侠，在破碎之夜离开了岗位，循着声响而去。从那以后她一直撑着一扇门。

English: she steps in front of the target: it loses its next two actions (a boss, one)
简体中文: 她挺身挡在目标面前：使其失去接下来两次行动（首领为一次）

English: I counted the voices behind my door every night for a year. Then I stopped counting and opened it.
简体中文: 整整一年，我每晚都数着门后的声音。后来我不数了，把门打开了。

English: There was a girl on the other side of my door. I told her to wait, that I'd come back for her. I'd like to know if she did.
简体中文: 我那扇门的另一边有个女孩。我叫她等着，说我会回来接她。我想知道她有没有等。

English: We drew lots for the posts. I drew a deep one. I remember thinking that was lucky.
简体中文: 我们抽签决定岗位。我抽到了很深的一个。我记得当时还觉得是好运。

English: When the light closed over me it didn't hurt. It felt like being told to wait, very firmly.
简体中文: 光合拢在我身上时并不疼。感觉就像被人非常坚决地命令：等着。

English: My whole shield-company walked into the light together. I came out alone. Ask the others if they're still holding.
简体中文: 我整个盾卫连一起走进了光里。只有我一个人出来了。去问问其他人，他们是否还在坚守。

English: The order was: hold until relieved. The Grandmaster said she would come back for us herself. She didn't. Why didn't she?
简体中文: 命令是：坚守，直到换岗。大团长说她会亲自回来接我们。她没有。为什么没有？

English: I ran messages between the posts that night. The last one I carried was from the Grandmaster, and it was sealed with ash.
简体中文: 那晚我在各个岗位之间传递消息。我送的最后一封出自大团长，用灰烬封着。

English: The wolves knew before we did. They howled at the Hall for three days before the Night. Nobody listens to wolves.
简体中文: 狼比我们先知道。破碎之夜前三天，它们一直对着大厅嚎叫。没人会听狼的话。

English: Some of us didn't go into the light willingly. The Grandmaster said there wasn't time to ask.
简体中文: 我们中有些人并非自愿走进光里。大团长说没时间问了。

English: I set a snare at my post, out of habit. Caught a voice. It kept saying: the price, the price.
简体中文: 出于习惯，我在岗位上设了个陷阱。逮到了一个声音。它一直在说：代价，代价。

English: I had the Grandmaster in my sights that night, on her way out. I've never missed. I didn't take the shot. I'd like to know if that was right.
简体中文: 那晚大团长离开时，我把她套在了准星里。我从没失过手。我没有放箭。我想知道那样做对不对。

English: I read her proclamations aloud in the ash for years before I read one closely. It began: the Accord is dissolved.
简体中文: 多年来我在灰烬中高声宣读她的公告，直到有一次细读。开头写着：盟约就此解散。

English: The new stars leaking from the rifts are the posts, going out one by one. I have counted forty dark since the Night.
简体中文: 从裂隙中渗出的新星就是那些岗位，正一个接一个熄灭。自破碎之夜以来，我已数到四十颗暗了。

English: Freezing my rift was my own idea, not the Accord's. I think that's why the Hollow never got its hooks into me.
简体中文: 冻结我的裂隙是我自己的主意，不是盟约的。我想这就是空洞从未把钩子扎进我身上的原因。

English: The Accord's engineers built the bargain like a lock. I've seen the plans. Every lock has a key.
简体中文: 盟约的工匠把这桩交易造得像一把锁。我见过图纸。每把锁都有钥匙。

English: Each of us gave the Hollow something to seal the deal. I gave my colour. You can probably tell.
简体中文: 我们每个人都给了空洞一样东西来达成交易。我给的是我的颜色。你大概看得出来。

English: I was kept lit to read the archive by. I read all of it. The bargain has a clause about what happens when a post is abandoned.
简体中文: 他们让我一直亮着，好借光阅读档案。我读完了全部。交易里有一条，讲的是岗位被遗弃时会发生什么。

English: The lamps of my city were Accord lamps, meant to lead the guilds home. The city fell before anyone came back.
简体中文: 我那座城的灯是盟约之灯，本是用来引领各公会回家的。还没等到有人回来，城就陷落了。

English: The Grandmaster said there would be no sunrise until the price was paid. She was wrong. I went and found it.
简体中文: 大团长说代价付清之前不会有日出。她错了。我去把它找了回来。

English: Half the Accord drank at my tavern the night before. The Grandmaster paid for every round. I thought it was generous. It was a goodbye.
简体中文: 那天前夜，半个盟约都在我的酒馆里喝酒。每一轮都是大团长请的。我以为她很大方。那是在道别。

English: I signed the bargain as a witness. The mask is so the Hollow can't match my face to my name on it.
简体中文: 我以见证人的身份签了那份交易。戴面具是为了不让空洞把我的脸和上面的名字对上。

English: My last contract came from inside the Accord: remove a ranger who had left her post. I didn't. Vaelith owes me one.
简体中文: 我的最后一单来自盟约内部：除掉一名擅离职守的游侠。我没下手。Vaelith欠我一个人情。

English: The key I stole opened a rift, yes. It was the Grandmaster's key. I'm told that matters.
简体中文: 我偷的钥匙确实打开了一道裂隙。那是大团长的钥匙。听说这很重要。

English: We were to ferry the last guild to its post across the Marches. The water rose too fast. I kept the coat. I kept the list of names too.
简体中文: 我们本该载着最后一个公会穿过沼泽前往岗位。水涨得太快了。外套我留着。名单我也留着。

English: The Accord's healers poisoned nobody, whatever the songs say. They gave the posts something to sleep. I still have the recipe.
简体中文: 不管歌谣怎么唱，盟约的医者没毒害任何人。他们给了驻守者让人沉睡的东西。配方我还留着。

English: %s beat us once. They're gone. You're not.
简体中文: %s曾经打败过我们。他们已经不在了。你们还在。

English: We remember %s. We'll remember you too, for a shorter while.
简体中文: 我们记得%s。我们也会记得你们，只是时间短些。

English: The Royal Charter hung in %s's hall. It'll hang in ours this time.
简体中文: 王室特许状曾挂在%s的大厅里。这次它会挂在我们的大厅。

English: %s haven't forgotten %s, who beat them to the Royal Charter. They'll race you harder, and beating them again is worth %d Laurels.
简体中文: %s没有忘记抢先拿下王室特许状的%s。他们会更拼命地与你竞赛，再次击败他们可得%d桂冠。
让两个世界都保持敞开

English: Keep three oaths in one guild
简体中文: 在一个公会中守住三项誓言

English: Old contacts: two Rank C recruits waiting
简体中文: 旧日人脉：两名阶级C新兵在等候

English: Veteran start: Act I already done
简体中文: 老兵开局：第一幕已完成

English: The Clerk's Copy: two ledger pages already found
简体中文: 书记员的副本：已找到两页账簿

English: Pip's Key: choose your rifts' region until Act III is done
简体中文: Pip的钥匙：在第三幕完成前自选裂隙地区

English: Once Rank %s with %s: %d rifts sealed, %d foes felled.
简体中文: 曾为阶级%s，效力于%s：封印%d个裂隙，击倒%d个敌人。

English: Took the forty-first post for %s, and held it.
简体中文: 为%s接下了第四十一个岗位，并守住了它。

English: Different crest on the banner. Same work. I sealed %d rifts with %s; I can manage a few more.
简体中文: 旗帜上的纹章不同了。活儿一样。我封印过%d个裂隙，那时效力于%s；再多几个也没问题。

English: Tell Hesper I kept count. %d rifts with %s, and every one of them stayed shut.
简体中文: 告诉Hesper我一直在数。%d个裂隙，和%s一起，每一个都关得严严实实。

English: The light was very quiet. I kept thinking about payday at %s, of all things. %d rifts, and I still miss the pay table.
简体中文: 光非常安静。我一直在想%s的发薪日，偏偏是这个。%d个裂隙，我还是怀念那张发薪桌。

English: Every year someone from %s climbed down to tell me how the harvest went. I'd like to hear it up close for once.
简体中文: 每年都会有个%s的人爬下来告诉我收成如何。我想有一次能当面听听。

English: Relic ward: survive a wipe at 8% HP
简体中文: 遗物守护：团灭时以8%生命幸存

English: +15% chance to counter-attack when evading or taking a heavy hit
简体中文: 闪避或受到重击时反击几率+15%

English: +25% chance to gain 1 Momentum when evading or hit hard
简体中文: 闪避或受重击时获得1点气势的几率+25%

English: On a kill, shields the lowest-HP ally for 20% of their max HP
简体中文: 击杀时，为生命最低的盟友提供其最大生命20%的护盾

English: The tear in the world seals over.
Quiet returns to the floor you just cleared.
简体中文: 你刚清理的这一层恢复了安静。

English: The world holds a little longer.
Nobody will thank you for it.
One less wound in the Rift's hide.
简体中文: 裂隙的皮上少了一道伤口。

English: You were in and out before the rift even noticed.
简体中文: 裂隙还没察觉，你们就进出完毕了。

English: No wasted swings, no wasted time.
简体中文: 没有一招白费，没有一刻虚度。

English: The Rift barely had a chance to answer.
The Rift barely had time to react.
Some fights end before they really begin.
简体中文: 有些战斗还没真正开始就结束了。

English: Not every victory needs to be hard-won.
简体中文: 不是每场胜利都得来不易。

English: It fought like it knew what was coming.
简体中文: 它打起来像是知道会发生什么。

English: Whatever it was guarding, it isn't guarding anymore.
简体中文: 不管它守着什么，现在都不再守了。

English: The floor goes quiet where it used to stand.
简体中文: 它曾站立的地方安静下来。

English: The rift itself feels smaller for it.
简体中文: 裂隙本身似乎也因此变小了。

English: The guild adds one more name to the list.
简体中文: 公会的名单上又添了一个名字。

English: Some things don't come back from a fight like that.
简体中文: 有些东西经过那样一场战斗就回不来了。

English: Stronger than the rest, and still not strong enough.
简体中文: 比其他的都强，却还是不够强。

English: It made you work for it.
简体中文: 它让你们费了一番功夫。

English: A cut above the usual — until it wasn't.
简体中文: 比寻常的高出一截——直到不再是。

English: The Rift saves its better monsters for later. This one came early.
简体中文: 裂隙会把更好的怪物留到后面。这一只来早了。

English: That's the difference between elite and dead.
简体中文: 这就是精英和死物的区别。

English: The rest of the floor felt easier after that.
简体中文: 那之后这一层的其余部分感觉轻松多了。

English: It won't be the last one like it.
简体中文: 它不会是最后一只这样的。
他们身上有什么改变了。

English: They walked out different than they walked in.
简体中文: 他们走出来时，已不是走进去时的样子。

English: Whatever they were before, it isn't enough anymore.
简体中文: 不管他们以前是什么，现在都不够了。

English: Growth has a cost, and they just paid it.
简体中文: 成长有代价，他们刚刚付过。

English: Not every change happens by choice — but this one did.
简体中文: 不是每次改变都出于选择——但这一次是。

English: Something in the wreckage doesn't belong to this floor at all.
简体中文: 残骸中有样东西根本不属于这一层。

English: The rift doesn't usually give things like this away.
简体中文: 裂隙通常不会把这种东西拱手送出。

English: Buried under the ordinary, something extraordinary.
简体中文: 平凡之下，埋着不凡之物。

English: Not every rift hides a find like this.
简体中文: 不是每个裂隙都藏着这样的发现。

English: Luck, or the Rift wanted rid of it.
简体中文: 是运气，还是裂隙想甩掉它。

English: The guild will be talking about this one.
简体中文: 公会会议论这件事很久。

English: Worth every wound it took to find it.
简体中文: 为找到它受的每道伤都值得。

English: Some things are worth the risk of coming back for.
简体中文: 有些东西值得冒险回来取。

English: A name, a crest, and nothing else yet.
简体中文: 一个名字，一面纹章，暂时别无其他。

English: Every guild starts as an empty ledger.
简体中文: 每个公会都始于一本空白的账簿。

English: The banner goes up before anyone's earned it.
简体中文: 旗帜在任何人配得上之前就已升起。

English: The Rift doesn't care how you began, only how you end.
简体中文: 裂隙不在乎你怎么开始，只在乎你怎么结束。

English: Everything after this gets written the hard way.
简体中文: 此后的一切都得靠硬拼写就。

English: Whatever comes next, it starts here.
简体中文: 无论接下来是什么，都从这里开始。

English: Some wounds don't close all the way.
简体中文: 有些伤口永远不会完全愈合。

English: Not every scar shows on the skin.
简体中文: 不是每道伤疤都显在皮肤上。

English: The fight is over. The fear isn't.
A price paid for coming back at all.
简体中文: 能回来本身就付出了代价。

English: The rift takes more than HP sometimes.
简体中文: 裂隙有时夺走的不只是生命。

English: Not every cost gets fully repaid.
简体中文: 不是每份代价都能完全偿还。

English: The Rift Hall's third gate finally answers.
简体中文: 裂隙大厅的第三道门终于有了回应。

English: With Vaelith's Breach sealed, the chains on the old gateway snap loose.
简体中文: Vaelith的裂口封印后，旧门上的锁链崩开了。

English: The rubble in the doorway stops mattering.
简体中文: 门口的瓦砾不再碍事了。

English: Something the guild wasn't ready for, until now it is.
简体中文: 公会之前还没准备好面对的东西，如今准备好了。

English: Whatever's behind it, the guild has earned the right to find out.
简体中文: 不管门后是什么，公会都已赢得了一探究竟的资格。

English: Not every gate opens with a key. Some just need proof.
简体中文: 不是每扇门都用钥匙打开。有些只需要证明。

English: The easy floors are behind you now.
简体中文: 容易的层已经在你身后了。

English: Other guilds have started asking who you are.
简体中文: 其他公会开始打听你们是谁。

English: The name on the banner starts to mean something.
简体中文: 旗帜上的名字开始有分量了。

English: Renown is its own kind of currency.
简体中文: 声望本身就是一种货币。

English: The guild's name means something now.
简体中文: 公会的名字如今有了分量。

English: Not everyone gets to hear it and stay calm.
简体中文: 不是每个人听到它都能保持镇定。

English: Whatever you're building, people have noticed.
简体中文: 不管你在建造什么，人们都注意到了。

English: Growth like this doesn't go unnoticed for long.
简体中文: 这样的成长很快就会引人注目。

English: bonus damage on the party's opening round of every fight
简体中文: 每场战斗中小队开场回合的额外伤害

English: damage that keeps growing every round the fight goes on
简体中文: 战斗每多进行一回合就持续增长的伤害

English: cuts the damage rift hazards (traps, fog, lava) deal to the party
简体中文: 降低裂隙险境（陷阱、迷雾、熔岩）对小队造成的伤害

English: chance to avoid a monster's attack completely
简体中文: 完全躲开怪物攻击的几率

English: the party heals a share of its HP at the end of every round
简体中文: 小队在每回合结束时回复一部分生命

English: once per rift, the last hero standing survives a killing blow
简体中文: 每个裂隙一次，最后站着的英雄能在致命一击下幸存

English: step in front of an attack aimed at a wounded ally
简体中文: 挺身挡下瞄准负伤盟友的攻击

English: strike back at the attacker after dodging or taking a heavy hit
简体中文: 闪避或受到重击后反击攻击者

English: instantly defeats a foe your hit leaves below the threshold
简体中文: 立即击败被你打到阈值以下的敌人

English: the hero immediately takes another turn, once per round
简体中文: 该英雄立即再行动一次，每回合一次

English: absorbs incoming damage before HP is lost
简体中文: 在损失生命之前吸收伤害

English: everyone acts in Speed order each round; first/last means this round's order
简体中文: 每回合所有人按速度顺序行动；首个/最后指本回合的顺序

English: sets turn order each round, faster acts earlier
简体中文: 决定每回合的行动顺序，越快越先行动

English: the front row draws about 3x as many monster attacks as the back row
简体中文: 前排吸引的怪物攻击约为后排的3倍

English: win fast: first-strike, speed and round-one bursts
简体中文: 速战速决：先手、速度和首回合爆发

English: win long fights: bonuses that grow with every round
简体中文: 赢下持久战：随回合增长的加成

English: keep the party standing: HP, hazard/wipe guard, intercepts
简体中文: 让小队屹立不倒：生命、险境/团灭防护、拦截

English: avoid hits: dodge and punishing counters
简体中文: 躲开攻击：闪避与惩戒性反击
比对手撑得更久：回复、吸血和护盾

English: finish things: raw damage, executes, boss killing
简体中文: 了结一切：纯粹伤害、终结、击杀首领

English: +2% damage and +1.5% HP per point above 5
+2% speed, +1.5% dodge and +2% first-strike per point above 5
简体中文: 高于5的每点：速度+2%，闪避+1.5%，先手伤害+2%

English: +4% ability power and +0.2% mend per point above 5
简体中文: 高于5的每点：技能强度+4%，回复+0.2%

English: Heals an ally 35% of max HP and cleanses burn, poison, chill, stun and curses.
简体中文: 为一名盟友回复其最大生命35%的生命，并净化燃烧、中毒、冻寒、眩晕和诅咒。

English: Wards an ally for 30% of their max HP.
简体中文: 为一名盟友提供其最大生命30%的守护。

English: Fresh off the recruiting table, with a borrowed sword and big plans.
简体中文: 刚从招募桌前过来，拿着借来的剑，怀着远大的计划。

English: Good with a bow, better with a trail, untested in a rift.
简体中文: 弓使得不错，追踪更好，还没在裂隙里经受过考验。

English: Knows enough spells to be dangerous, mostly to foes.
简体中文: 会的法术足以构成危险，主要是对敌人。

English: Carries a prayer book and a bag of bandages, in that order.
简体中文: 带着一本祈祷书和一包绷带，顺序如此。

English: Light on their feet and lighter-fingered; nobody asks too closely.
简体中文: 脚步轻盈，手脚更轻；没人会追问太多。

English: A guild recruit swinging a borrowed blade.
简体中文: 挥舞着借来兵刃的公会新兵。

English: Slow, sturdy, and hard to put down.
Wins the exchange before it starts.
简体中文: 交锋还没开始就已经赢了。
视护甲为对自己的侮辱。
裂隙锻造的板甲，坑坑洼洼，毫不在意。

English: Trades wounds and wins the trade.
Has died before. Didn't care for it.
The Rift answers to almost nothing. Almost.
简体中文: 裂隙几乎不听命于任何东西。几乎。
在挥砍间隙为小队包扎。

English: First through the door, first to swing.
简体中文: 第一个进门，第一个出手。

English: The cold never bothered the plate much.
简体中文: 寒冷从来不怎么困扰板甲。
越来越愤怒，而不是越来越慢。

English: The last thing standing, on principle.
Meets the charge before it lands.
简体中文: 在冲锋落地之前迎上去。

English: Puts the first crack in anything.
简体中文: 在任何东西上砸开第一道裂缝。

English: Sets more snares than the Rift can spring.
简体中文: 设的陷阱比裂隙能触发的还多。

English: Improvises a weapon out of whatever's at hand.
简体中文: 随手拿起什么都能当武器。

English: Already knows where the floor gives way.
简体中文: 早就知道哪里的地面会塌。

English: One arrow. Rarely needs a second.
简体中文: 一支箭。很少需要第二支。

English: The opening strike is the whole performance.
简体中文: 开场一击就是整场表演。

English: Has walked through worse hallways than this.
Follows the lightning instead of waiting for thunder.
简体中文: 追着闪电跑，而不是等雷声。

English: Reads a hallway before it reads back.
简体中文: 在走廊读懂它之前先读懂走廊。

English: Sets the trap the Rift walks into instead.
简体中文: 设下让裂隙自己走进去的陷阱。

English: Half-stepped out of the fight before it began.
简体中文: 战斗开始前就已半步抽身。

English: Tracks by scent when the light gives out.
Knows exactly where to put an arrow.
简体中文: 确切知道箭该射向哪里。

English: Watches the dark so the party doesn't have to.
Field dressings from whatever's growing nearby.
简体中文: 用附近长着的东西就地包扎。

English: Gone before the echo catches up.
简体中文: 回声追上之前就已消失。

English: The wind carries the first shot true.
Finds the one seam every ward has.
简体中文: 找到每道守护都有的那条缝。

English: Every shadow in the Rift owes her an arrow.
简体中文: 裂隙里的每道阴影都欠她一箭。

English: Still learning to hold a spark steady.
简体中文: 还在学着稳住一点火花。

English: Sees the trap a half-second before it triggers.
简体中文: 在陷阱触发前半秒就看见了它。

English: Every spell warms up the next.
简体中文: 每个法术都为下一个预热。

English: Studies the Rift's cold so it can't study back.
简体中文: 研究裂隙的寒冷，好让它没法反过来研究自己。

English: Weaves a ward faster than the Rift can break it.
简体中文: 编织守护的速度比裂隙打破它还快。

English: Calls down more with every passing second.
The Rift itself seems to lean away.
简体中文: 连裂隙本身都似乎要躲开。

English: Opens every Warden's door with thunder.
简体中文: 以雷霆敲开每位守卫的大门。

English: No name holds it. No floor stops it.
简体中文: 没有名字能束缚它。没有一层能阻挡它。

English: Grows a ward out of nothing but will.
简体中文: 仅凭意志就能长出一道守护。

English: The first spell is always the quiet one.
简体中文: 第一个法术总是最安静的那个。

English: Turns skin to something closer to bark.
Bargains with the dark for one more round.
简体中文: 与黑暗讨价还价，再多换一回合。

English: Reads the future in root and leaf.
Sees the strike land before it's thrown.
简体中文: 攻击还没出手，就看见它落下。
每个方程都以火焰告终。

English: Wards the floor before the Rift finishes forming it.
简体中文: 在裂隙成形之前就为这一层布下守护。

English: Carries a field kit for every wound.
简体中文: 为每种伤口都备有急救包。

English: Swings a censer like it owes him money.
简体中文: 挥舞香炉的架势像是香炉欠他钱。

English: Prays loudly enough to keep the party moving.
简体中文: 祈祷声大到足以让小队继续前进。
主要靠信仰。偶尔靠刀刃。

English: Faster hands than the Rift has wounds to give.
简体中文: 手比裂隙给伤口的速度还快。

English: Carries first light into the deepest floor.
简体中文: 把第一缕晨光带到最深的一层。

English: Swears the party will not fall today.
简体中文: 发誓今天小队不会倒下。

English: Brews faster than the Rift can wound.
Prays with a lit candle, not a cold one.
简体中文: 祈祷时点着蜡烛，而不是熄着的。

English: Keeps the chill out of everyone but herself.
简体中文: 把寒意挡在每个人身外，除了她自己。

English: Blesses the blade before it's needed.
简体中文: 在需要之前就为刀刃祝福。

English: A fire that doesn't go out in the cold.
简体中文: 一团在寒冷中不熄的火。

English: Absolves the Rift of its sins, briefly.
Fasts, prays, and somehow still heals faster.
简体中文: 禁食、祈祷，却不知怎的治疗得更快。

English: The Rift's worst still flinches from her first word.
简体中文: 裂隙最凶恶的东西听到她第一句话仍会退缩。

English: The party has never seen the floor she stood between them and.
简体中文: 她挡住的那一层，小队从未亲眼见过。

English: Knows which puddles not to step in.
Has never once stood and fought fair.
简体中文: 从来没有堂堂正正地站着打过一场。

English: Leaves with more than they came with.
简体中文: 离开时带走的比来时多。

English: Never where the last swing landed.
简体中文: 永远不在上一击落下的地方。

English: The Rift barely notices it was there.
简体中文: 裂隙几乎察觉不到它来过。

English: Gets faster the longer no one catches them.
Strikes from the dark and returns to it.
简体中文: 从黑暗中出击，再回到黑暗。

English: Leaves two footprints and no explanation.
简体中文: 留下两个脚印，不作任何解释。

English: Moves like the space between two heartbeats.
简体中文: 移动起来像两次心跳之间的空隙。

English: Knows every plant the Rift hasn't poisoned yet.
简体中文: 认得每一株裂隙还没毒死的植物。

English: Steals more than coin from a warded vault.
简体中文: 从受守护的金库里偷走的不只是钱币。

English: Tougher than a rogue has any right to be.
简体中文: 比盗贼应有的样子结实得多。

English: Reads a ward's seams like a lockpick reads a door.
简体中文: 读守护的缝隙，就像开锁器读门。

English: The undergrowth hides more than it seems to.
简体中文: 灌木丛藏着的比看上去更多。

English: Steps half out of reality when it matters.
简体中文: 关键时刻半步踏出现实。

English: Every strike thinner than the last, and faster.
简体中文: 每一击都比上一击更薄，也更快。

English: Already struck before the boss noticed it arrive.
简体中文: 首领还没察觉它到来，就已出手。

English: Nothing has landed a hit since the Rift learned her name.
简体中文: 自从裂隙得知她的名字，就再没有东西击中过她。

English: Heals the wielder for 25% of the damage they deal each round they attack. -15% hazard severity guard.
简体中文: 每回合攻击时，回复造成伤害25%的生命。险境防护-15%。

English: Instantly finishes a foe this hero's attack would drop below 15% HP. -10% damage otherwise.
简体中文: 若该英雄的攻击会使敌人生命低于15%，立即将其终结。否则伤害-10%。

English: The lower this hero's HP, up to +30% dodge chance near death. -10% dodge chance at full HP.
简体中文: 该英雄生命越低，闪避越高，濒死时最多+30%。满血时闪避几率-10%。

English: Whenever the party mends, also shields the lowest-HP ally for 15% of their max HP. -15% damage. Cleric only.
简体中文: 小队每次回复时，同时为生命最低的盟友提供其最大生命15%的护盾。伤害-15%。仅限牧师。

English: On a kill, this hero immediately acts again (once per round). -10% HP.
简体中文: 击杀时，该英雄立即再次行动（每回合一次）。生命-10%。

English: +2% damage for every point of Speed above 10. -8% HP.
简体中文: 速度每高于10一点，伤害+2%。生命-8%。

English: +50% damage when this hero is the last in the round to act. -40% Speed.
简体中文: 该英雄在回合中最后行动时伤害+50%。速度-40%。

English: +40% damage when this hero acts first in the round. -8% HP.
简体中文: 该英雄在回合中首个行动时伤害+40%。生命-8%。

English: 60% chance to step in front of a blow aimed at an ally below half HP. -10% dodge chance.
简体中文: 60%几率挺身挡下瞄准生命低于一半盟友的攻击。闪避几率-10%。

English: +45% damage while this hero is below 35% HP. -10% HP.
简体中文: 该英雄生命低于35%时伤害+45%。生命-10%。

English: 60% chance to cool every Ability by 1 round when this hero dodges or takes a heavy hit. -8% damage.
简体中文: 该英雄闪避或受到重击时，60%几率使所有技能冷却减少1回合。伤害-8%。

English: +40% damage in Boss fights. -10% first-strike damage.
简体中文: 首领战中伤害+40%。先手伤害-10%。

English: Each round: 50% chance the party's damage is doubled, 50% chance it's halved.
简体中文: 每回合：50%几率小队伤害翻倍，50%几率减半。

English: +damage the more wounded the party collectively is, up to +30% at the brink of death. -10% hazard severity guard.
简体中文: 小队整体伤势越重伤害越高，濒死时最多+30%。险境防护-10%。

English: +25% team damage, but only while every living hero shares the same role.
简体中文: 全队伤害+25%，但仅在所有存活英雄职业相同时生效。

English: +2% dmg/round (stacking) on its own. Paired with Ashes of the Fallen, that relic's desperation bonus doubles.
简体中文: 单独装备时每回合伤害+2%（可叠加）。与逝者之灰搭配时，该遗物的绝境加成翻倍。

English: Once per rift, when the whole party falls, everyone rises again at 30% HP.
简体中文: 每个裂隙一次，全队倒下时，所有人以30%生命重新站起。

English: The Champion's Call can be used twice per rift.
简体中文: 勇者的号令每个裂隙可使用两次。

English: +35% team damage, but the party never mends between rounds.
简体中文: 全队伤害+35%，但小队在回合之间不会回复。

English: Quests pay 50% more Gold and Essence. +5% odds toward Rare/Epic loot.
简体中文: 任务报酬的金币和精华增加50%。稀有/史诗战利品几率+5%。

English: Carrying a downed hero out of a rift costs no day. Mends 2% HP/round.
简体中文: 把倒下的英雄抬出裂隙不消耗天数。每回合回复2%生命。

English: Foes can't act in the first round of a fight. -15% first-strike damage.
简体中文: 战斗第一回合敌人无法行动。先手伤害-15%。

English: Copies every special of your best other equipped relic.
简体中文: 复制你已装备的其他最佳遗物的所有特效。

English: Every third round, lightning strikes every foe for 60% of the party's damage.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，闪电打击所有敌人，造成小队伤害60%的伤害。

English: +5% team damage for each different element among your standing heroes.
简体中文: 站立的英雄中每有一种不同元素，全队伤害+5%。

English: Guardian takes 40% of the blows aimed at the back row (was 25%), but Shieldwall heroes take 10% more from blows aimed at them.
简体中文: 护卫承受瞄准后排攻击的40%（原为25%），但盾墙英雄受到针对自己的攻击时伤害提高10%。

English: When the Guardian takes a share of a blow: +1 Momentum, once a round.
简体中文: 护卫分担攻击时：+1气势，每回合一次。

English: Bloodrage climbs to +60% damage (was +40%), but Bloodrage heroes heal half as much.
简体中文: 血怒最高提升至伤害+60%（原为+40%），但血怒英雄受到的治疗减半。

English: Below 30% HP, a Bloodrage hero's hits ignore armour and wards.
简体中文: 生命低于30%时，血怒英雄的攻击无视护甲和守护。
连携层数上限提高两层。

English: At 4 Combo, hits on the same foe ignore armour and wards.
简体中文: 连携达到4层时，对同一敌人的攻击无视护甲和守护。

English: Steady Aim shrugs off the first hit each fight.
简体中文: 每场战斗中，稳定瞄准不受第一次受击影响。

English: Steady Aim gives +55% from the back row (was +35%).
简体中文: 稳定瞄准在后排提供+55%（原为+35%）。

English: In round 1 the snares take two foes.
简体中文: 第1回合陷阱可缚住两个敌人。

English: Snared foes take 15% more damage from everyone.
简体中文: 被缚的敌人受到所有人的伤害提高15%。

English: When a marked foe falls, the Mark jumps to the next foe.
简体中文: 被标记的敌人倒下时，印记转移到下一个敌人。

English: The party deals +25% to a marked foe (was +15%).
简体中文: 小队对被标记敌人的伤害+25%（原为+15%）。

English: Evocation heroes start every fight with 2 Heat.
简体中文: 唤焰英雄每场战斗开始时拥有2层热量。

English: Ward Weave covers the two most-hurt allies.
简体中文: 守护编织覆盖伤势最重的两名盟友。

English: Ward Weave wards 12% of max HP (was 8%).
简体中文: 守护编织提供最大生命12%的守护（原为8%）。

English: Foresight cancels one more heavy blow each fight.
简体中文: 先见每场战斗多抵消一次重击。

English: A blow cancelled by Foresight gives +2 Momentum.
简体中文: 被先见抵消的攻击提供+2气势。

English: Overflow turns all overheal into a ward (was half), but all healing is 10% weaker.
简体中文: 溢流将全部过量治疗转为守护（原为一半），但所有治疗效果降低10%。

English: A Miracle raises the fallen with 15% more HP.
简体中文: 奇迹复活倒下者时生命多15%。
