English: Sanctuary cuts damage to the party by 9% (was 6%).
简体中文: 庇护所使小队受到的伤害降低9%（原为6%）。

English: With an Aegis hero in the party, hazards deal 25% less.
简体中文: 小队中有圣盾英雄时，险境伤害降低25%。

English: Fervor heals 35% of damage dealt (was 25%), but Zeal heroes take 10% more damage.
简体中文: 热忱回复造成伤害35%的生命（原为25%），但狂热英雄受到的伤害提高10%。

English: A Zeal hero's kill gives +1 Momentum.

简体中文: 终结在生命低于45%时生效（原为35%）。

English: The first Assassin kill each fight restores 1 Resolve.
简体中文: 每场战斗中刺客的首次击杀恢复1点决心。

English: Evasion gives +25% dodge (was +15%), but a Skirmisher who is hit takes 10% more.
简体中文: 规避提供+25%闪避（原为+15%），但游斗者被击中时伤害提高10%。
闪避后的反刺伤害提高60%。
好斗回复造成伤害25%的生命（原为15%）。

English: Scrappy's patch-up works in the back row too.
简体中文: 好斗的包扎在后排也能生效。

English: Every third round, a nova hits every foe for 40% of your damage.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，新星打击所有敌人，造成你伤害40%的伤害。

English: Every third round, shields the whole party for 15% of max HP.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，为全队提供其最大生命15%的护盾。

English: Relic ward: once a fight, survive a wipe at 35% HP.
简体中文: 遗物守护：每场战斗一次，团灭时以35%生命幸存。

English: +30% chance to counter when evading or hit hard.
简体中文: 闪避或受重击时反击几率+30%。

English: Every third round, fire strikes every foe for 80% of the party's damage.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，火焰打击所有敌人，造成小队伤害80%的伤害。

English: +5% damage every round (stacking), and every third round a starfall hits every foe for 100% of the party's damage.
简体中文: 每回合伤害+5%（可叠加），且每隔三回合星落打击所有敌人，造成小队伤害100%的伤害。

English: Vaelith's squad took four posts in a row at Thornwood.
简体中文: Vaelith的小队在荆棘林连续拿下了四个岗位。

English: Rangers' tags turn up in the Vale's rifts.
简体中文: 游侠的身份牌出现在山谷的裂隙中。

English: Vaelith didn't desert. She heard children behind her door.
简体中文: Vaelith并没有当逃兵。她听见门后有孩子。

English: Someone who knew Vaelith might say what she was listening for.
简体中文: 认识Vaelith的人或许能说出她在听什么。

English: At Act I's finale, a guild can let Vaelith go.
简体中文: 在第一幕终章，公会可以放Vaelith离开。

English: The great Breach is the door Vaelith held open, and she is still in it.
简体中文: 那道巨大的裂口就是Vaelith撑开的门，她至今仍在其中。

English: A guild that let Vaelith go would know where she went.
简体中文: 放Vaelith离开的公会会知道她去了哪里。

English: Vaelith's Rangers joins the founding charters.
简体中文: Vaelith的游侠团加入创建特许状。

English: Hesper wrote the Terms out fair. She knew every word.
简体中文: Hesper亲手誊清了条款。她知道每一个字。

English: Hesper's handwriting is in more places than she admits.
简体中文: Hesper的笔迹出现的地方比她承认的更多。

English: There was no fever. Hesper wrote the note herself, and ran.
简体中文: 根本没有热病。那张字条是Hesper自己写的，然后她逃了。

English: Ask who nursed Hesper that week.
简体中文: 去问问那一周是谁在照料Hesper。

English: The Grandmaster let Hesper go, and left the forty-second line blank for her.
简体中文: 大团长放走了Hesper，并为她留空了第四十二行。

English: The Grandmaster's own hall remembers who it waited for.
简体中文: 大团长自己的大厅记得它在等谁。

English: At the Renew ending, Hesper can sign the forty-first line herself. The Clerk's Copy joins the founding gifts.
简体中文: 在续订结局中，Hesper可以亲自签下第四十一行。书记员的副本加入创建赠礼。

English: The Accord's key opens any door, from either side.
简体中文: 盟约的钥匙能从任意一边打开任何门。

English: Whoever holds Morrow's key could say what it opens.
简体中文: 持有Morrow钥匙的人能说出它打开什么。

English: Whoever holds the key may keep it or break it. Pip's Key joins the founding gifts.
简体中文: 持有钥匙的人可以保留或折断它。Pip的钥匙加入创建赠礼。

English: Pip stole the key from the Warden of Rifts, a royal officer.
简体中文: Pip是从裂隙守卫官——一位王室官员——那里偷走钥匙的。

English: Someone in a fine hat is missing a key.
简体中文: 某个戴着华丽帽子的人丢了一把钥匙。

English: At the Crown's hearing, a guild that's losing can buy the Charter.
简体中文: 在王冠的听证会上，落后的公会可以买下特许状。

English: The Royal Treasury pays the Hollow Crown Company to open rifts.
简体中文: 王室国库付钱让空洞王冠佣兵团打开裂隙。

English: Follow the money behind the Company's contracts.
简体中文: 追查佣兵团契约背后的钱。

English: In the Charter War, a guild can turn Morrow instead.
简体中文: 在特许状之争中，公会也可以策反Morrow。

English: Ezra was the Ninth Lamp's last apprentice. He was below, measuring, on the Night.
简体中文: Ezra是第九盏灯的最后一名学徒。那一夜，他在下面测量。

English: Ezra's lantern has a maker's mark.
简体中文: Ezra的灯笼上有制作者的印记。

English: Ezra's lantern holds what the rifts took, from both sides.
简体中文: Ezra的灯笼装着裂隙从两边夺走的东西。

English: Ask what Ezra keeps in the lantern, and whose voices are in it.
简体中文: 问问Ezra灯笼里装着什么，里面是谁的声音。

English: When Ezra visits, a guild can pour its kept echoes into the lantern.
简体中文: Ezra来访时，公会可以把保留的回响注入灯笼。

English: Essence is the far side's sky. Every crystal burned is a piece of it falling.
简体中文: 精华是彼岸的天空。每烧掉一块晶体，就有一片天空坠落。

English: The Ninth Lamp measured something the Crown wanted kept quiet.
简体中文: 第九盏灯测量了王冠想要掩盖的东西。

English: The Ninth Lamp joins the founding charters.
简体中文: 第九盏灯加入创建特许状。

English: The Last Lantern is the Ninth Lamp's sister hall. Mother Ilse has known all along.
简体中文: 末灯会是第九盏灯的姊妹会堂。Ilse嬷嬷一直都知道。

English: Mother Ilse signs her letters with more than her name.
简体中文: Ilse嬷嬷的信上签的不只是她的名字。

English: The Terms were the Grandmaster's own. The ledger's "voice that offered terms" was a lie.
简体中文: 条款是大团长自己的。账簿上那句"提出条款的声音"是谎言。

English: Read the ledger's third day beside the reply on its last page.
简体中文: 把账簿第三天的记录与最后一页的回信对照着读。

English: With the right guild in the Hall, a sixth crossing comes to the door.
简体中文: 大厅中有合适的公会时，第六次越界会来到门前。

English: The Night of Breaking was the far side knocking on every door at once.
简体中文: 破碎之夜是彼岸同时敲响了每一扇门。

English: Ask the ones who came through what they remember of that night.
简体中文: 问问那些穿越过来的人，他们记得那一夜的什么。

English: When the Choir crosses, a guild can let them sing.
简体中文: 圣咏团越界时，公会可以让他们歌唱。

English: Brannoch holds the door under the Inverted City, and promised a child he'd come back.
简体中文: Brannoch守着倒悬之城下的门，并答应过一个孩子他会回来。

English: Somebody once measured a child's height on a deep pillar.
简体中文: 曾有人在一根深处的石柱上为一个孩子量身高。

English: At Act VI's start, a guild can leave Brannoch holding, or free him.
简体中文: 第六幕开始时，公会可以让Brannoch继续坚守，或解放他。

English: A rewrite reaches both sides: the far side holds its doors in turns too.
简体中文: 改写会传到两边：彼岸也轮流守着他们的门。

English: A guild that rewrote the Terms, or kept both worlds, would know.
简体中文: 改写过条款或保全了两个世界的公会会知道。

English: The Iron Chorus marched for the Crown on the Night of Breaking, not for the Vale.
简体中文: 破碎之夜，钢铁合唱团是为王冠而进军，不是为了山谷。

English: The Iron Chorus is proud of an old order.
简体中文: 钢铁合唱团以一道旧命令为荣。

English: A year of witnesses can come round.
简体中文: 见证者之年可能会轮到。

English: The Ashen Wolves served the Ashen Crown, and fed it.
简体中文: 灰烬狼群效忠灰烬王冠，并供养着它。

English: Ask what the wolves did after the Night.
简体中文: 问问那些狼在破碎之夜之后做了什么。

English: The first signature on the Terms is the Crown's seal.
简体中文: 条款上的第一个签名是王冠的印章。

English: Someone on the far side kept the first page.
简体中文: 彼岸有人保留着第一页。

English: Accord ranger's tag, Thornwood post. "Corin" stamped on the front. On the back, in someone else's knife-work: "V. said wait. I waited."
简体中文: 盟约游侠的身份牌，荆棘林岗位。正面刻着"Corin"。背面是另一个人用刀刻的："V.说等着。我等了。"

English: Accord ranger's tag, Thornwood post: "Mags". Something chewed one corner and gave up. Scratched under the name, in the same hand as Corin's: "Third in line. V. fourth."
简体中文: 盟约游侠的身份牌，荆棘林岗位："Mags"。有东西啃过一角，又放弃了。名字下面刻着字，笔迹和Corin那块一样："排第三。V.第四。"

English: Wen copies the ranger's face before the crystal goes home. On the collar, too small for the elder to notice, is a squad mark: a V with four notches.
简体中文: 在晶体送回家之前，Wen临摹下了那名游侠的脸。衣领上有个小到长者注意不到的小队标记：一个V，带四道刻痕。

English: Wen's note for the Bestiary: twice in the fight Vaelith stopped, turned her head to the Breach, and listened. Not to us. To something small behind it.
简体中文: Wen为怪物图鉴写的笔记：战斗中Vaelith两次停下，把头转向裂口，侧耳倾听。不是在听我们。是在听裂口后面某个小小的东西。

English: Vaelith asked me once if doors had two sides.
简体中文: Vaelith有一次问我，门是不是有两面。

English: That rifts don't. She looked at me like I'd failed a test I didn't know I was taking.
简体中文: 我说裂隙没有。她看我的眼神，就像我没通过一场我都不知道自己在参加的考试。

English: P.S. Your Vaelith was a deserter, whatever the songs say. She walked off her post toward the noise, not away from it. The Chorus has never decided which was worse.
简体中文: 附：不管歌谣怎么唱，你们的Vaelith就是个逃兵。她离开岗位，朝着声响走去，而不是逃开。合唱团至今没想清楚哪种更糟。

English: Small bare footprints in the frost at the rift's mouth, leading out, not in. They stop at the road, where someone in ranger's boots picked them up.
简体中文: 裂隙口的霜上有一串赤裸的小脚印，向外走，而不是向里。它们在路边停住，有个穿游侠靴子的人在那里接走了它们。

English: A note on the pay table, in ranger shorthand.
简体中文: 发薪桌上有张字条，用游侠速记写的。

English: "Door holding. Four more through. Don't pay me. Feed them."
简体中文: "门守住了。又过来四个。别付我钱。喂饱他们。"

English: The eldest points at your crest, then up at the Vale. "The green lady's door," she says. "She let our cousins through. She said you were kinder than you look."
简体中文: 最年长的那位指了指你的纹章，又抬头指向山谷。"绿衣女士的门，"她说，"她放我们的表亲过来了。她说你们比看上去和善。"

English: Hesper says she was the Grandmaster's clerk, and wrote the Terms out fair: forty-one lines, in her own hand.
简体中文: Hesper说她曾是大团长的书记员，亲手誊清了条款：四十一行，都是她的笔迹。

English: In Quiet Coin's counting room Dobbs finds the Accord's copies of the Terms, all in one neat hand. He holds one up beside this week's wage sheet. Hesper's.
简体中文: 在静默之币的账房里，Dobbs找到了盟约保存的条款副本，全出自同一手工整的笔迹。他拿起一份，与本周的工资单并排对照。是Hesper的。
第二页写着"好好地拒绝它们"。

English: She wrote "proper". She never could spell. I fixed it when I wrote them out fair.
简体中文: 她写的是"的"。她总分不清“的”和“地”。我誊清的时候改过来了。

English: Hesper, your fever note is in green ink.
简体中文: Hesper，你那张热病字条是用绿墨水写的。

English: The Terms are in green ink.
简体中文: 条款也是用绿墨水写的。

English: It was the ink I had.
P.S. My regards to Hesper. I still have the blanket she lent me on the night she was meant to be in bed with a fever. She was never sick a day in her life.
简体中文: 附：代我问候Hesper。她本该发烧卧床的那一晚借给我的毯子，我还留着。她这辈子一天都没病过。

English: The Green Hand wrote down everyone they nursed. The week of the Night of Breaking has eleven names: burns, a broken arm, a midwife's twins. No fevers. Wen closes it gently.
简体中文: 绿手会记下了他们照料过的每个人。破碎之夜那一周有十一个名字：烧伤、一条断臂、一位接生婆的双胞胎。没有热病。Wen轻轻合上了它。

English: Day 11, in a clerk's neat hand: "V. asked who holds the last post. G. said the ledger. After, G. told me to go home with a fever. I said I wasn't ill. She said: you will be, and you'll come back."
简体中文: 第11天，书记员工整的笔迹："V.问谁守最后一个岗位。G.说账簿。之后，G.让我以热病为由回家。我说我没病。她说：你会病的，然后你会回来。"

English: The archive's index lists every copyist by year. For the year of the Terms there is one name, and it has been scratched out so hard the pen went through. The initial is still there: H.
简体中文: 档案索引按年份列出了每位抄写员。条款那一年只有一个名字，被狠狠划掉，笔尖都戳穿了纸。首字母还在：H。

English: Forty-one chairs at the long table, thick with dust. At the end, the clerk's stool is clean, and the inkwell beside it is full. Someone kept it ready for twenty years.
简体中文: 长桌旁四十一把椅子，积着厚厚的灰。桌尾，书记员的凳子却干干净净，旁边的墨水瓶是满的。有人二十年来一直让它备着。

English: Hesper writes the forty-second line without looking at the page. "I had twenty years to practise," she says. "She left it blank for me. I just never came back."
简体中文: Hesper写下第四十二行，看都没看纸面。"我练了二十年，"她说，"她为我留了空白。我只是一直没回来。"

English: Dobbs tries Morrow's key in the rift's door, to lock it. It turns the wrong way, and keeps turning. Something on the other side knocks back, twice, politely.
简体中文: Dobbs把Morrow的钥匙插进裂隙的门里，想把它锁上。钥匙朝错误的方向转，而且一直在转。另一边有什么东西回敲了两下，很有礼貌。

English: I nicked it off a rift-lord. Big hat. Smelled of ink.
简体中文: 我从一个裂隙领主身上顺来的。大帽子。一身墨水味。

English: Last week he smelled of fish.
Long night. He opened three doors with it before I got it off him.
简体中文: 那晚很长。我把钥匙弄到手之前，他已经用它开了三扇门。

English: Wen's note for the Bestiary: the crossbowmen's bolts are tipped with fresh Essence, and fresh means a rift opened this week. Their quartermaster keeps a calendar of rifts opening, which is a strange thing to be able to keep.
简体中文: Wen为怪物图鉴写的笔记：弩手的弩矢尖上涂着新鲜的精华，新鲜意味着本周有裂隙开启。他们的军需官有一份裂隙开启的日历，能有这种东西本身就很奇怪。

English: P.S. My cousin is Warden of the Crown's Rifts, and the Vale is safe in his hands. He did lose a key once, to a girl no taller than a sword. We don't mention it.
简体中文: 附：我的表兄是王冠的裂隙守卫官，山谷在他手中安然无恙。他确实丢过一把钥匙，被一个还没剑高的女孩偷走。我们不提这事。

English: A signet ring from a deep rift: a crowned door, and under it, Warden of Rifts. The inside of the band is worn smooth where a key on a cord used to rub.
简体中文: 一枚来自深处裂隙的印章戒指：一扇戴冠的门，下方刻着“裂隙守卫官”。戒圈内侧有一处被磨得光滑，那是曾经挂在绳上的钥匙摩擦的地方。

English: Dobbs holds the Company's offer up to the window. Under Morrow's seal the paper carries a watermark: a crowned door. "That's not a Company mark," he says. "That's the Warden's."
简体中文: Dobbs把佣兵团的报价举到窗前。Morrow的封印下面，纸上有一道水印：一扇戴冠的门。"这不是佣兵团的标记，"他说，"这是守卫官的。"

English: This time Ilse brings the whole page, not the torn half. Beside the list of rifts and dates is a second column, headed Paid: every amount signed for by the Royal Treasury.
简体中文: 这次Ilse带来的是整页，不是撕下的半张。在裂隙与日期的清单旁还有第二栏，标题是“已付”：每一笔都由王室国库签收。

English: At the foot of Morrow's first generous contract, in very small print: "Disbursed by the Royal Treasury, Office of Rifts." Dobbs reads it three times, then stops reading it.
简体中文: 在Morrow第一份慷慨契约的末尾，用很小的字写着："由王室国库裂隙司拨付。"Dobbs读了三遍，然后不再读了。

English: Morrow, bleeding, looks at your charter and laughs. "Hired swords. Then you know. Someone always pays. The Crown pays me to open them and pays you to close them. Ask who's richer."
简体中文: Morrow流着血，看着你们的特许状大笑。"雇来的刀剑。那你就懂了。总有人付钱。王冠付钱让我打开它们，又付钱让你们关上它们。问问谁更有钱。"

English: As Ezra leaves, Wen asks where the lantern came from. "My Lamp's," he says, then corrects himself. "The Ninth Lamp's. I was their last apprentice. I was below that night, measuring."
简体中文: Ezra离开时，Wen问那盏灯笼是从哪来的。"我灯会的，"他说，接着又改口，"第九盏灯的。我是他们最后一名学徒。那晚我在下面，测量。"

English: The Ninth Lamp's register lists every member. The lamps along the wall light for one name only, the last apprentice taken on: Ezra, aged sixteen, "good with depths".
简体中文: 第九盏灯的名册列出了每一位成员。墙边的灯只为一个名字亮起，最后收下的那名学徒：Ezra，十六岁，"擅长测深"。

English: A notebook of depth readings from the Night of Breaking, each rift measured twice. The last page, in a shaking hand: "Deeper than the Assay. Not a wound. A door. Someone is on the other side of all of them."
简体中文: 一本破碎之夜的测深笔记，每个裂隙都测了两次。最后一页，字迹颤抖："比勘测石所能测量的更深。不是伤口。是一扇门。它们每一扇的另一边都有人。"

English: Kept, the Oath echo plays in the vault at night. The words are the Accord's, but the voice isn't human. When Ezra hears of it, he only says: "Theirs took ours, too."
简体中文: 保留下来的誓言回响夜里在金库中回放。词句是盟约的，但声音不是人类的。Ezra听说后，只说了一句："他们的也夺走了我们的。"

English: Ezra's lantern was on the step again this morning.
简体中文: 今天早上，Ezra的灯笼又出现在台阶上。

English: Full. Hundreds of little lights. Some of them are saying names. Not ours.
简体中文: 满的。几百点小小的光。有些在念名字。不是我们的。

English: Halfway through, the choir sings a name nobody in the Vale knows, then asks after a pale man with a lantern. "He has some of ours," the eldest says. "We would like them back."
简体中文: 唱到一半，圣咏团唱出了一个山谷里无人知晓的名字，接着打听一个提着灯笼的苍白男子。"他拿着我们的一些东西，"最年长的那位说，"我们想要回来。"

English: Under a royal seal, the Ninth Lamp's last finding, a year before the Night: "Essence is not ours. It is their sky, hardening as it falls. Every crystal we burn, we pull down." Stamped across it: Not for circulation.
简体中文: 在王室印章之下，是第九盏灯在破碎之夜前一年的最后发现："精华不属于我们。它是他们的天空，在坠落中凝固。我们每烧掉一块晶体，就拉下一片。"上面盖着戳：不得外传。

English: He turns a crystal of your Essence in his glass fingers. "You burn these for light? Down there we called it weather. It was the part of the sky that rained."
简体中文: 他用玻璃般的手指转动着一块你们的精华晶体。"你们烧这个来照明？在下面我们管它叫天气。是天空会下雨的那部分。"

English: A sodden journal from a Marsh rift, kept by a guild that held the tides: "Every tide follows a good harvest. The more Essence the Vale burns, the harder the Hollow comes up, as if chasing something it lost."
简体中文: 一本来自沼泽裂隙、浸透了水的日志，出自一个守住潮汐的公会："每次潮汐都紧跟着一次丰收。山谷烧的精华越多，空洞涌上来就越猛，像是在追赶它失去的东西。"

English: P.S. Under Ilse's signature, smaller than a fingernail, someone has drawn a lamp with nine flames. The Last Lantern's own mark has one.
简体中文: 附：在Ilse的签名下方，有人画了一盏比指甲还小的灯，灯上九朵火焰。末灯会自己的标记只有一朵。

English: The smugglers' crates came in. I was promised Essence.
简体中文: 走私者的货箱到了。说好的是精华。

English: Lamp oil. Nine casks. Mother Ilse's compliments, and "keep the Lamp lit".
简体中文: 灯油。九桶。Ilse嬷嬷的问候，外加一句"让灯一直亮着"。

English: Mother Ilse is gone before the herald finishes, but she has left something on your table: a brass key to the Ninth Lamp's hall, and a note. "You'll need this one day. I kept it warm."
简体中文: 传令官还没念完，Ilse嬷嬷就走了，但她在你的桌上留下了东西：一把第九盏灯会堂的黄铜钥匙，和一张字条。"总有一天你会用到它。我一直替你捂着。"

English: Wen reads the reply's first words again. "We accept your Terms." Yours. Not theirs. The Grandmaster's ledger says a voice from the deep offered them. Someone is lying, and it isn't the far side.
简体中文: Wen又读了一遍回信的开头。"我们接受你们的条款。"你们的。不是他们的。大团长的账簿上说，是深处的一个声音提出了条款。有人在撒谎，而那不是彼岸。
第三天："一个声音提出了条款。"

English: The last page: "We accept your Terms."
简体中文: 最后一页："我们接受你们的条款。"

English: I have. Nobody wants the last biscuit.
简体中文: 读过了。最后一块饼干没人要。

English: Safe on our side, the eldest asks which of you wrote to them first. "Your Grandmaster's letter. It was very polite. It said: stay where you are."
简体中文: 到了我们这边安全后，最年长的那位问你们当中谁最先给他们写信。"你们大团长的信。非常礼貌。上面写着：待在原地。"

English: She remembers the night every door rang. "We all knocked," she says. "Everyone at once, on every door there was. Somebody told us someone would come."
简体中文: 她记得每扇门都响起的那一夜。"我们都敲了，"她说，"所有人同时敲，敲遍了每一扇门。有人告诉我们会有人来。"

English: A tide-wrack journal on the Glass Coast, from a guild that burned the Terms: "Most of what came up with the tides wasn't hunting. It was running, and looking back."
简体中文: 玻璃海岸上的一本潮汐残骸日志，出自一个烧掉了条款的公会："随潮汐涌上来的大多不是在狩猎。它们在逃，还不断回头张望。"

English: The Choir's song is the Accord's oath, word for word, learned from a guild that came down twenty years ago. They sing it the way the village does now, a little off-key.
简体中文: 圣咏团的歌就是盟约的誓言，一字不差，是从二十年前下来的一个公会那里学来的。他们的唱法和如今村里一样，有点跑调。

English: Hollin's miller remembers the Night of Breaking. Every door in the village knocked at once, from inside the frame, three times. Then the mill wheel turned backwards until morning.
简体中文: Hollin的磨坊主记得破碎之夜。村里每一扇门同时被敲响，从门框里面，三下。然后水车倒着转了一整夜，直到天亮。

English: Day 10, in the clerk's hand: "B. asked for the deepest post, under the city. A child watched from the other side. He told her: wait there, I'll come back for you. G. let him go first."
简体中文: 第10天，书记员的笔迹："B.请求驻守最深的岗位，在那座城之下。一个孩子在另一边看着。他对她说：在那儿等着，我会回来接你。G.让他第一个去。"

English: Knife-marks on a deep pillar's base, a hand's width apart, climbing: a child's height, measured every year. They stop at about the height of a girl of twelve.
简体中文: 深处一根石柱底部的刀痕，相隔一掌宽，逐年往上：一个孩子的身高，每年量一次。刻痕停在约十二岁女孩的高度。

English: After the gate holds, someone knocks from below. Three times, then twice, then three times: the Accord's old signal for relief coming.
简体中文: 大门守住之后，有人从下面敲门。三下，再两下，再三下：盟约传递“换岗将至”的老信号。

English: On the far side of the first door, someone has painted a list on the wall: names and seasons, in turns. Some of the names are ours.
简体中文: 在第一扇门的另一边，有人在墙上画了一份名单：名字与季节，轮流排列。其中一些名字是我们的。

English: The new recruit asked when "our keepers" get paid.
简体中文: 新来的新兵问"我们的守门人"什么时候领薪水。

English: The ones holding their side of the doors. She says they take turns, like ours.
简体中文: 守着门另一边的那些。她说他们轮班，和我们一样。

English: She is older than the Accord's last guild, and she has walked a long way. "Your guilds took turns," she says. "So did we. I held our side of the first door."
简体中文: 她比盟约最后一个公会还要年长，走了很远的路。"你们的公会轮班，"她说，"我们也是。我守着第一扇门我们那一边。"

English: Orla Venn sends the contest prize with a copy of her proudest possession: the Chorus's marching order from the Night of Breaking. It is addressed to the Crown's garrison, not to the Vale.
简体中文: Orla Venn随竞赛奖品附上了她最引以为豪的藏品的副本：合唱团在破碎之夜的进军令。收件方是王冠的驻军，不是山谷。

English: In the Iron Oath's drill yard one row of stones is painted royal blue. The old drillmaster's note: "Chorus recruits stand here. They take their orders from further up."
简体中文: 在钢铁誓约的操练场上，有一排石头被漆成了王室蓝。老教官的字条："合唱团的新兵站这儿。他们听命于更上头的人。"

English: Wen's note for the Bestiary: Sythrane's wolves wore no collars, and never once turned on her. Wolves don't do that for a crown. They do it for whoever feeds them.
简体中文: Wen为怪物图鉴写的笔记：Sythrane的狼没戴项圈，却从未反咬过她。狼不会为了王冠这样做。它们只为喂养它们的人这样做。

English: Kael Ashborn asks for a job, and for once says why. "My wolves fed the Ashen Crown for ten years. Somebody has to feed them now, and it shouldn't be that."
简体中文: Kael Ashborn来找活干，难得说了原因。"我的狼供养了灰烬王冠十年。现在总得有人喂它们，而那不该是王冠。"

English: The First Signatory unfolds a page she has carried for twenty years: the Terms' first line. Above forty signatures, in red wax, is a seal: a crowned door.
简体中文: 首位签署人展开一页她带了二十年的纸：条款的第一行。在四十个签名之上，红色火漆上压着一枚印章：一扇戴冠的门。

English: The Warden's ring. I've seen this seal before.
简体中文: 守卫官的戒指。我以前见过这枚印章。

English: On the Terms. Above every signature.
简体中文: 在条款上。每个签名的上方。

English: Quiet Coin's last ledger: a royal stipend, paid to the Grandmaster every year since the Night of Breaking, "for keeping the doors". It stops the year she fell.
简体中文: 静默之币的最后一本账：一笔王室津贴，自破碎之夜起每年付给大团长，"用于守门"。在她倒下的那一年停止了。

English: A wanderer at the rift's mouth sells copies of a page for a copper each: the Terms' first line, and above it, a crowned seal. Nobody buys one. Dobbs buys three.
简体中文: 裂隙口的一个流浪者兜售某页纸的副本，一铜币一份：条款的第一行，上方是一枚戴冠的印章。没人买。Dobbs买了三份。

English: P.S. My cousin has been recalled to the capital. Something about a seal, a ring, and questions he would rather not answer. The Lance is, of course, above such things.
简体中文: 附：我的表兄已被召回王都。似乎和一枚印章、一枚戒指以及一些他不愿回答的问题有关。长枪团当然超然于这类事之上。

English: A voice from the deepest rift offered terms.
简体中文: 最深的裂隙中有个声音提出了条款。

English: The posts hold the Hollow back.
All the Grandmaster wanted was more time.
简体中文: 大团长想要的只是更多时间。

English: She had a fever on the Night of Breaking, and missed it.
简体中文: 破碎之夜她在发烧，所以错过了。

English: The Grandmaster sent her home to spare her.
简体中文: 大团长送她回家，是为了保全她。

English: She copied the Terms without reading them.
简体中文: 她誊抄条款时没有读过。

English: Marshal Orla Venn, the Iron Chorus
Vaelith was a deserter who doomed her post.
简体中文: Vaelith是个害了自己岗位的逃兵。

English: The Crown saved the Vale by paying for the posts.
简体中文: 王冠出钱维持岗位，拯救了山谷。

English: The Hollow Crown Company opens rifts for profit.
简体中文: 空洞王冠佣兵团为牟利打开裂隙。

English: Someone pays Morrow to do it.
Captain Morrow, the Hollow Crown Company
There is no Hollow, only doors and whoever holds the keys.
简体中文: 没有什么空洞，只有门，和持有钥匙的人。

English: He works for nobody but himself.
Every guild sells rifts; his just keeps receipts.
简体中文: 每个公会都在卖裂隙；他只是留着收据。

English: Ser Aldric Vane, the Gilded Lance
The guilds sold too much Essence, and the Hollow came to collect.
简体中文: 各公会卖了太多精华，空洞来讨债了。

English: His cousin, the Warden of Rifts, keeps the Vale safe.
简体中文: 他的表兄，裂隙守卫官，守护着山谷的安全。

English: The key that opens rifts is a myth.
简体中文: 能打开裂隙的钥匙只是传说。

English: The Hollow is hunger: you feed it or you burn it.
简体中文: 空洞就是饥饿：要么喂它，要么烧了它。

English: The Ashen Crown kept the Vale alive.
简体中文: 灰烬王冠让山谷活了下来。

English: They knocked, everyone at once, on every door.
简体中文: 他们敲了门，所有人同时，敲遍每一扇门。

English: Someone on this side wrote to them first.
简体中文: 这边有人最先给他们写了信。

English: They were promised someone would come back.
简体中文: 他们得到过承诺，会有人回来。

English: P.S. Keep your walls up. The Hollow came for the Vale once, the night the old guilds fell, and it will come again.
简体中文: 附：守好你们的城墙。旧公会陨落的那一夜，空洞来过山谷一次，它还会再来。

English: P.S. Remember who paid for the posts. The Crown kept the Vale alive when the guilds could not. The Chorus remembers.
简体中文: 附：记住是谁为岗位付的钱。公会无能为力时，是王冠让山谷活了下来。合唱团记得。

English: P.S. Whatever they tell you about the old guilds, remember that they were betrayed by the one they trusted most. I knew her.
简体中文: 附：不管他们怎么跟你说那些旧公会，记住，他们是被自己最信任的人背叛的。我认识她。

English: P.S. Watch the Hollow Crown Company. Count the rifts that open on their roads, and the contracts that follow.
简体中文: 附：盯着空洞王冠佣兵团。数一数他们路上开启的裂隙，以及随之而来的契约。

English: P.S. Morrow hasn't the coin to do what he does. Someone pays him. I'm still finding out who.
简体中文: 附：Morrow没那么多钱干他干的事。有人在付钱给他。我还在查是谁。

English: P.S. There's no Hollow, friend. There are doors, and whoever holds the keys. The rest is sermons.
简体中文: 附：朋友，没有什么空洞。只有门，和持有钥匙的人。其余都是布道。

English: P.S. And before you ask: I work for nobody but myself. Ask anyone.
简体中文: 附：在你问之前先说清楚：我只为自己干活。随便问谁。

English: P.S. Every guild sells rifts. Mine just keeps receipts.
简体中文: 附：每个公会都在卖裂隙。我的只是留着收据。

English: P.S. My grandfather said the old guilds sold too much Essence to too many buyers, and the Hollow came to collect. Grandfather was rarely wrong.
简体中文: 附：我祖父说，旧公会把太多精华卖给了太多买家，于是空洞来讨债了。祖父很少出错。

English: P.S. And no, there is no key that opens rifts. That's a story for children and smugglers.
简体中文: 附：还有，没有什么能打开裂隙的钥匙。那是讲给小孩和走私者听的故事。

English: P.S. The Hollow is a mouth. You feed it or you burn it. My wolves know which.
简体中文: 附：空洞是一张嘴。要么喂它，要么烧了它。我的狼知道该选哪个。

English: P.S. Say what you like about the Ashen Crown. For ten years nobody in the ash starved. Count that.
简体中文: 附：随你怎么说灰烬王冠。十年来灰烬之中没有人饿死。记上这一笔。

English: P.S. And my wolves owe nobody. Not the Crown, not the old guilds, not you.
简体中文: 附：而且我的狼不欠任何人。不欠王冠，不欠旧公会，也不欠你。

English: Did you read the Terms, back then?
I copied them. A clerk copies. Reading is for the people who sign.
简体中文: 我誊抄过。书记员负责誊抄。阅读是签字的人的事。

English: Vaelith is down on one knee at the mouth of the Breach. She isn't looking at your heroes. She is listening to something behind it, and you know now what it is.
简体中文: Vaelith单膝跪在裂口前。她没有看你的英雄。她在听裂口后面的某样东西，而你现在知道那是什么了。

English:
Your heroes lower their weapons. Vaelith looks at them for a long moment, then walks back into the Breach on her own feet. At dawn she comes out carrying a child wrapped in her cloak, and does not explain. She asks for work.

(Vaelith joins as a champion. No relic from this finale, and half its Essence.)
简体中文:
你的英雄放下了武器。Vaelith久久地看着他们，然后自己走回了裂口。黎明时分她走了出来，斗篷里裹着一个孩子，什么也没解释。她来找活干。

（Vaelith作为勇者加入。本终章无遗物，精华减半。）

English: The Breach closes behind Vaelith, by her own hand this time. Under her cloak is an Accord badge with the oath scratched out: she was one of them, and she left her post. Whatever the old guilds did that night, she has been undoing it. Greater Rifts are open to your guild.
简体中文: 这一次，裂口在Vaelith身后由她亲手关上。她斗篷下有一枚盟约徽章，誓言已被刮去：她曾是他们中的一员，并离开了岗位。无论旧公会那一夜做了什么，她一直在将其撤销。大型裂隙已向你的公会开放。

English: The Grandmaster's clerk, who wrote the Terms out fair and ran from them. Twenty years later she came back and signed the forty-first line herself, for %s.
简体中文: 大团长的书记员，誊清了条款，又逃离了它们。二十年后她回来了，为%s亲自签下了第四十一行。

English: Tell Wen to keep the books straight. Tell Dobbs the green ink is in the bottom drawer. Tell %s it was my turn.
简体中文: 告诉Wen把账记清楚。告诉Dobbs绿墨水在最下面的抽屉里。告诉%s，轮到我了。

English: Wen finds the last page of the Grandmaster's ledger stuck to the back cover, in a hand neither she nor Dobbs knows. It is a reply. "We accept your Terms. Hold your doors, and we will not come through them. Our sky is falling. We will not ask again." Wen reads it twice and puts on her coat.
简体中文: Wen在大团长账簿的封底内侧发现了粘着的最后一页，笔迹她和Dobbs都不认识。是一封回信。"我们接受你们的条款。守住你们的门，我们就不会穿过它们。我们的天空在坠落。我们不会再问第二次。"Wen读了两遍，穿上了外套。

English: There is a third way. Hesper left the forty-second line open before she signed: rewrite the Terms, and the posts are held in turns. She would come home.
简体中文: 还有第三条路。Hesper在签字之前留空了第四十二行：改写条款，岗位便可轮班坚守。她就能回家了。

English:
Your guild climbs down to the forty-first post with the Terms, and Hesper writes the forty-second line there, in her own hand, because hers is the only one the Terms accept: the posts are held in turns. Then she climbs out with you. The forty in the pillars walk home, and nobody holds the Hollow alone any more.

(Riftbreaks have ended, every champion of this guild is free, Hesper is home, and the old Accord halls can be restored.)
简体中文:
你的公会带着条款下到第四十一号岗位，Hesper在那里亲手写下第四十二行，因为条款只接受她的笔迹：岗位轮班坚守。然后她和你们一起爬了出来。石柱中的四十人走回了家，再也没有人独自挡住空洞。

（裂隙崩溃已终结，本公会的所有勇者获得自由，Hesper回家了，古老的盟约大厅可以修复。）

English: Wen finds it while copying the last page: a line in the margin, in a smaller, neater hand than the Grandmaster's. "If a guild ever has to choose, there is a forty-second line. Ask the clerk." Wen asks Dobbs who the Grandmaster's clerk was. Dobbs looks at the empty fourth chair at the pay table, and doesn't answer.
简体中文: Wen在誊抄最后一页时发现了它：页边的一行字，笔迹比大团长的更小、更工整。"若有哪个公会不得不做出选择，还有第四十二行。去问书记员。"Wen问Dobbs大团长的书记员是谁。Dobbs看着发薪桌旁空着的第四把椅子，没有回答。

English: A letter comes up from the forty-first post, in green ink. "I was the clerk. I wrote her letters and her contracts, and I wrote the Terms out fair: forty-one lines. The night they were signed, she sent me home with a note that said I had a fever. I kept the note. I never told %s. I'm telling you. H."
简体中文: 一封信从第四十一号岗位传了上来，用绿墨水写的。"我就是那个书记员。我替她写信、写契约，也誊清了条款：四十一行。签约那晚，她给了我一张说我在发烧的字条，把我送回了家。字条我留着。我从没告诉过%s。现在我告诉你们。H."

English: Another letter from the post, in green ink. "There was a line under the forty-first. She made me leave it blank. It says the Terms can be changed, once, by a guild that has both kept them and broken them, and a guild is everyone who came before it. %s kept them. %s burned them. Write the forty-second line, and come and fetch me. H."
简体中文: 岗位又来了一封绿墨水写的信。"第四十一行下面还有一行。她让我留空。上面写着，条款可以被更改一次，由一个既守护过它又打破过它的公会来改，而一个公会包括它之前的所有人。%s守护了它。%s烧掉了它。写下第四十二行，然后来接我。H."

English: Another letter from the post, in green ink. "There was a line under the forty-first. She made me leave it blank. It says the Terms can be changed, once, by a guild that has both kept them and broken them, and a guild is everyone who came before it. None of ours has done both yet. H."
简体中文: 岗位又来了一封绿墨水写的信。"第四十一行下面还有一行。她让我留空。上面写着，条款可以被更改一次，由一个既守护过它又打破过它的公会来改，而一个公会包括它之前的所有人。我们的公会还没有一个两者都做到。H."

English:
Morrow's contracts start arriving on your board, generous ones. Wen reads the first, folds it, and doesn't write anything down. She doesn't have to.

(Contracts pay 25% more Gold for the rest of the campaign.)
简体中文:
Morrow的契约开始出现在你的告示板上，都很慷慨。Wen读完第一份，叠起来，什么也没记。她不需要记。

（本战役剩余时间内契约多付25%金币。）

English: Wen holds it a long time, then sends it down to the forty-first post. It comes back with a note in green ink: "That was the Grandmaster, before. Give it to the village." They give it to the village.
简体中文: Wen拿着它很久，然后把它送到了第四十一号岗位。它带着一张绿墨水字条回来了："那是从前的大团长。把它交给村子吧。"他们把它交给了村子。

English: The Iron Oath trained shield-walls. Their drill yard is still marked out in white stones, and Dobbs walks it once, end to end, counting, before he lets the recruits in.
简体中文: 钢铁誓约曾训练盾墙。他们的操练场仍用白石标着界线，Dobbs先从头到尾走了一遍，边走边数，才让新兵进去。

English: Dobbs pays for the climb down out of Morrow's old contracts, and doesn't say where the money came from. Wen writes it down anyway.
简体中文: Dobbs用Morrow旧契约的钱支付了下行的开销，没说钱从哪来。Wen还是记了下来。

English: Wen keeps the guild's chronicle and Dobbs keeps its books. Old Hesper, the last of an Accord guild, holds the forty-first post; her letters come up in green ink.
简体中文: Wen记录公会的编年史，Dobbs管账。老Hesper，某个盟约公会的最后一人，守着第四十一号岗位；她的信都用绿墨水写成。

English: Send one down to the post.
It'd be cold by the time it got there.

You don't take the page to the herald. You take it to Morrow, with the second column showing, and the coin. He reads it, counts the coin, and laughs for a long time. "The Treasury's man, bought by a guild. Fine. I was tired of their calendar."

(Morrow joins your guild as a Rank S rogue on double wages, and the Company stops hunting. Miss his pay once and he's gone. The Crown will remember at its hearing.)
简体中文:
你没有把那页纸交给传令官。你把它带给了Morrow，露出第二栏，还带着钱。他读完，数了数钱，笑了很久。"国库的人，被一个公会收买了。行。我早就受够他们的日历了。"

（Morrow以阶级S盗贼的身份加入你的公会，领双倍薪水，佣兵团不再追杀。漏发一次薪水他就会走。王冠会在听证会上记住这件事。）

English: The herald's list has another guild's name at the top. The Warden of Rifts' office, you happen to know, has a price, and a cousin who once mislaid a key.
简体中文: 传令官的名单最上面是另一个公会的名字。碰巧你知道，裂隙守卫官的官署有个价码，还有个曾经弄丢钥匙的表兄。

English: The Royal Charter is yours, at a price
简体中文: 王室特许状归你了，但有代价

English:
The herald clears his throat, turns his list over, and reads your name off the back of it. Nobody shakes your hand.

(Contracts pay 10% more Gold and Essence. A bought Charter earns no Laurels, and the Crown's auditors will come in Act IV.)
简体中文:
传令官清了清嗓子，把名单翻过来，从背面念出了你的名字。没人和你握手。

（契约多付10%金币和精华。买来的特许状不会获得桂冠，王冠的审计官将在第四幕到来。）

English:
Two clerks in grey arrive with the Warden's seal and go through Dobbs's books for three days. They leave with a fifth of the vault and a receipt.

(-20% of your Gold.)
简体中文:
两名灰衣书记员带着守卫官的印章到来，把Dobbs的账翻查了三天。他们带走了金库的五分之一，留下一张收据。

（损失20%金币。）

English: Morrow's key is on the table: old iron with the Accord's sigil, warm in a way iron shouldn't be. It opens any rift's door, from either side. Pip wants it back. Wen wants it in the river.
简体中文: Morrow的钥匙放在桌上：老铁打的，刻着盟约的徽记，带着一种铁不该有的温热。它能从任意一边打开任何裂隙的门。Pip想要回去。Wen想把它扔进河里。

English:
The key goes on a cord round the quartermaster's neck. Dobbs says it hums when a rift is near, and it does.

(Choose each rift's region in the Rift Hall. Every Riftbreak comes a rank higher: the doors know who has the key.)
简体中文:
钥匙用绳子挂在了军需官的脖子上。Dobbs说裂隙靠近时它会嗡嗡作响，确实如此。

（在裂隙大厅中自选每个裂隙的地区。每次裂隙崩溃都会高一个阶级：门知道钥匙在谁手里。）

English:
It takes the smith, two hammers and most of a morning. When the key breaks, every dog in the Vale barks at once, then stops.

(+5 Renown. Riftbreaks warn you a day earlier. The Grandmaster's Hall will have to be forced open, at a quarter more.)
简体中文:
这花了铁匠、两把锤子和大半个上午。钥匙断开的那一刻，山谷里所有的狗同时叫了起来，然后又停了。

（+5声望。裂隙崩溃提前一天预警。大团长的大厅将不得不强行打开，花费多四分之一。）

English: The last hall is the one the Accord was sworn in. Its doors open for no key now; the guild forces them with bars and patience. Inside is a long table, forty-one chairs, and one that someone has dusted every year. The Vale has its keepers again.
简体中文: 最后一座大厅是盟约宣誓成立的地方。如今它的门不为任何钥匙打开；公会用撬棍和耐心把门撬开。里面是一张长桌、四十一把椅子，其中一把有人每年都擦拭过。山谷再次有了守护者。

English: He holds the lantern out to you, open. You know now what's in it, and that the echoes in your vault would fit.
简体中文: 他把灯笼递向你，敞开着。你现在知道里面是什么了，也知道你金库里的回响正好装得下。

English:
You pour the vault's kept echoes into Ezra's lantern, one crystal at a time. The heroes they touched sit down, suddenly tired, and look lighter. Ezra bows, which nobody in the Vale has seen him do, and gives you the Ninth Lamp's own reckoning of what Essence is worth.

(Contracts pay 10% more Essence for the rest of the campaign. The Vale will remember what you gave.)
简体中文:
你把金库里保留的回响一块一块倒进Ezra的灯笼。被它们触动过的英雄坐了下来，突然很累，却显得轻松了。Ezra鞠了一躬——山谷里从没人见他这样做过——并把第九盏灯对精华价值的估算交给了你。

（本战役剩余时间内契约多付10%精华。山谷会记住你给予的东西。）

English: Under the City, at the deepest door, a knight in chains is still holding. Brannoch. He promised a child on the other side he would come back for her, and he never left the door to do it.
简体中文: 在城市之下，最深的那扇门前，一位戴着锁链的骑士仍在坚守。Brannoch。他答应过门另一边的一个孩子会回去接她，却从未为此离开过那扇门。

English:
You tell him she's grown, and safe, and waiting on our side. He laughs, once, and sets his shoulder against the door again. "Then it can wait for me a little longer."

(The City's gate holds: Act VI's gate objective is met. Brannoch stays at his post.)
简体中文:
你告诉他，她已经长大了，很安全，正在我们这边等着。他笑了一声，又把肩膀抵回门上。"那就让它再多等我一会儿吧。"

（城市的大门守住了：第六幕的大门目标已达成。Brannoch留守岗位。）

English:
Your heroes take the door's weight together, and Brannoch steps out of the light for the first time in twenty years. The door shudders. Something on the other side has noticed.

(Brannoch joins as a champion. The City's gate will come at Rank SS.)
简体中文:
你的英雄们一起扛住了门的重量，Brannoch二十年来第一次走出了光。门在颤抖。另一边有什么东西注意到了。

（Brannoch作为勇者加入。城市的大门将在阶级SS到来。）

English:
They sing the Accord's oath in the square, badly and beautifully, and the whole village joins in the second verse. The song carries. Far below, something hears it.

(+5 Renown and +15 morale for every hero. A Riftbreak swells in two days.)
简体中文:
他们在广场上唱起盟约的誓言，唱得很糟，也很美，全村人在第二段时都跟着唱了起来。歌声传得很远。在极深的下方，有什么听见了。

（+5声望，每位英雄+15士气。两天后将有一次裂隙崩溃膨胀。）

English: An old woman at the door, with a satchel she won't let go of. She says she signed for her side, once, and has come to see who signed for ours.
简体中文: 门口有一位老妇人，挎着一个怎么也不肯松手的挎包。她说她曾为她那一边签过字，这次是来看看是谁为我们这边签的字。

English: She joins as a Hollow-born Rank A cleric, and opens her satchel
简体中文: 她以空洞出生的阶级A牧师身份加入，并打开了她的挎包

English: +300 Gold: the Crown pays three times the usual for this one
简体中文: +300金币：王冠为这一个付了平常的三倍

English: The Crown's herald has come to the Vale to read the new Royal Charter in the square. Wen has the Terms' first page in her satchel, with the Crown's seal above every name. The square is full. Everyone is waiting for someone to speak.
简体中文: 王冠的传令官来到山谷，要在广场上宣读新的王室特许状。Wen的挎包里装着条款的第一页，每个名字上方都有王冠的印章。广场上挤满了人。所有人都在等有人开口。

English:
Wen reads the first page in the square, slowly, so the back rows can hear. The herald leaves before she finishes. By winter the Charter is gone from every wall, and the villages choose their own guilds at a moot.

(+30 Laurels. In every later guild: the Crown's hearing is the Vale's Moot, contracts pay 10% less Gold, rifts 10% less Essence, guilds earn 10% more Laurels, and Hollow-born heroes come from the start.)
简体中文:
Wen在广场上宣读了第一页，读得很慢，好让后排的人也听得见。她还没读完，传令官就走了。到了冬天，特许状从每一面墙上消失，各村在集会上选出自己的公会。

（+30桂冠。之后的每个公会：王冠的听证会改为山谷集会，契约金币减少10%，裂隙精华减少10%，公会获得的桂冠增加10%，空洞出生的英雄从一开始就会出现。）

English:
The page burns green, like the Terms did. The herald reads the Charter to a quiet square and leaves your guild a letter of thanks with a pension in it. Nobody mentions the smell of smoke.

(+30 Laurels, and 1,000 Gold every 28 days for this guild. In every later guild: royal patronage, contracts pay 15% more Gold, the Crown takes a tenth of the vault every 28 days, and the Iron Chorus is always the rival.)
简体中文:
那页纸燃起绿色的火焰，就像当年的条款一样。传令官向一片安静的广场宣读了特许状，给你的公会留下一封感谢信，里面附着一笔年金。没人提起烟味。

（+30桂冠，本公会每28天获得1,000金币。之后的每个公会：王室资助，契约多付15%金币，王冠每28天拿走金库的十分之一，钢铁合唱团始终是对手。）

English:
Every village sends someone to the moot, and the show of hands isn't close. No herald, no seal: the Vale's own say-so hangs in your hall.

(Wages are 10% lower: heroes want to work for the Vale's guild.)
简体中文:
每个村子都派人来参加集会，举手表决毫无悬念。没有传令官，没有印章：山谷自己的决定挂在了你的大厅里。

（薪水降低10%：英雄们都想为山谷的公会效力。）

English: The moot is long, and loud, and %s takes it. The villages will bring their troubles to another door for a while. The rifts don't care whose name the villages call.
简体中文: 集会冗长而喧闹，最终%s胜出。各村会有一段时间把麻烦带到别家门前。裂隙可不在乎各村喊的是谁的名字。

English: A notice on every guild door in the Vale
简体中文: 山谷中每个公会门上都贴着一张告示

English:
At the end of the year the villages will hold a moot and choose the guild they trust most. Until then, every guild works for its Renown.

The loudest of them, %s, led by %s, has noticed your guild.
简体中文:
年末各村将举行集会，选出他们最信任的公会。在那之前，每个公会都为声望而努力。

其中呼声最高的%s，由%s率领，已经注意到了你的公会。

English: Nyxara is gone, and the Spire is going after her. The Accord's archive is still on its shelves: every contract, every name, every oath, three hundred years of them. Down the hill the same water is heading for Hollin, and Hollin has a mill, a mill race and forty houses. Your heroes can carry one of them out.
简体中文: Nyxara已经消失，尖塔正随她而去。盟约的档案仍在架上：每一份契约、每一个名字、每一条誓言，三百年的积累。山下，同样的水正涌向Hollin，而Hollin有一座磨坊、一条水渠和四十户人家。你的英雄只能救出其中一样。

English:
Your heroes come down the Spire with the shelves on their backs and the water at their heels. Wen spends a week drying pages on every line in the camp. Hollin floods to the eaves. Nobody died, the miller says, which is not the same as nobody being hurt.

(-6 Renown. Ledger pages and the Vale's story turn up half again as often for the rest of this guild.)
简体中文:
你的英雄背着书架走下尖塔，水追在脚后。Wen花了一周时间在营地的每根绳子上晾干书页。Hollin被淹到了屋檐。磨坊主说没人死，但这不等于没人受伤。

（-6声望。本公会剩余时间内，账簿残页和山谷的故事出现频率提高一半。）

English:
Your heroes spend the night on the mill race with spades and doors torn off their hinges, and by morning the water goes round Hollin instead of through it. Behind them the Spire folds into the marsh with everything the Accord ever wrote down. Wen watches it go and doesn't say anything for a long time.

(+8 Renown. Hollin will remember.)
简体中文:
你的英雄在水渠上守了一夜，用铁锹和从铰链上拆下的门板，到早上，水绕过了Hollin而不是穿村而过。在他们身后，尖塔连同盟约写下的一切一起折进了沼泽。Wen看着它消失，很久都没说话。

（+8声望。Hollin会记住的。）

English: The Spire crumbles into the black water, and Nyxara with it, but not before your guild has carried out its shelves. Most of it is contracts. One book is in the Grandmaster's hand, and it says the guilds did not fall that night. They made a bargain. Beneath the Spire, something vast stirs: a rift with no bottom, lit by pillars of light. The Endless Rift is open to your guild.
简体中文: 尖塔崩落进黑水之中，Nyxara也随之而去，但在那之前你的公会已经搬出了它的书架。大部分是契约。有一本是大团长的手迹，书中说那一夜各公会并没有陨落。他们做了一笔交易。尖塔之下，某种庞然之物在蠢动：一个没有底的裂隙，被光柱照亮。无尽裂隙已向你的公会开放。

English:
Wen has read the archive's copies of the Terms, clause by clause. She knows what they are made of now, and so do your heroes.

(Act IV's finale is 5% weaker.)
简体中文:
Wen逐条读过了档案里的条款副本。她现在知道它们是由什么构成的，你的英雄也知道了。

（第四幕终章减弱5%。）

English:
Word comes down from Hollin before you open the door: whoever comes through, Hollin will take them in.

(Letting a crossing through costs no Renown.)
简体中文:
在你开门之前，Hollin传来了消息：无论谁穿越过来，Hollin都会收留他们。

（放行越界者不损失声望。）

English: Dobbs pays for the climb down out of Morrow's old contracts, and doesn't say where the money came from. Hesper does.
简体中文: Dobbs用Morrow旧契约的钱支付了下行的开销，没说钱从哪来。Hesper说了。

English: At the back of the square stands Mother Ilse, who brought you the first page of all this. She catches Wen's eye and nods, once.
简体中文: 广场后方站着Ilse嬷嬷，正是她给你带来了这一切的第一页。她和Wen对上了目光，点了一下头。

English: Morrow reads the seal over Wen's shoulder and laughs, the way he did when you bought him. "Told you. Someone always pays."
简体中文: Morrow越过Wen的肩膀读了印章，笑了起来，就像你收买他的那天一样。"早说过了。总有人付钱。"

English:
A letter under the Crown's seal follows you down: the Charter's holder will turn every crossing back. The bounty is doubled while you hold it.

(Turning a crossing back pays double.)
简体中文:
一封盖着王冠印章的信追着你下来了：特许状持有者须遣返每一次越界。持有期间赏金翻倍。

（遣返越界者的报酬翻倍。）

English: %s holds the Charter, so the Crown has sent them down as well. Their banners are on the Glass Coast before yours, and the doors near their camp are already shut.
简体中文: %s持有特许状，所以王冠也把他们派了下来。他们的旗帜比你的先插上玻璃海岸，他们营地附近的门已经关上了。

English: Vaelith comes to the door before anyone calls her. The smallest of the five lets go of the line and runs to her.
简体中文: 还没人叫她，Vaelith就来到了门前。五个人里最小的那个松开了队伍，向她跑去。

English: They ask after a pale man with a lantern. Wen tells them what you poured into it. The eldest closes her eyes, listens to something none of you can hear, and says some of theirs are home.
简体中文: 他们打听一个提着灯笼的苍白男子。Wen告诉他们你往灯笼里倒了什么。最年长的那位闭上眼睛，听着你们谁都听不见的东西，然后说他们的一些人回家了。

English: The first winter nobody comes up. The doors stand open on an empty shore, and your guild learns how to wait.
简体中文: 第一个冬天没有人上来。门在空荡荡的岸边敞开着，你的公会学会了等待。

English: The first of them to come up are met at the doors by the ones you let through before, holding lamps and calling down in their own language.
简体中文: 最先上来的那些人，在门口迎接他们的是你之前放行的人，提着灯，用他们自己的语言朝下呼喊。

English: The ones you let through watch from the cliff as the last door closes. Nobody asks them to leave. Nobody asks them anything.
简体中文: 你放行的人在悬崖上看着最后一扇门关上。没人叫他们离开。也没人问他们什么。

English: Under the city, a knight sets down a door he held for twenty years, because nobody needs it held any more.
简体中文: 在城市之下，一位骑士放下了他守了二十年的门，因为再也不需要有人守着它了。

English: Brannoch is still holding when the last door closes. Nobody can say which side he is on.
简体中文: 最后一扇门关上时，Brannoch仍在坚守。没人说得清他在哪一边。

English: Brannoch climbs to the top of the cords himself, to see the last door with his own eyes.
简体中文: Brannoch亲自爬到了绳索顶端，要亲眼看着最后一扇门。
每回合小队伤害+3%（可叠加）。

English: Every third round, fire strikes every foe for 35% of party damage.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，火焰打击所有敌人，造成小队伤害35%的伤害。

English: Evading or taking a heavy hit weakens the attacker.
简体中文: 闪避或受到重击时削弱攻击者。

English: Every third round, shield the party for 8% of max HP.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，为小队提供其最大生命8%的护盾。

English: Hits heal the attacker for 8% of the damage.
简体中文: 攻击为攻击者回复伤害8%的生命。

English: Each kill mends the party for 6% of max HP.
简体中文: 每次击杀为小队回复最大生命的6%。

English: +20% chance to counter when evading or hit hard.
简体中文: 闪避或受重击时反击几率+20%。

English: 20% chance to take a hit meant for a wounded ally.
简体中文: 20%几率替负伤的盟友承受攻击。

English: Once a fight, survive a wipe at 25% HP.
简体中文: 每场战斗一次，团灭时以25%生命幸存。

English: +30% chance to gain 1 Momentum when evading or hit hard.
简体中文: 闪避或受重击时获得1点气势的几率+30%。

English: Each kill arcs lightning into every foe for 30% of party damage.
简体中文: 每次击杀时闪电跳向所有敌人，造成小队伤害30%的伤害。

English: Hits finish off foes left below 12% HP.
简体中文: 攻击会终结生命低于12%的敌人。

English: Each kill shields the weakest ally for 12% of max HP.
简体中文: 每次击杀为最弱的盟友提供其最大生命12%的护盾。

English: Every third round, mend the party for 5% of max HP.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，为小队回复最大生命的5%。

English: Every third round, fire hits every foe for 60% of party damage.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，火焰打击所有敌人，造成小队伤害60%的伤害。

English: Every third round, shield the party for 15%.
简体中文: 每隔三回合，为小队提供15%的护盾。

English: Hits heal for 15% of the damage.
Each kill shields the weakest ally for 20%.
简体中文: 每次击杀为最弱的盟友提供20%的护盾。

English: Evading or taking a heavy hit can grant an extra turn.
简体中文: 闪避或受到重击时可能获得额外回合。

English: Hits finish off foes below 20% HP.
简体中文: 攻击会终结生命低于20%的敌人。

English: Once a fight, survive a wipe at 30% HP.
简体中文: 每场战斗一次，团灭时以30%生命幸存。

English: Every foe is armored (at least 30% of basic attacks shrugged off). Abilities ignore armor.
简体中文: 所有敌人都有护甲（至少30%的普通攻击被抵挡）。技能无视护甲。

English: Every foe's hits can set a hero ablaze.
简体中文: 所有敌人的攻击都可能点燃英雄。

English: Every foe's hits can chill a hero (acts late).
简体中文: 所有敌人的攻击都可能冻寒英雄（延后行动）。

English: Every foe winds up heavy blows far more often. Defend!
简体中文: 所有敌人蓄力重击的频率大大提高。防御！

English: A single foe with double health.
Foes hit 40% harder but have 30% less health.
简体中文: 敌人伤害提高40%，但生命减少30%。

English: Foes have 50% more health but hit 20% softer.
简体中文: 敌人生命增加50%，但伤害降低20%。

English: An iron sentinel bars the first gate.
简体中文: 一个钢铁哨兵挡住了第一道门。

English: The flooded stair has a keeper, and it does not tire.
简体中文: 被淹的阶梯有一位看守，而它不知疲倦。

English: Heat pours down from the thirtieth landing.
简体中文: 热浪从第三十层平台倾泻而下。

English: Voices echo from every wall, louder by the moment.
简体中文: 声音从每面墙上回荡，越来越响。

English: Halfway up, the tower tests your patience.
简体中文: 爬到一半，塔开始考验你的耐心。

English: A crowned flame waits on its throne.
简体中文: 一团戴冠的火焰在王座上等候。

English: Whatever falls here, it stitches back together.
简体中文: 无论什么倒在这里，它都会重新缝合起来。

English: It has already seen how this fight ends.
简体中文: 它早已看见这场战斗如何结束。

English: The oldest fire in the tower.
The top of the tower. No one has stood here in an age.
简体中文: 塔的顶端。已经很久没有人站在这里了。

English: Ser Corwen of the Third Post
Brother Anselm of the Chapel Road
A merchant's cart rolls into camp with three fine pieces. They leave at dusk.
简体中文: 一辆商人的马车驶进营地，载着三件好货。黄昏时离开。

English: %s, a name from the old guild songs, stops for the night and offers to drill one of your heroes.
简体中文: %s，一个出自古老公会歌谣的名字，在此留宿一晚，并提出要操练你的一名英雄。

English: A Rank %s %s asks for a place in the guild, for less than the recruit board would charge.
简体中文: 一名阶级%s的%s请求加入公会，要价比招募板上的低。

English: A hooded peddler unwraps a single relic and names a steep price.
简体中文: 一个戴兜帽的小贩展开一件遗物，报出了高价。

English: A journeyman smith offers to temper your %s at half the forge's price.
简体中文: 一位出师的铁匠提出以锻炉半价淬炼你的%s。

English: A scholar offers a lecture on the old guilds' tactics. Every hero at camp would learn from it.
简体中文: 一位学者提议讲授旧公会的战术。营地里的每位英雄都能从中受益。

English: The village holds its harvest festival and hopes the guild will pay for the feast.
简体中文: 村庄举办丰收节，希望公会为宴席买单。

English: Families fleeing a broken rift ask for shelter and bread. Word of it would travel.
简体中文: 逃离一处崩溃裂隙的家庭请求庇护和面包。这件事会传开。

English: A clerk arrives with a debt the guild's founders left unpaid, with interest. Refusing would be talked about.
简体中文: 一名书记员带来了公会创始人留下的一笔欠债，还附着利息。拒绝的话会招来闲话。

English: %s's quartermaster wants to buy your %s, at twice what a merchant pays. They would fight with it.
简体中文: %s的军需官想买下你的%s，出价是商人的两倍。他们会用它来作战。

English: The forge chimney threw sparks all evening.
简体中文: 锻炉的烟囱整晚都在冒火星。

English: Two of the guild woke up coughing.
简体中文: 公会里有两个人醒来就在咳嗽。

English: A fever is spreading through the barracks. A cleric could keep it from taking anyone down.
简体中文: 热病正在兵营中蔓延。牧师可以防止它击倒任何人。

English: Strangers were seen watching the camp from the treeline.
简体中文: 有人看到陌生人在林线边窥视营地。

English: Bandits have come for the guild's strongbox.
简体中文: 盗匪来抢公会的钱箱了。

English: The sky over the hills has turned the colour of a bruise.
简体中文: 山丘上空变成了淤青般的颜色。

English: A storm is tearing at the roofs of the %s.
The ground hummed under the camp all night.
简体中文: 营地下方的地面嗡鸣了一整夜。

English: A small rift has torn open by the well, and something is climbing out.
简体中文: 井边裂开了一道小裂隙，有东西正在爬出来。

English: A chaplain of the old Accord chapels offers to bless the next party that goes out.
简体中文: 一位来自古老盟约礼拜堂的牧师提出为下一支出发的小队祝福。

English: The next party sets out blessed: +3 Resolve.
简体中文: 下一支小队带着祝福出发：+3决心。

English: A retired adventurer with one eye and a hundred stories sits down at the guild's fire.
简体中文: 一位独眼、肚子里装着一百个故事的退役冒险者在公会的火堆旁坐了下来。

English: A good night of stories: morale up, +1 Resolve for the next party.
简体中文: 一夜好故事：士气提升，下一支小队+1决心。

English: Two marsh folk come up the road with bundles of fever-reed. Boiled, it keeps a wound from turning.
简体中文: 两个沼泽人沿路走来，背着一捆捆热病芦苇。煮过之后，能防止伤口恶化。

English: An old guide from the Drowned Marches offers to walk your next party to the rift by the dry paths.
简体中文: 一位来自淹没沼泽的老向导提出沿干燥的小路带你的下一支小队前往裂隙。

English: The next party sets out fresh: +3 Resolve.
简体中文: 下一支小队精神饱满地出发：+3决心。

English: A drummer who marched with the old guilds offers to play the next party to the rift's edge.
简体中文: 一位曾随旧公会行军的鼓手提出为下一支小队击鼓，一路送到裂隙边缘。

English: The next party marches out to the drum: +4 Resolve.
简体中文: 下一支小队随鼓声出征：+4决心。

English: Someone screamed in their sleep last night.
简体中文: 昨晚有人在睡梦中尖叫。

English: The heroes are dreaming of the rifts, and nobody is sleeping.
简体中文: 英雄们梦见了裂隙，没有人睡得着。

English: A quiet word at the right bedside: morale up.
简体中文: 在合适的床边说几句贴心话：士气提升。

English: Let it pass (the next party sets out with -3 Resolve)
简体中文: 随它去（下一支小队出发时决心-3）

English: A child at the rift's edge
A village child wandered toward a rift scar and hasn't come back.
简体中文: 一个村里的孩子朝裂隙疤痕走去，至今没有回来。

English: The child is home by dark. The village won't forget it: +6 Renown.
简体中文: 天黑前孩子回到了家。村子不会忘记：+6声望。

English: The heroes want a night of cards and dice, with the guild's purse as the bank.
简体中文: 英雄们想来一晚纸牌和骰子，用公会的钱袋坐庄。

English: The house wins: +90 Gold, and a good night.
简体中文: 庄家赢了：+90金币，还度过了愉快的一晚。

English: The heroes clean out the bank, and love every minute of it.
简体中文: 英雄们把庄家赢了个精光，玩得不亦乐乎。

English: An assessor from the Crown wants to inspect the guild's books, and hints that a gift would speed things up.
简体中文: 一名来自王冠的估税官要检查公会的账目，还暗示送点礼能让事情快些。

English: Word of the gift gets out: -6 Renown.
简体中文: 送礼的事传了出去：-6声望。

English: A caravan bound for the Ashen Wastes asks for an escort past the old rift scars.
简体中文: 一支前往灰烬荒原的商队请求护送他们经过古老的裂隙疤痕。

English: The caravan pays well, and talks about it.
简体中文: 商队报酬丰厚，还到处宣扬。

English: A man covered in ash preaches the end of the Vale at the camp gate. The heroes are listening.
简体中文: 一个满身灰烬的男人在营地门口宣讲山谷的末日。英雄们在听。

English: Pay him to move on (%d Gold)
The heroes sleep badly: morale down.
简体中文: 英雄们睡得很差：士气下降。

English: Smugglers offer rift-glass relics pulled from a wreck. Nobody asks where the crew went.
简体中文: 走私者兜售从沉船里捞出的裂隙玻璃遗物。没人问船员去了哪里。

English: The Glass Coast's lighthouse keeper sells charts of where the rifts will break.
简体中文: 玻璃海岸的灯塔看守出售标注裂隙将在何处崩溃的海图。

English: The heroes study the charts: some XP, +3 Resolve for the next party.
简体中文: 英雄们研究海图：获得一些经验，下一支小队+3决心。

English: Pilgrims walking to the Inverted City ask to rest at the guild's fire.
简体中文: 前往倒悬之城的朝圣者请求在公会的火堆旁歇脚。

English: A trader from the far side of the City sells blades that show what's behind you.
简体中文: 一位来自城市彼端的商人出售能照出身后之物的刀刃。

English: Foes are weaker, the haul is never at risk, breaches come later, and Resolve doesn't count. Half the Laurels.
简体中文: 敌人更弱，战利品永无风险，裂口来得更晚，决心不计入。桂冠减半。

English: Parties set out with 2 less Resolve.
Mending is capped at 30% a round.
A party that falls loses 75% of its haul.
简体中文: 小队覆灭时损失75%战利品。

English: Every ranked boss has a second mechanic.
简体中文: 每个阶级首领都有第二种机制。

English: Foes deal 10% more damage, and the rival's Renown grows 20% faster.
简体中文: 敌人伤害+10%，对手的声望增长加快20%。

English: %s has been in the rifts a lot and wants a few days away from the guild.
简体中文: %s在裂隙里待了太久，想离开公会几天。

English: %s says the rifts are worth more than the guild pays and wants a bigger share.
简体中文: %s说裂隙的价值超过公会付的钱，想要更大的份额。

English: %s says their gear is falling apart and asks for Gold for repairs.
简体中文: %s说自己的装备快散架了，请求拨些金币修理。

English: %s asks for a free day at the Training Yard.
简体中文: %s请求在训练场免费训练一天。

English: Give them a station: a free day of training, +5 morale
简体中文: 给一个位置：免费训练一天，士气+5

English: An argument over the last rift's spoils has turned sour. Each wants you on their side.
简体中文: 为上一个裂隙的战利品起的争执闹僵了。双方都想让你站在自己这边。

English: %s wants to test a new spell
%s wants to try something loud on the training dummies. The yard may need a sweep afterwards.
简体中文: %s想在训练假人上试点动静大的东西。之后训练场可能得打扫一下。

English: Let them (%d Gold): +15 morale, some XP
简体中文: 同意（%d金币）：士气+15，获得一些经验

English: %s and %s ask to share a tent
Two heroes who have been through a lot together want to bunk side by side.
简体中文: 两位一起经历过很多的英雄想睡在一起。

English: Let them: their bond grows, +8 morale each
简体中文: 同意：他们的羁绊加深，各自士气+8

English: %s still carries the last bad rift and asks for a day to visit the fallen.
简体中文: %s仍放不下上一次惨烈的裂隙，请求一天时间去看望逝者。

English: Give them the day (busy today): +20 morale, Steady Nerves
简体中文: 给他一天（今天没空）：士气+20，镇定心神

English: An experienced hero wants to take a newer one under their wing for a day.
简体中文: 一位经验丰富的英雄想带一名新人一天。

English: Agree (both busy today): the junior gains a level's XP, Mentor
简体中文: 同意（两人今天都没空）：新人获得一级的经验，导师

English: %s hasn't seen home since joining. A letter and a little coin would help.
简体中文: %s加入后就再没回过家。一封信和一点钱会有帮助。

English: %s asks for a night alone with the guild's relics and swears nothing will break.
简体中文: %s请求独自与公会的遗物待一晚，发誓什么都不会弄坏。

English: Allow it (%d Essence): some XP, Spark of Genius
简体中文: 允许（%d精华）：获得一些经验，灵光乍现

English: %s wants to duel the rival's champion
The rival guild's champion has been mocking us in the tavern. %s wants to settle it in the ring.
简体中文: 敌对公会的勇者一直在酒馆里嘲笑我们。%s想在擂台上做个了断。

English: Let them fight (3 in 5: Renown and a title)
简体中文: 让他们打（五成之三：声望与称号）

English: %s knows a quiet valley with deer and would bring back meat for the whole guild.
简体中文: %s知道一个有鹿的幽静山谷，能为全公会带回肉来。

English: Let them go (busy today): +5 morale for everyone
简体中文: 让他去（今天没空）：所有人士气+5

English: %s offers to sit with anyone who wants to talk about what they've seen in the rifts.
简体中文: %s愿意陪伴任何想谈谈在裂隙中所见之事的人。

English: Allow it (busy today): +6 morale for everyone
简体中文: 允许（今天没空）：所有人士气+6

English: %s won a charm off a sailor at dice. It may well be stolen.
简体中文: %s和一个水手掷骰子赢来了一个护符。很可能是偷来的。

English: Let them keep it: +10 morale, -2 Renown
%s has been knocked out too often and the wound never healed right. A healer could help.
简体中文: %s被击倒的次数太多，伤口一直没好利索。医者能帮上忙。

English: %s wants to lead the next rift
%s is in high spirits and wants to be first through the next rift.
简体中文: %s斗志高昂，想第一个冲进下一个裂隙。

English: Yes: the next party sets out with +2 Resolve
简体中文: 好：下一支小队出发时决心+2

English: %s wants the next rift to pay for the last one, and talks about little else.
简体中文: %s想让下一个裂隙为上一个付出代价，满嘴都是这件事。

English: Tell them to let it go: +5 morale
%s wants to visit a shrine of their Path
%s has heard of an old shrine to their Path two valleys over.
简体中文: %s听说隔着两座山谷有一座供奉其道途的古老圣坛。

English: Send them (busy 2 days, %d Essence): a level's XP, a title
简体中文: 派他去（2天没空，%d精华）：一级的经验，一个称号

English: %s can't sleep and offers to keep watch over the camp.
Let them (busy today): +1 Resolve for the next party, +5 morale
简体中文: 让他去（今天没空）：下一支小队决心+1，士气+5

English: %s wrote a song about the guild
%s wants to sing it at the village tavern. It is... enthusiastic.
简体中文: %s想在村里的酒馆唱这首歌。它……很有激情。

English: Let them (%d Gold for a round): +4 Renown, a title
简体中文: 让他唱（请一轮酒%d金币）：声望+4，一个称号

English: Two heroes want to settle who's better. It could get heated.
简体中文: 两位英雄想比个高低。可能会动真火。

English: Allow it: both gain XP, their bond grows
简体中文: 允许：两人都获得经验，羁绊加深

English: Not in my yard: -3 morale each
简体中文: 别在我的训练场：各自士气-3

English: %s asks for a share of the spoils
%s thinks the heroes deserve a cut of what the last rifts brought home.
简体中文: %s认为英雄们应该分到最近几个裂隙带回来的东西。

English: Share a tenth of the Gold (up to 150): +10 morale for everyone
简体中文: 分出十分之一的金币（最多150）：所有人士气+10

English: %s has been watching the forge and wants to temper their own gear.
简体中文: %s一直在看锻炉，想亲手淬炼自己的装备。

English: Let them (busy today): their best piece is tempered once
简体中文: 让他学（今天没空）：其最好的一件装备淬炼一次

English: Leave it to the smiths: -4 morale
%s is afraid of the next rift
%s is new and has heard too many of the veterans' stories. They want to stay back once more.
简体中文: %s是新人，听了太多老兵的故事。他想再留守一次。

English: Let them sit it out (busy today): +10 morale
简体中文: 让他留下（今天没空）：士气+10

English: Send them anyway: -8 morale, some XP from facing it
简体中文: 照样派去：士气-8，直面恐惧获得一些经验

English: Stun, freeze or bash a foe while it winds up, before its heavy blow lands. One winds up in round 2.
简体中文: 在敌人蓄力时将其眩晕、冻结或击晕，赶在重击落下之前。第2回合会有一个敌人蓄力。

English: Down every foe by the end of round %d.
简体中文: 在第%d回合结束前击倒所有敌人。

English: No hero loses more than half their health in this fight.
简体中文: 本场战斗中没有英雄损失超过一半的生命。

English: The first foe to fall is %s.
Down two foes in the same round.
简体中文: 在同一回合内击倒两个敌人。

English: Bank %d Momentum at any point in the fight.
简体中文: 战斗中任意时刻积攒%d点气势。

English: A scout from another guild lies bleeding against the wall, clutching a torn map.
简体中文: 一名来自其他公会的斥候靠在墙边流着血，紧攥着一张撕破的地图。

English: An altar hums with rift-light. It wants something from you.
简体中文: 一座祭坛闪烁着裂隙之光，嗡嗡作响。它想从你这里得到些什么。

English: Every hero loses 15% HP (never below 1) · gain a Rare-or-better item or relic
简体中文: 每位英雄损失15%生命（不会低于1）· 获得一件稀有或更好的物品或遗物

English: Supplies left behind by a party that didn't make it out.
简体中文: 一支没能走出去的小队留下的补给。

English: 70%: 20-35 Gold · 30%: a trap hits everyone for 10% HP
简体中文: 70%：20-35金币 · 30%：陷阱对所有人造成10%生命伤害

English: Shimmering memories of old battles replay in the air around you.
简体中文: 往日战斗的记忆在你周围的空气中闪烁重演。

English: Every hero in the party gains 20 XP
简体中文: 小队中每位英雄获得20经验

English: A cloaked figure shuffles cards on an upturned crate and grins at you.
简体中文: 一个披着斗篷的身影在倒扣的木箱上洗牌，朝你咧嘴一笑。

English: A small shrine the rift somehow left untouched. The air is calm here.
简体中文: 一座裂隙不知为何没有触及的小圣坛。这里的空气很平静。

English: A rack of weapons lies pinned under fallen stone. Something good might still be under there.
简体中文: 一排武器被压在落石之下。下面也许还有好东西。

English: Might check · pass: a Rare-or-better item · fail: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 力量检定 · 成功：一件稀有或更好的物品 · 失败：所有人损失10%生命

English: A book floats open in the dark, murmuring techniques in a language almost like yours.
简体中文: 一本书在黑暗中悬浮翻开，用一种近似你们的语言低声念着技艺。

English: Focus check · pass: every hero gains 40 XP · fail: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 专注检定 · 成功：每位英雄获得40经验 · 失败：所有人损失10%生命

English: A rope bridge sways over a chasm. On the far side, a dead scout's pack.
简体中文: 一座绳桥在深渊上方摇晃。对面有一名死去斥候的背包。

English: Agility check · pass: +20-35 Gold · fail: everyone loses 15% HP
简体中文: 敏捷检定 · 成功：+20-35金币 · 失败：所有人损失15%生命

English: Something glints at the bottom of a pit of still-glowing coals.
简体中文: 一个仍在发光的炭坑底部，有什么东西在闪烁。

English: Everyone loses 15% HP · a Rare-or-better relic
简体中文: 所有人损失15%生命 · 一件稀有或更好的遗物

English: A knight from another guild, frozen mid-stride in rift-ice. Still breathing.
简体中文: 一名来自其他公会的骑士，迈步途中被冻在裂隙寒冰里。仍在呼吸。

English: Costs 15 Gold · +3 Renown · +3 Momentum next fight
简体中文: 花费15金币 · +3声望 · 下一场战斗+3气势
一件稀有或更好的物品 · -2声望

English: A pool of something thick and red. Drinking it would teach you things. Painful things.
简体中文: 一池又稠又红的东西。喝下它会教你一些事。痛苦的事。

English: Everyone loses 20% HP · every hero gains 40 XP
简体中文: 所有人损失20%生命 · 每位英雄获得40经验

English: An anvil that rings on its own. A smith's ghost offers to work it, for a price.
简体中文: 一座会自己鸣响的铁砧。一个铁匠的幽魂提出为你打造，要收钱。
花费25金币 · 一件史诗物品

English: A totem crackles with trapped lightning. Channelled right, it could charge your party.
简体中文: 一根图腾噼啪作响，困着闪电。引导得当，它能为你的小队充能。

English: Focus check · pass: +12-20 Essence, +3 Momentum next fight · fail: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 专注检定 · 成功：+12-20精华，下一场战斗+3气势 · 失败：所有人损失10%生命

English: A shade drifts toward you, hungry for anything bright: gold, light, warmth.
简体中文: 一道幽影朝你飘来，渴求任何明亮的东西：金子、光、温暖。

English: Half a chapel, the other half somewhere in the rift. The altar still holds warmth.
简体中文: 半座礼拜堂，另一半在裂隙中的某处。祭坛仍有余温。

English: Costs 20 Gold · every hero heals 50% HP · +2 Renown
简体中文: 花费20金币 · 每位英雄回复50%生命 · +2声望

English: A translucent merchant lays out wares that flicker in and out of existence.
简体中文: 一个半透明的商人摆出时隐时现的货物。

English: Costs 30 Gold · an Epic item or relic
简体中文: 花费30金币 · 一件史诗物品或遗物

English: A rift beast in a cage of runes, whimpering. The rune-lock is simple enough.
简体中文: 一只裂隙兽被关在符文笼中，呜咽着。符文锁很简单。

English: 55%: it bounds off grateful · +4 Renown, +2 Essence · 45%: it lashes out, everyone loses 15% HP
简体中文: 55%：它感激地跑开 · +4声望，+2精华 · 45%：它发起攻击，所有人损失15%生命

English: Your reflection moves a moment after you do. It seems to be showing you something.
简体中文: 你的倒影比你慢一拍才动。它似乎在给你看什么。

English: Focus check · pass: +3 Momentum next fight, +25 XP each · fail: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 专注检定 · 成功：下一场战斗+3气势，每人+25经验 · 失败：所有人损失10%生命

English: A stone golem dozes on top of a treasure chest. Its snores shake the floor.
简体中文: 一尊石魔像趴在宝箱上打盹。它的鼾声震得地面发颤。

English: Agility check · pass: +30-45 Gold and a Rare-or-better item or relic · fail: everyone loses 20% HP
简体中文: 敏捷检定 · 成功：+30-45金币和一件稀有或更好的物品或遗物 · 失败：所有人损失20%生命

English: A young recruit from a village guild, lost and terrified, clutching a rusted sword.
简体中文: 一名来自乡村公会的年轻新兵，迷了路，吓坏了，紧攥着一把生锈的剑。

English: Every hero loses 5% HP · +4 Renown, +1 Essence
简体中文: 每位英雄损失5%生命 · +4声望，+1精华

English: Pale mushrooms pulse with soft light. They smell faintly of mint and ozone.
简体中文: 苍白的蘑菇脉动着柔和的光。闻起来隐约有薄荷和臭氧的味道。

English: 60%: every hero heals 30% HP and gains 15 XP · 40%: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 60%：每位英雄回复30%生命并获得15经验 · 40%：所有人损失10%生命

English: Two paths: one dives deeper into raw rift energy, one leads to a quiet alcove.
简体中文: 两条路：一条深入原始的裂隙能量，一条通往一处安静的凹室。

English: Every hero heals 15% HP · +3 Momentum next fight
简体中文: 每位英雄回复15%生命 · 下一场战斗+3气势

English: A guild banner lies in the dust, its bearer long gone. The cloth is still good.
简体中文: 一面公会旗帜躺在尘土中，持旗者早已不在。布料还很好。

English: +3 Renown · a 20-point shield against the next hazard
简体中文: +3声望 · 抵御下一个险境的20点护盾

English: A rival guild's hireling crouches in a side passage, clutching a stolen purse.
简体中文: 一名敌对公会的雇工蹲在侧道里，紧攥着一个偷来的钱袋。

English: Coins glint at the bottom of a dry well, and something down there whispers your name.
简体中文: 枯井底部有钱币闪光，下面有什么在低声呼唤你的名字。

English: Agility check · pass: 25-40 Gold · fail: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 敏捷检定 · 成功：25-40金币 · 失败：所有人损失10%生命

English: Costs 5 Gold · every hero heals 15% HP
简体中文: 花费5金币 · 每位英雄回复15%生命

English: An abandoned rift-forge, its coals still faintly warm.
简体中文: 一座废弃的裂隙锻炉，炭火仍有微温。
花费10精华 · 一件稀有或更好的物品

English: Chalk lines and battered practice dummies. Someone trained here once, and the rift kept it.
简体中文: 粉笔线和破旧的练习假人。曾有人在这里训练，裂隙把它留了下来。

English: Everyone loses 10% HP · every hero gains 35 XP
简体中文: 所有人损失10%生命 · 每位英雄获得35经验

English: An old man lives here, somehow. He offers tea and a story.
简体中文: 有个老人不知怎么住在这里。他请你喝茶，讲个故事。

English: Costs 20 Gold · a 25-point shield against the next hazard
简体中文: 花费20金币 · 抵御下一个险境的25点护盾

English: Adventurers' bones, their packs still strapped on.
简体中文: 冒险者的骸骨，背包还系在身上。

English: 60%: a Rare-or-better find · 40%: a trap hits everyone for 10% HP
简体中文: 60%：一件稀有或更好的发现 · 40%：陷阱对所有人造成10%生命伤害
+2声望 · 每位英雄获得10经验

English: A masked figure blocks the path with a spear. "Toll."
简体中文: 一个戴面具的身影用长矛拦住去路。"过路费。"

English: Costs 25 Gold · he points out a shortcut: +3 Momentum next fight
简体中文: 花费25金币 · 他指了一条捷径：下一场战斗+3气势

English: Might check · pass: +30 Gold from his strongbox · fail: everyone loses 15% HP
简体中文: 力量检定 · 成功：从他的钱箱拿到+30金币 · 失败：所有人损失15%生命

English: A shaft of pale light falls through a crack in the rift. It feels like home.
简体中文: 一束苍白的光从裂隙的缝隙中洒落。感觉像家。

English: A merchant's cart lies on its side. The merchant is nowhere to be seen.
简体中文: 一辆商人的马车翻倒在地。不见商人踪影。

English: A scarecrow stands in the rift's wheat, its sackcloth head turning to follow you.
简体中文: 一个稻草人立在裂隙的麦田里，麻布做的脑袋跟着你转动。

English: Focus check · pass: a Rare-or-better item · fail: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 专注检定 · 成功：一件稀有或更好的物品 · 失败：所有人损失10%生命

English: Apple trees heavy with softly glowing fruit, in a field that shouldn't exist.
简体中文: 苹果树上挂满微微发光的果实，长在一片本不该存在的田野里。

English: 70%: every hero heals 30% HP · 30%: bellyache, everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 70%：每位英雄回复30%生命 · 30%：肚子疼，所有人损失10%生命

English: The mill wheel turns with no water and no wind, grinding something that glows.
简体中文: 水车在没有水也没有风的情况下转动，碾磨着某种发光的东西。

English: Might check · pass: the village thanks you, +4 Renown, +15 Gold · fail: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 力量检定 · 成功：村子感谢你，+4声望，+15金币 · 失败：所有人损失10%生命

English: A farmer's roadside shrine, its garlands somehow still fresh.
简体中文: 一座农夫的路边神龛，花环不知为何仍很新鲜。

English: Costs 10 Gold · every hero heals 20% HP · +2 Renown
简体中文: 花费10金币 · 每位英雄回复20%生命 · +2声望

English: A bronze bell rises from the black water and tolls once, very slowly.
简体中文: 一口青铜钟从黑水中升起，非常缓慢地敲响了一下。

English: 50%: a Rare-or-better relic surfaces · 50%: the water lashes out, everyone loses 15% HP
简体中文: 50%：一件稀有或更好的遗物浮出水面 · 50%：水猛然袭来，所有人损失15%生命

English: Fat leeches drift in a warm pool. The old marsh healers swore by them.
简体中文: 肥硕的水蛭在一池温水中漂浮。老一辈的沼泽医者对它们深信不疑。

English: A chest sits chained under a foot of murky water.
简体中文: 一个宝箱被锁链拴在一尺深的浑水下。

English: Agility check · pass: a Rare-or-better item · fail: everyone loses 12% HP
简体中文: 敏捷检定 · 成功：一件稀有或更好的物品 · 失败：所有人损失12%生命

English: The fog whispers the names of heroes your guild has lost.
简体中文: 雾气低声念着你的公会失去的英雄的名字。

English: The statue of a forgotten king, half swallowed by ash, still holds out its hand.
简体中文: 一尊被遗忘国王的雕像，半截埋在灰烬里，仍伸着手。

English: Might check · pass: a Rare-or-better relic · fail: everyone loses 10% HP
简体中文: 力量检定 · 成功：一件稀有或更好的遗物 · 失败：所有人损失10%生命

English: A bridge of cooled volcanic glass arcs over a river of fire.
简体中文: 一座冷却火山玻璃的桥拱跨在火河之上。

English: Agility check · pass: +8 Essence, +3 Momentum next fight · fail: everyone loses 15% HP
简体中文: 敏捷检定 · 成功：+8精华，下一场战斗+3气势 · 失败：所有人损失15%生命

English: An abandoned fire-cult altar, piled high with offerings.
简体中文: 一座废弃的拜火教祭坛，供品堆得高高的。

English: A warm egg rests in the embers, pulsing with light like a heartbeat.
简体中文: 一枚温热的蛋躺在余烬中，光芒如心跳般脉动。

English: 40%: it hatches and leaves a gift, a Rare-or-better find, +10 Essence · 60%: it bursts, everyone loses 15% HP
简体中文: 40%：它孵化并留下礼物，一件稀有或更好的发现，+10精华 · 60%：它爆开，所有人损失15%生命

English: In the middle of the rift, a stall. A thing with too many hands is selling fruit made of glass. It does not attack. It seems embarrassed to be seen. When your party comes closer it holds out a fruit and says, very clearly, in our language: please.
简体中文: 裂隙中央有一个摊位。一个手多得过分的东西在卖玻璃做的水果。它没有攻击。它似乎因为被看见而难为情。你的小队走近时，它递出一个水果，用我们的语言清清楚楚地说：求你了。

English: Costs 12 Gold · every hero heals 25% HP
简体中文: 花费12金币 · 每位英雄回复25%生命

English: A small creature hides behind a rock. It has the shape of the things you fight, but small, and it is crying. It flinches when your party comes near, then follows at a distance.
简体中文: 一个小生物躲在岩石后面。它的样子像你们与之战斗的那些东西，只是很小，而且在哭。你的小队靠近时它缩了一下，然后远远地跟在后面。

English: Walk it to the rift's heart
Here the rain falls toward the sky, slow and warm, and collects in the air above your heads like a lake seen from underneath.
简体中文: 这里的雨朝天空落去，缓慢而温暖，在你们头顶的空中聚集，就像从下方看到的湖。

English: A pillar of glass stands in the rift, cracked and empty. Scratched into its base: a name, and the Accord's oath. Whoever held this post let go a long time ago.
简体中文: 一根玻璃柱立在裂隙中，开裂而空荡。底座上刻着：一个名字，和盟约的誓言。守着这个岗位的人很久以前就放手了。
每位英雄回复10%生命 · +2声望

English: The salt carts want guards as far as the river ford. Nobody expects trouble, which is when it comes.
简体中文: 盐车要人护送到河边浅滩。没人预料会出事，而麻烦往往就在这时找上门。

English: Something is eating the miller's grain and he would rather not find out what.
简体中文: 有东西在偷吃磨坊主的粮食，他宁可不知道那是什么。

English: The Crown pays a surveyor's fee to anyone who walks the old border and counts what is still standing.
简体中文: 王冠会付一笔测量费，给任何走完旧边界、清点出仍然矗立之物的人。

English: Lights over the marsh have drowned three fishermen this month. The village has a purse for whoever puts them out.
简体中文: 沼泽上的鬼火这个月已经淹死了三个渔夫。村里凑了一笔赏钱，给能把它们熄灭的人。

English: Bandits took the bridge toll and went to ground in the quarry. Bring the chest back and keep a share.
简体中文: 强盗抢走了桥上的过路费，躲进了采石场。把箱子带回来，你可以留一份。

English: The old Accord road runs under the floodwater now. A merchant house wants it mapped before their rivals do.
简体中文: 古老的盟约大道如今沉在洪水之下。一家商行想抢在对手之前把它绘成地图。
劫下空洞的什一税驳船

English: A barge carries rift-glass up the river for the Hollow's buyers. It is guarded, and it is worth it.
简体中文: 一艘驳船沿河运送裂隙玻璃，交给空洞的买家。船上有守卫，但值得一抢。

English: A scholar swears an old guild vault lies under the burned chapel. The last party that went down came back two short.
简体中文: 一位学者发誓，烧毁的礼拜堂下面有一座旧公会宝库。上一支下去的小队，回来时少了两个人。

English: no rarity floor on the starting relic
简体中文: 初始遗物无稀有度下限

English: Forks offer elite fights more often.
The mildest hazards are skipped: every hazard is at least Moderate (at least Severe at SSS).
简体中文: 最轻微的险境被跳过：每个险境至少为中等（SSS时至少为严重）。

English: Forks offer a shop less often.
简体中文: 岔路提供商店的频率降低。

English: The starting relic can be any rarity, even Common.
简体中文: 初始遗物可以是任何稀有度，甚至是普通。

English: The boss uses two of its mechanics at once.
简体中文: 首领同时使用其两种机制。

English: Mentors: new recruits join 1 level higher

简体中文: 老兵教官：英雄获得经验+20%

English: -15% recovery time; a bed at Lv1/3/5
简体中文: 恢复时间-15%；在1/3/5级各增加一张床

English: Order: Supply Drop — heal the party 35% between fights
简体中文: 命令：补给空投——战斗之间为小队回复35%生命

English: Field Triage: once per rift, get a downed hero back up
简体中文: 战地分诊：每个裂隙一次，让一名倒下的英雄重新站起

English: Wounded heroes heal fully after every run
简体中文: 负伤的英雄在每次远征后完全康复

English: a Training Yard slot every 2 levels; +4% party damage and +4% max HP
简体中文: 每2级增加一个训练场位置；小队伤害+4%，最大生命+4%

English: Order: Rally — the party acts first this round and hits 30% harder
简体中文: 命令：集结——本回合小队先手行动，伤害提高30%

English: Vanguard: a fight's first strike deals +25% damage
简体中文: 先锋：战斗的第一击伤害+25%

English: Abilities are ready at the start of every fight
简体中文: 每场战斗开始时技能已就绪

English: Energy extraction: elites often drop bonus Essence
简体中文: 能量萃取：精英常掉落额外精华

English: Resonance: bosses drop an Essence cache
简体中文: 共鸣：首领掉落精华宝藏

English: Anchor: the first hazard of each rift is negated
简体中文: 锚定：每个裂隙的第一个险境无效

English: Hazards can't knock a hero out
+1 feast seat; -6% shop prices, -2% auction fees, +5% Rift Cache chance
简体中文: +1宴席座位；商店价格-6%，拍卖费用-2%，裂隙宝藏几率+5%

English: Order: Requisition — reroll a fight's loot choices
简体中文: 命令：征用——重抽战斗的战利品选项

English: Black Market: Rift Caches hold 30% more Gold
简体中文: 黑市：裂隙宝藏中的金币增加30%

English: Every rift shop offers a unique relic
简体中文: 每家裂隙商店都提供一件独特遗物

English: Recruit board: +1 offer at Lv1 and Lv4
简体中文: 招募板：1级和4级时+1个人选

English: Order: Scout Ahead — reroll the next fork's paths
简体中文: 命令：先行侦察——重抽下一个岔路的路线

English: Headhunter: every recruit refresh has a Rank C+ hero
简体中文: 猎头：每次刷新招募都有一名阶级C+英雄

English: +10% Gold and Essence for holding a breach
简体中文: 守住裂口获得的金币和精华+10%

English: A lost defense damages one building at most
简体中文: 防御失败最多损坏一座建筑

English: +1 day of warning before a rift breaks
+1 equipped relic slot at Lv1, Lv3 and Lv5
Treatments and respecs cost 10% less; salvage returns 10% more Essence
简体中文: 治疗和重置便宜10%；分解多返还10%精华

English: Heal every standing hero 35% of their max HP.
简体中文: 为每位站立的英雄回复其最大生命35%的生命。

English: This round the party acts before every foe and hits 30% harder.
简体中文: 本回合小队先于所有敌人行动，伤害提高30%。
重抽本场战斗的战利品选项。

English: Reroll the paths on the next fork.
简体中文: 重抽下一个岔路的路线。

English: Contracts pay 15% less Gold, and heroes ask 15% lower wages.
简体中文: 契约金币减少15%，英雄要求的薪水降低15%。

English: Rift fights pay 20% more Gold, and shop prices are 15% higher.
简体中文: 裂隙战斗金币增加20%，商店价格提高15%。

English: Foes there have 20% more health, and its rifts pay 25% more Essence.
简体中文: 那里的敌人生命增加20%，其裂隙精华增加25%。

English: One Medical Bay bed fewer (never none), and feasts lift morale twice as much.
简体中文: 医疗所少一张床（不会为零），宴席提升的士气翻倍。

English: Riftbreaks come 2 days sooner, and holding one pays double.
简体中文: 裂隙崩溃提前2天到来，守住一次报酬翻倍。

English: Two more recruits on the board, and the rival signs your best offer twice as often.
简体中文: 招募板上多两名新兵，对手抢签你最好人选的频率翻倍。

English: Echoes turn up twice as often, and a kept echo gives half the Essence.
简体中文: 回响出现的频率翻倍，保留回响获得的精华减半。

English: The rival writes every week, and every letter tells its version of the Night of Breaking; its Renown comes 10% faster.
简体中文: 对手每周来信，每封信都讲述它所知的破碎之夜；其声望增长加快10%。

English: The rival gains Renown 15% faster and you 10% faster, and the monthly contest pays double.
简体中文: 对手声望增长加快15%，你加快10%，每月竞赛报酬翻倍。

English: It goes after your heroes more than anything.
It dares you more than anything.
It goes after your contracts more than anything.

The Vale split open on the Night of Breaking, and it has not closed since. Rifts bleed monsters into the farmland. The largest breach belongs to Vaelith, and the villages say she wears the green of an Accord ranger. Seal it, and find out why.
简体中文: 山谷在破碎之夜被撕裂，此后再未合拢。裂隙向农田中涌出怪物。最大的裂口属于Vaelith，村民说她穿着盟约游侠的绿衣。封印它，查明原因。

English: Vaelith falls back through the Breach, and it seals behind her. Under her cloak was an Accord badge with the oath scratched out: she was one of them, and she left her post. Whatever the old guilds did that night, someone has been undoing it. Greater Rifts are open to your guild.
简体中文: Vaelith退回裂口，裂口在她身后封闭。她斗篷下有一枚盟约徽章，誓言已被刮去：她曾是他们中的一员，并离开了岗位。无论旧公会那一夜做了什么，一直有人在将其撤销。大型裂隙已向你的公会开放。

English: South of the Vale the marshes have risen, and Nyxara's spire rises with them. Before it drowned, the Spire was the Accord's archive: every contract, every name, every oath. Nyxara keeps it now, with a light burning at the bottom. The villages will only trust a guild that has proven itself.
简体中文: 山谷以南沼泽水位上涨，Nyxara的尖塔也随之升起。尖塔被淹没之前是盟约的档案馆：每一份契约、每一个名字、每一条誓言。如今由Nyxara看守，塔底燃着一盏灯。村民们只信任证明过自己的公会。

English: The Spire crumbles into the black water, and Nyxara with it. One book survived the archive, in the Grandmaster's hand, and it says the guilds did not fall that night. They made a bargain. Beneath the Spire, something vast stirs: a rift with no bottom, lit by pillars of light. The Endless Rift is open to your guild.
简体中文: 尖塔崩落进黑水之中，Nyxara也随之而去。档案中只有一本书幸存，是大团长的手迹，书中说那一夜各公会并没有陨落。他们做了一笔交易。尖塔之下，某种庞然之物在蠢动：一个没有底的裂隙，被光柱照亮。无尽裂隙已向你的公会开放。

English: Seal 2 rifts of Rank C or higher
简体中文: 封印2个阶级C或更高的裂隙

English: Every rift you've sealed led here. At the heart of the rift network sits Sythrane in a crown of ash, guarded by Korrath and Drevok, once her wardens. The Grandmaster's book names her plainly: Sythrane, Grandmaster of the Accord. She made the bargain. Every breach in the world is one of her guilds letting go, and every one feeds her.
简体中文: 你封印的每个裂隙都通向这里。在裂隙网络的中心，Sythrane头戴灰烬之冠端坐，由Korrath和Drevok守护，他们曾是她的守卫。大团长的书直截了当地写出了她的名字：Sythrane，盟约大团长。是她做了那笔交易。世上的每一道裂口都是她的一个公会放了手，每一道都在供养她。

English: The Ashen Crown shatters. Sythrane's last words are not a threat but a warning: someone has to hold the Hollow shut, and she was tired. One by one the rifts fall quiet, and for the first time in years the sky is only sky. In the Endless Rift the pillars of light are still holding. Your guild's name will be told for generations. (The rifts never fully close: Endless, the rift ladder and the quests carry on.)
简体中文: 灰烬王冠碎裂了。Sythrane的遗言不是威胁，而是警告：必须有人把空洞封住，而她累了。裂隙一个接一个安静下来，多年来第一次，天空只是天空。在无尽裂隙中，光柱仍在坚守。你的公会之名将传颂数代。（裂隙永远不会完全关闭：无尽模式、裂隙阶梯和任务仍将继续。）

English: The Terms, in the Grandmaster's shape
简体中文: 化作大团长之形的条款

English: With Sythrane gone, the Hollow has no one to bargain with, so it is bargaining with the posts directly. One by one the pillars in the Endless Rift are flickering. The Accord Hall lies below them, and in it the Terms that started all of this, wearing the Grandmaster's face. Every post that has gone dark makes them stronger. Someone will have to read them out loud.
简体中文: Sythrane消失后，空洞没有了谈判对象，便直接与岗位谈判。无尽裂隙中的光柱一根接一根地闪烁。盟约大厅就在它们之下，里面是引发这一切的条款，戴着大团长的面孔。每一个熄灭的岗位都让它们更强。总得有人把它们大声念出来。

English: The Terms come apart into forty-one lines of old ink, and the Hall goes quiet. The posts are listening. The bargain needs a last signature, or a fire. Your guild has to choose.
简体中文: 条款崩解成四十一行旧墨迹，大厅安静下来。岗位在聆听。这笔交易需要最后一个签名，或一把火。你的公会必须做出选择。

English: Free a lost champion from a pillar
简体中文: 从石柱中解放一位失落的勇者

English: Find every page of the Grandmaster's ledger
简体中文: 找到大团长账簿的每一页

English: Under the Accord Hall the Endless Rift has a floor now, and the floor is glass. Below it is a shore the sky comes down to meet: sea-glass sand, tides that fall upward, and the villages of the Hollow's people, who were never only monsters. Their sky is falling. The Tidewarden has kept this shore since the Terms were signed. Find out what the Grandmaster promised them.
简体中文: 盟约大厅之下，无尽裂隙如今有了底，而底是玻璃。底下是一片天空降下来与之相接的海岸：海玻璃沙滩、向上退去的潮汐，以及空洞居民的村庄——他们从来不只是怪物。他们的天空正在坠落。自条款签订以来，潮汐守卫一直看守着这片海岸。查明大团长向他们许诺了什么。

English: The Tidewarden kneels in the glass and lays down a key shaped like a wave. The bargain, it says, was simple: the Vale would hold its doors shut, and the Hollow would not knock. It has kept its side for twenty years while its sky came down. Beyond the shore, the last city of the Hollow hangs upside down from the falling sky.
简体中文: 潮汐守卫跪在玻璃上，放下一把形如波浪的钥匙。它说，交易很简单：山谷关紧自己的门，空洞就不来敲门。二十年来它一直守着自己这边的约定，而它的天空在不断坠落。海岸之外，空洞的最后一座城市倒挂在坠落的天空下。

English: Seal 3 rifts on the Glass Coast
简体中文: 在玻璃海岸封印3个裂隙

English: The Inverted City hangs over nothing by cords as thick as towers, and they are fraying one by one. If it falls, both worlds crack along the same line. Its gate is the only door the Hollow's people have left, and something comes up the cords at night to close it. Hold the gate, and climb to the Falling Sky.
简体中文: 倒悬之城悬在虚空之上，靠的是粗如高塔的绳索，而它们正一根接一根地磨断。若它坠落，两个世界都会沿同一条线裂开。它的大门是空洞居民仅剩的门，夜里有东西沿着绳索爬上来要关上它。守住大门，攀向陨落之天。

English: The Falling Sky is not a creature. It is what the city's sky became when it stopped believing it could stay up, and when it breaks, it breaks into light. The cords hold, for now. Every door between the worlds is in your guild's hands.
简体中文: 陨落之天不是一个生物。它是城市的天空在不再相信自己能撑住时变成的东西，而它破碎时，碎成了光。绳索暂时撑住了。两个世界之间的每一扇门都掌握在你的公会手中。

English: Seal 3 rifts in the Inverted City
简体中文: 在倒悬之城封印3个裂隙

English: Wen finds the last page of the Grandmaster's ledger stuck to the back cover, in a hand neither of them knows. It is a reply. "We accept your Terms. Hold your doors, and we will not come through them. Our sky is falling. We will not ask again." Hesper reads it twice and puts on her coat.
简体中文: Wen在大团长账簿的封底内侧发现了粘着的最后一页，笔迹他们俩都不认识。是一封回信。"我们接受你们的条款。守住你们的门，我们就不会穿过它们。我们的天空在坠落。我们不会再问第二次。"Hesper读了两遍，穿上了外套。

English: Far below, the forty-first post hears knocking from underneath. %s asks the guild to answer it.
简体中文: 在极深的下方，第四十一号岗位听到了来自底下的敲门声。%s请公会去回应。

English: Not everything that came up with the tides was hunting. Some of it was running.
简体中文: 随潮汐涌上来的并不都在狩猎。有些是在逃。

English: The posts are held in turns now. Your guild is the first that can go down, and come back.
简体中文: 岗位现在轮班坚守了。你的公会是第一个能下去、还能回来的公会。

English: Five of them, holding hands in a line, the smallest at the back. In this air their edges have already started to go wrong: too many joints, a shine to the skin. The eldest says the only word of ours she knows. It is please.
简体中文: 五个人，手拉手排成一列，最小的在最后。在这里的空气中，他们的轮廓已经开始走样：关节太多，皮肤泛着光。最年长的那位说出了她唯一会的一个我们的词。是“求你了”。

English: A man with glass where his fingers should be. He was a glassblower, he says, and the air on this side is turning his hands into his work. He would like to come through before it finishes.
简体中文: 一个手指变成了玻璃的男人。他说他曾是吹玻璃匠，而这边的空气正把他的手变成他的作品。他想在变完之前过来。

English: Nine voices on the other side of the door, singing in our language, badly. They learned the song from a guild that came down twenty years ago and never went home. They would like to sing it for you in the Vale.
简体中文: 门的另一边有九个声音，用我们的语言歌唱，唱得很糟。他们是从二十年前下来、再也没回家的一个公会那里学的这首歌。他们想在山谷为你唱这首歌。

English: You have heard of her: the small one who waited behind a rock for someone to come through the rift for her. Nobody came. She is grown now, and she is done waiting.
简体中文: 你听说过她：那个躲在岩石后面、等着有人穿过裂隙来接她的小家伙。没有人来。如今她长大了，不想再等了。
