English: Every door between the worlds is in your guild's hands. Prop the city and keep the doors open, with keepers on both sides, and the Hollow's people can choose where to live. Or close them all, and let the far side fall quietly, the way it has been falling for twenty years.
简体中文: 两个世界之间的每一扇门都掌握在你的公会手中。撑住城市，让门敞开，两边都有守门人，空洞的居民就可以选择在哪里生活。或者把门全部关上，让彼岸静静坠落，就像它二十年来一直在坠落那样。

English:
The city holds, barely, on new cords your guild helped tie. The rifts become doors with keepers on both sides, and the first of the Hollow's people come up through them carrying everything they own. Some of them ask for work.

(Hollow-born heroes now join the recruit board, in this guild and every guild after it.)
简体中文:
城市勉强撑住了，靠的是你的公会帮忙系上的新绳索。裂隙变成了两边都有守门人的门，第一批空洞的居民带着全部家当从门里上来。其中一些人来找活干。

（空洞出生的英雄现在会出现在招募板上，在本公会及之后的每个公会中。）

English:
Your guild closes the doors one by one, from the glass shore to the city's gate. The far side falls quietly. The rifts heal over in a season. Some nights the new stars show low on the horizon, for a moment, and then not.

(+10 Laurels for this guild's legacy. The Hollow's foes no longer appear on the ladder.)
简体中文:
你的公会从玻璃海岸到城市大门，一扇接一扇地关上了门。彼岸静静坠落。一季之内，裂隙便愈合了。有些夜晚，新的星星会在地平线低处出现片刻，然后消失。

（本公会传承+10桂冠。空洞的敌人不再出现在阶梯上。）

English: Win %d fight%s without a hero going down
简体中文: 赢得%d场战斗%s且无英雄倒下

English: First Blood — seal your first Rift
简体中文: 初次见血——封印你的第一个裂隙
怪物猎人——累计击败25个怪物
精英杀手——赢得3场精英战
工匠——制作3件物品或遗物

English: Full Roster — fill every hero slot
简体中文: 满员名册——填满所有英雄栏位

English: Guild of the Realm — top the Guild Standings in Renown
简体中文: 王国公会——在公会声望排行中位居榜首

English: Renowned Guild — reach Renowned Guild tier
简体中文: 显赫公会——达到显赫公会等级

English: Greater Threat — open the Rank C rift
简体中文: 更大的威胁——开启阶级C裂隙

English: The Vale Holds — complete Act I
Out of the Marshes — complete Act II
Keeper of the Accord — complete the campaign
Untouched — seal 5 rifts with no one knocked out
简体中文: 毫发无伤——封印5个裂隙且无人被击倒

English: Climber — reach floor 25 of the Tower
简体中文: 攀登者——到达试炼之塔第25层

English: Summit — clear floor 100 of the Tower
简体中文: 登顶——通关试炼之塔第100层

English: Beyond the Edge — survive 10 minutes in the Endless Rift
简体中文: 越过边缘——在无尽裂隙中存活10分钟

English: Daily Duty — seal a rift with the daily twist
简体中文: 每日职责——以每日变奏封印一个裂隙

English: Dedicated — seal the daily twist 7 days in a row
简体中文: 坚持不懈——连续7天完成每日变奏封印

English: Build Complete — own a 4-piece boon set
简体中文: 构筑完成——拥有一套4件的恩赐套装

English: Legendary Guild — reach Legendary Guild tier
简体中文: 传奇公会——达到传奇公会等级

English: Paragon — raise a hero to Level 10
简体中文: 典范——将一名英雄提升到10级

English: Great Hall — have 10 heroes on the roster
简体中文: 宏伟大厅——名册上有10名英雄

English: Seal the small rifts, %s. Leave the real ones to us.
简体中文: 去封印那些小裂隙吧，%s。真正的裂隙交给我们。

English: %s pays its heroes in promises, I hear.
简体中文: 听说%s用承诺给英雄发薪水。

English: Our recruits ask about %s. Then they sign with us.
简体中文: 我们的新兵会打听%s。然后就跟我们签约了。

English: Tell %s the quest board isn't a charity.
简体中文: 告诉%s，任务板不是慈善机构。

English: We'll send flowers when %s closes its doors.

For three hundred years the guilds of the Accord kept the rifts shut. They swore one oath: close what opens, share what you find, never sell a rift. Then, in a single night, every rift in the Vale opened at once, and every Accord guild went in. None of them came back. By morning their halls stood empty.

The villages still need a guild. They have yours.
简体中文:
三百年来，盟约的各公会一直让裂隙保持关闭。他们立下同一条誓言：关闭打开之物，分享所获之物，绝不出卖裂隙。然后，在一夜之间，山谷中的每一道裂隙同时打开，每一个盟约公会都走了进去。没有一个回来。到早上，他们的大厅已空无一人。

村庄仍然需要一个公会。他们有了你的公会。

English: The world sits on a thin crust. Under it is the Hollow, where things that never got to happen pile up: unfinished storms, roads never built, beasts that almost were. A rift is a crack in the crust, and what comes through is the Hollow trying on a shape. It copies what it finds, which is why each region's monsters look like that region.
简体中文: 世界坐落在一层薄薄的地壳上。地壳之下是空洞，那里堆积着从未有机会发生的事物：未完成的风暴、从未修建的道路、差一点就存在的野兽。裂隙是地壳上的裂缝，从中涌出的是空洞在试穿某种形状。它模仿它找到的东西，所以每个地区的怪物都长得像那个地区。

English: When the Hollow touches air it hardens into crystal. Essence is unfinished possibility: put it into a hero and they grow into what they might have been, into a building and it becomes its better self, into a relic and it wakes. Gold pays people. Essence changes things.
简体中文: 空洞接触空气时会凝固成晶体。精华是未完成的可能性：注入英雄，他们就会长成本可能成为的样子；注入建筑，它会成为更好的自己；注入遗物，它会苏醒。金币用来付给人。精华用来改变事物。

English: The oath of the old guilds: close what opens, share what you find, never sell a rift. The villages paid the guilds that swore it, and for three hundred years the crust held. Renown is the villages' trust; the best recruits go where it is.
简体中文: 旧公会的誓言：关闭打开之物，分享所获之物，绝不出卖裂隙。村庄供养立下誓言的公会，三百年来地壳一直完好。声望就是村庄的信任；最好的新兵会去声望所在之处。

English: Every hero who joins a guild is measured once on the Assay stone, by how much Essence they can hold without breaking: F to S. Rifts are measured on the same scale, so a Rank C rift is one a Rank C hero can stand in. SS and SSS were added after the Night of Breaking, by clerks who had run out of letters.
简体中文: 每位加入公会的英雄都会在勘测石上测量一次，依据是他们能承载多少精华而不崩溃：从F到S。裂隙也以同样的尺度衡量，所以阶级C裂隙就是阶级C英雄能站得住的裂隙。SS和SSS是在破碎之夜之后，由用完了字母的书记员们加上的。

English: The Accord trained fighters in five Paths: the Shield (warriors), the Bow (rangers), the Word (mages), the Vow (clerics) and the Knife (rogues). Below Rank B the Path is all a hero is. From Rank B there is enough Essence in them that it settles into a shape of its own, and the Path forks into a calling.
简体中文: 盟约以五条道路训练战士：盾（战士）、弓（游侠）、言（法师）、誓（牧师）和刃（盗贼）。阶级B以下，道路就是英雄的全部。从阶级B起，他们体内的精华足以凝成自己的形状，道路便分化为一种天命。

English: Every rift in the Vale opened at once, deeper than the Assay could measure, and every Accord guild answered. None came back. The new companies that took charters afterward never swore the Accord. Yours can choose to keep it.
简体中文: 山谷中的每一道裂隙同时打开，深到勘测石无法测量，每一个盟约公会都响应了。没有一个回来。之后获得特许状的新团体从未宣誓加入盟约。你的公会可以选择守护它。

English: Under Vaelith's cloak was an Accord ranger's badge with the oath scratched out. She held a post on the Night of Breaking and walked away from it. The great Breach in the Vale was the post she left.
简体中文: Vaelith的斗篷下有一枚盟约游侠的徽章，誓言已被刮去。破碎之夜她守着一个岗位，然后离开了。山谷中那道巨大的裂口，就是她离开的岗位。

English: The guilds did not fall. On the Night of Breaking the Grandmaster of the Accord made a bargain with the Hollow: the strongest of the guilds would stand in the cracks and let the Hollow harden around them, and the Hollow would stay below. The pillars of light in the Endless Rift are those posts, still holding.
简体中文: 各公会并没有陨落。破碎之夜，盟约大团长与空洞做了一笔交易：最强的公会成员站进裂缝，让空洞在他们周围凝固，空洞则留在下面。无尽裂隙中的光柱就是那些岗位，至今仍在坚守。

English: Sythrane was the Grandmaster. The bargain asked for forty-one posts, and she would not take the last one herself. The Hollow crowned her instead, and every post that tired and let go fed her. With her gone the rifts are quiet. The posts are still holding, and someone will have to relieve them.
简体中文: Sythrane就是大团长。交易要求四十一个岗位，而她不愿亲自守最后一个。于是空洞为她加冕，每一个疲惫放手的岗位都在供养她。她消失后，裂隙安静了。岗位仍在坚守，总得有人去换岗。

English: Day 1. The Hollow is rising faster than we can close it. The Assay has no mark for what came through at Thornwood. I have called every guild to the Hall.
简体中文: 第1天。空洞上涨的速度比我们关闭的速度更快。荆棘林涌出来的东西，勘测石上没有对应的刻度。我已将所有公会召集到大厅。

English: Day 3. A voice answered from the deepest rift. It offered terms. I wrote them down so that I could refuse them properly.
简体中文: 第3天。最深的裂隙中有个声音回应了。它提出了条款。我把它们记了下来，好好地拒绝它们。

English: Day 9. Forty posts: forty of our strongest, standing in the cracks, held by the Hollow's own hardening. In return it stays below. I have not refused.
简体中文: 第9天。四十个岗位：我们最强的四十人站在裂缝中，被空洞自身的凝固所固定。作为回报，它留在下面。我没有拒绝。

English: Day 10. Lots drawn. Brannoch asked for the deepest post and I let him. I told them all I would come back for them myself.
简体中文: 第10天。抽签完毕。Brannoch请求驻守最深的岗位，我答应了他。我告诉他们所有人，我会亲自回来接他们。

English: Day 11. Vaelith asked who holds the Grandmaster's post. I said the Grandmaster keeps the ledger. That was not an answer, and she knew it.
简体中文: 第11天。Vaelith问谁守大团长的岗位。我说大团长掌管账簿。这不是答案，她也知道。

English: The Night. Every post is taken but mine. The terms say forty-one. The Hollow can count.
简体中文: 那一夜。除了我的，每个岗位都有人了。条款上写的是四十一。空洞会数数。

English: After. The Hollow came for the forty-first and found me ready to make a different bargain. It gives me a crown. I give it the posts, one at a time, as they tire. It is slower than refusing. That is all I wanted: more time.
简体中文: 后来，空洞为第四十一个岗位而来，却发现我已准备好另做一笔交易。它给我一顶王冠，我把岗位一个个交给它，待它们疲惫之时。这比拒绝要慢。我想要的不过如此：更多时间。

English:
The Crown will return to the Vale. A single Royal Charter will go to the company that has done the most to close the rifts: every contract, for a generation. Until then, all chartered companies compete on equal terms.

The loudest of them, %s, led by %s, has noticed your guild.
简体中文:
王冠将重返山谷。唯一一份王室特许状将授予在封闭裂隙上功劳最大的团体：一代人的所有契约。在此之前，所有获特许的团体平等竞争。

其中声势最大的%s，由%s率领，已经注意到了你的公会。

English: %s fights like one of mine. I'd rather ask than steal, so I'm asking: let them come, or pay them what they're worth. No hard feelings either way. — O. Venn
简体中文: %s打起仗来像我的人。我宁可开口也不愿偷，所以我开口了：放他们过来，或者付他们应得的报酬。怎样都不伤和气。— O. Venn

English: Seal a Rank %s rift before payday. If you do, I'll say so to the herald. If you don't, I'll say that too. — O. Venn
简体中文: 在发薪日前封印一座%s阶裂隙。做到了，我会告诉传令官；做不到，我也会告诉他。— O. Venn

English: That contract is on the board and we can do it. So can you, maybe. First to sign it keeps it. — O. Venn
简体中文: 那份契约就在告示板上，我们能接。你们也许也能。先签者得。— O. Venn

English: Good work this week, %s. Do better next week.
简体中文: 这周干得不错，%s。下周再好点。

English: The Chorus sings about the rifts it has closed. %s hums.
简体中文: 钢铁合唱团歌颂自己封闭的裂隙。%s只会哼哼。

English: %s keeps its word. I'll give them that. I'll give them nothing else.
简体中文: %s说话算话，这点我承认。别的我一概不认。

English: We can't train heroes like %s; we haven't the Gold. We can pay them, though, for a few weeks at least. They'll be happy. Probably. — Kael
简体中文: 我们培养不出%s那样的英雄，没那么多金币。但我们付得起薪水，至少撑几周。他们会高兴的。大概吧。— Kael

English: Rank %s by payday. We did one last week. Barely. Your turn. — Kael
简体中文: 发薪日前拿下%s阶。我们上周拿下过一座，险得很。轮到你们了。— Kael

English: We need that contract more than you do. I'm not proud of saying so. I'm saying it anyway. — Kael
简体中文: 我们比你们更需要那份契约。说这话我不光彩，但我还是要说。— Kael

English: The Wolves are hungry and %s is fat. Draw your own conclusions.
简体中文: 狼群饿了，而%s正肥。你自己琢磨吧。

English: Someday the Wolves will have a hall like %s's. With a roof.
简体中文: 总有一天狼群也会有%s那样的大厅。带屋顶的。

English: %s had a good week. We ate.
简体中文: %s这周过得不错。我们有饭吃了。

English: Your %s has a good eye and a poor wage. I have the opposite problem. I'm sure we can come to an arrangement. — Vane
简体中文: 你的%s眼光好，薪水差。我正好相反。我相信我们能谈出个结果。— Vane

English: A Rank %s rift by payday, if your guild can manage it. Mine could, in its sleep. It frequently does. — Vane
简体中文: 如果你的公会办得到，就在发薪日前拿下一座%s阶裂隙。我的公会睡着都能办到，而且经常如此。— Vane

English: The Lance will be taking that contract. Do not trouble yourselves. — Ser Aldric Vane
简体中文: 那份契约由长枪团接手。诸位不必费心。— Ser Aldric Vane

English: The Charter will hang in the Lance's hall. I have already chosen the frame.
简体中文: 特许状将挂在长枪团的大厅里。框我都选好了。

English: %s has been unhappy, child. I notice these things. Pay them, or I will, and then we'll both know who listens. — Mother Ilse
简体中文: %s近来不太开心，孩子。这些事我都看在眼里。付他们钱，否则我来付，到时候我们都知道谁更会倾听。— Mother Ilse

English: I've told the taverns you can seal a Rank %s rift by payday. Don't make an old woman a liar. — Ilse
简体中文: 我已经告诉各家酒馆，你能在发薪日前封印一座%s阶裂隙。别让老太婆当骗子。— Ilse

English: The Wolves will try for this one tomorrow. Take it first and I'll know you can be trusted with better news. Let it go and I'll take it, and I'll know that too. — Ilse
简体中文: 狼群明天要去争这一单。你先拿下，我就知道能把更好的消息托付给你。你放手，我就拿走，我也会记住这点。— Ilse

English: Mother Ilse sends her regards to %s, and a small bill.
简体中文: Ilse嬷嬷向%s问好，附上一张小账单。

English: Everyone owes the Lantern something. %s just doesn't know what yet.
简体中文: 人人都欠末灯会点什么。%s只是还不知道欠了什么。

English: The Lantern hears %s is short this week. The Lantern lends.
简体中文: 末灯会听说%s这周手头紧。末灯会放贷。

English: %s deserves a company that values them. Ours does: twice the wage, half the danger. I can't explain the half. Trade secret. — Capt. Morrow
简体中文: %s值得一个珍惜他们的团体。我们就是：双倍薪水，一半风险。那一半我解释不了，商业机密。— Morrow队长

English: Rank %s by payday? A friendly wager. There is always another rift, after all. We make sure of it. — Morrow
简体中文: 发薪日前拿下%s阶？友好地赌一把。毕竟裂隙永远还有下一座，我们保证如此。— Morrow

English: We'll take this one off your hands. Plenty of work for everyone; there always seems to be, near us. — Morrow
简体中文: 这单我们替你接了。活儿人人有份，在我们附近总是不缺。— Morrow

English: Plenty of work for everyone, %s. There always is.
简体中文: 活儿人人有份，%s。永远都有。

English: The Company wishes %s a quiet week. Truly.
简体中文: 佣兵团祝%s度过平静的一周。真心的。

English: Captain Morrow sent %s a bottle of good wine. No note.
简体中文: Morrow队长给%s送来一瓶好酒。没有附言。

English: First payday. I'm Dobbs; I keep the books. The one with the ink is Wen.
简体中文: 第一个发薪日。我是Dobbs，管账的。手上沾墨水的那个是Wen。

English: I write down what happens. Try to make it worth writing.
简体中文: 我负责记下发生的事。尽量让它值得记。

English: And I'm the old woman who was here before both of them. Pay your heroes and they'll stay.
简体中文: 我是在他们俩之前就在这儿的老太婆。按时付英雄薪水，他们就会留下。

English: Unpaid twice, or miserable. Usually both.
简体中文: 两次没拿到薪水，或者过得太苦。通常两样都有。

English: I'll write that they left. I won't write why. That's yours to fix.
简体中文: 我会写下他们离开了，不会写为什么。那得由你来解决。

English: I've added a name to the Memorial.
简体中文: 我在纪念碑上添了一个名字。

English: Say it out loud once. It helps.
I'll take them off the payroll. Quietly.
简体中文: 我会把他们从薪水名单上划掉。悄悄地。

English: We're short. I want that written down, Wen.
简体中文: 我们钱不够。Wen，我要你记下来。

English: It's written down. It was written down last week, too.
The herald wrote our name first this week.
简体中文: 这周传令官把我们的名字写在了第一位。

English: The vault is full. I don't trust it.
Spend it on the heroes, then. Gold never closed a rift.
简体中文: 那就花在英雄身上。金币从没封闭过裂隙。

English: Gold paid the ones who did.
简体中文: 但金币付给了封闭裂隙的人。

English: These ledger pages. Hesper, did you know the Grandmaster?
简体中文: 这些账簿残页……Hesper，你认识大团长吗？

English: Everyone knew her. Nobody knew her.
简体中文: 人人都认识她。没人了解她。

English: It's the only one she ever gave.
简体中文: 这是她给过的唯一回答。

English: It's the best kind. You'll learn.
简体中文: 这是最好的那种。你会明白的。

English: Hesper, what were the old guilds like?
简体中文: Hesper，以前的公会是什么样的？
更吵闹，薪水更高，都没了。

English: Wages, upkeep, and a bill for a broken door.
简体中文: 薪水、维护费，还有一张修破门的账单。

English: The one someone kicked in after the last rift. I'm not saying who.
简体中文: 上次裂隙回来后被人踹坏的那扇。我不说是谁。

English: I sat the Assay at sixteen. The stone barely glowed.
简体中文: 我十六岁参加测阶，石头几乎没亮。

English: F. I'm still here. Most of the S's aren't.
简体中文: F。我还在这儿。大多数S阶的都不在了。

English: I need another word for 'rift'. I've used it four hundred times.
简体中文: 我需要“裂隙”的另一个说法。我已经用了四百次了。

English: The recruits ask what the Accord was.
Tell them it was a promise. Tell them we're keeping it.
简体中文: 告诉他们那是一个承诺。告诉他们我们在守着它。

English: {guild} paid on the seventh, too. Rain or not.
You never said you knew them.
简体中文: 你从没说过你认识他们。

English: You never asked who taught you the pay table.
简体中文: 你也从没问过是谁教你看薪水表的。

English: Someone left flowers under the {guild} banner.
简体中文: 有人在{guild}的旗帜下放了花。

English: Nobody. That's how you know they mean it.
简体中文: 没人。所以你知道他们是真心的。

English: {guild} spent less on feasts than we do.
I hate it when the books agree with you.
简体中文: 我讨厌账本站在你那边。

English: {hero} is all over the old {guild} ledgers. Rift after rift.
简体中文: {hero}的名字遍布{guild}的旧账簿。一座裂隙接一座。

English: {hero} carried me home from the Marches once. Don't write that down.
简体中文: {hero}有一次把我从沼泽背回家。别记下来。

English: Who goes down to the forty-first post now that {guild} is gone?
简体中文: {guild}不在了，现在谁去第四十一个岗位？

English: We do. Once a year, on the Night of Breaking.
简体中文: 我们去。每年一次，在破碎之夜。

English: I'll put it in the ledger. No charge.
The tides got worse after {guild} burned the Terms.
简体中文: {guild}烧掉条款后，潮汐变得更凶了。

English: In my hand. I'd have liked a better pen.
简体中文: 用我的笔迹。我倒希望有支好点的笔。

English: Someone goes down next season. I've budgeted for it.
简体中文: 下一季有人要下去。我已经做了预算。

English: I found our village in the archive. A contract from ninety years ago: three rifts closed, paid in cheese.
简体中文: 我在档案里找到了我们村子。九十年前的一份契约：封闭三座裂隙，报酬是奶酪。

English: Hollin sent a sack of flour. And a bill for the doors.
简体中文: Hollin送来一袋面粉，还有一张修门的账单。

English: Pay the bill. Keep the flour.
I'm writing down that they sent both.
简体中文: 我要记下他们两样都送了。

English: {guild} carried the Accord's archive out of the Spire. I've been reading it for a month.
简体中文: {guild}把盟约的档案从尖塔里搬了出来。我已经读了一个月。

English: Your handwriting. On most of it.
{guild} took Morrow's money, back in the Charter War.
They took a lot of it.
There's a ranger in the {guild} ledgers who never signed for her pay. Just a V.
简体中文: {guild}的账簿里有个游侠从没签收过薪水。只有一个V。
她向来不喜欢文书工作。

English: She never did like being paid, by the look of it.
简体中文: 看样子她也向来不喜欢领薪水。

English: {guild} just stopped. Do guilds do that?
The good ones stop. The rest get stopped.
简体中文: 好的公会会自己停下。其余的会被迫停下。

English: Look at their banner. It's still up.
简体中文: 看他们的旗帜。还挂着呢。

English:
The pillar is dark now. Somewhere in the Vale, a rift that has been quiet for twenty years draws breath. You did the right thing. The Hollow noticed.

(Each champion freed in the Endless Rift brings the next Riftbreak a day sooner.)
简体中文:
石柱暗了下去。山谷某处，一座沉寂二十年的裂隙重新开始呼吸。你做得对。空洞注意到了。

（每在无尽裂隙解放一位勇者，下次裂隙崩溃就提前一天。）

English: The Terms lie open on the floor of the Hall: forty-one lines, forty signed. Sign the last, and one of your heroes takes the forty-first post forever; the rifts close for good. Or burn it, and every post is released at once; the champions come home, and the Hollow comes up with them.
简体中文: 条款摊在大厅地上：四十一行，签了四十个。签下最后一行，你的一位英雄将永远守住第四十一个岗位，裂隙从此关闭。或者烧掉它，所有岗位同时解放：勇者们回家，空洞也随之升起。

English:
The Hall is quiet. Up in the Vale the villagers wake to a morning without a single rift on the horizon, and do not know why. The guild knows. Every year, on the Night of Breaking, someone climbs down to the forty-first post and tells %s how the harvest went.

(Riftbreaks have ended. The Endless Rift, the ladder and the quests carry on.)
简体中文:
大厅一片寂静。山谷里，村民醒来时地平线上再无一座裂隙，却不知为何。公会知道。每年破碎之夜，都有人爬下第四十一个岗位，告诉%s今年收成如何。

（裂隙崩溃已经结束。无尽裂隙、天梯和任务仍将继续。）

English:
The Terms burn green. Forty pillars go out at once, and forty people step into the dark and start walking home. Behind them, the Hollow rises to meet the sky. It will be a hard century. It will be an honest one.

(Every champion of the old guilds is free. Riftbreaks end; a tide of the Hollow breaks every week, stronger for each one you hold.)
简体中文:
条款燃起绿焰。四十根石柱同时熄灭，四十个人走进黑暗，踏上归途。在他们身后，空洞升起，与天相接。这将是艰难的一百年，也将是诚实的一百年。

（旧公会的所有勇者都已自由。裂隙崩溃结束；空洞之潮每周袭来，你每守住一次就更强。）

English:
Your guild writes one more line under the forty-first, in Hesper's hand, because hers is the only one the Terms accept: the posts are held in turns. Every guild in the Hall of Guilds sends someone down for a season, and they come back. The forty in the pillars walk home, and the Hollow stays shut behind the ones who take their place. Nobody holds it alone any more.

(Riftbreaks have ended, every champion of this guild is free, and the old Accord halls can be restored.)
简体中文:
你的公会在第四十一行下又写了一行，用Hesper的笔迹，因为条款只认她的字：岗位轮流值守。公会之殿的每个公会都派人下去守一季，然后回来。石柱中的四十人走回家，空洞在接替者身后紧闭。再没有人独自守着它。

（裂隙崩溃已经结束，本公会的所有勇者都已自由，旧盟约大厅可以修复了。）

English: There is a third way. Hesper's forty-second line is open: rewrite the Terms, and the posts are held in turns.
简体中文: 还有第三条路。Hesper的第四十二行尚未写下：改写条款，岗位轮流值守。

English: Wen finds it while copying the last page: a line in the margin, in a smaller, neater hand than the Grandmaster's. "If a guild ever has to choose, there is a forty-second line. Ask the clerk." Wen asks Hesper who the Grandmaster's clerk was. Hesper says she is tired, and goes to bed before the fire is out.
简体中文: Wen在抄写最后一页时发现了它：页边一行字，笔迹比大团长的更小、更工整。"若有公会不得不做出抉择，还有第四十二行。去问书记官。"Wen问Hesper大团长的书记官是谁。Hesper说她累了，炉火未熄就上床了。

English: "I was the clerk," Hesper says, as if Wen had asked a minute ago and not a guild ago. "I wrote her letters and her contracts, and I wrote the Terms out fair: forty-one lines. The night they were signed, she sent me home with a note that said I had a fever. I kept the note." She puts it on the table. It is in her own hand. "I never told %s. I'm telling you."
简体中文: "我就是那个书记官，"Hesper说，仿佛Wen一分钟前才问过，而不是一整个公会之前。"我替她写信、写契约，还誊清了条款：四十一行。签署那晚，她让我带着一张说我发烧的字条回家。那张字条我留着。"她把字条放在桌上。是她自己的笔迹。"我从没告诉过%s。我现在告诉你。"

English: "There was a line under the forty-first," Hesper says. "She made me leave it blank. It says the Terms can be changed, once, by a guild that has both kept them and broken them, and a guild is everyone who came before it. %s kept them. %s burned them. When you stand in the Accord Hall, you won't have to choose between the two. Write the forty-second line."
简体中文: "第四十一行下面还有一行，"Hesper说，"她让我空着。那一行写着：条款可以修改一次，由一个既守过又破过条款的公会来改，而一个公会包括在它之前的所有人。%s守过条款，%s烧过条款。当你站在盟约大厅时，不必在二者之间抉择。写下第四十二行吧。"

English: "There was a line under the forty-first," Hesper says. "She made me leave it blank. It says the Terms can be changed, once, by a guild that has both kept them and broken them, and a guild is everyone who came before it. None of ours has done both yet. When one has, the line will be waiting."
简体中文: "第四十一行下面还有一行，"Hesper说，"她让我空着。那一行写着：条款可以修改一次，由一个既守过又破过条款的公会来改，而一个公会包括在它之前的所有人。我们的公会还没有哪个两者都做过。等有了，那一行会在那里等着。"

English: Your guild signed the Terms. %s took the forty-first post, and the Hollow stays below. The rifts that remain are old ones, and quiet.
简体中文: 你的公会签署了条款。%s接过了第四十一个岗位，空洞被封在下面。剩下的裂隙都是旧的，而且安静。

English: Your guild burned the Terms. Every post was released, the old guilds came home, and the Hollow came up with them. The rifts are louder now, and nobody holds them shut but the guilds.
简体中文: 你的公会烧掉了条款。所有岗位解放，旧公会回家了，空洞也随之升起。如今裂隙更加喧嚣，只有公会在守着它们。

English: Your guild rewrote the Terms. The posts are held in turns now, a season at a time, by every guild that ever kept the Vale. The champions came home, and the Hollow stayed below.
简体中文: 你的公会改写了条款。如今岗位轮流值守，每次一季，由所有曾守护山谷的公会承担。勇者们回家了，空洞仍封在下面。

English: This Essence will not settle. It keeps the shape of a word. The miller's wife in Hollin heard about it and walked here in the rain: her son went into the Breach on the Night of Breaking, and she cannot remember what she called him.
简体中文: 这份精华无法沉淀，一直保持着一个词的形状。Hollin磨坊主的妻子听说后冒雨走来：她儿子在破碎之夜走进了裂口，而她想不起自己曾怎么叫他。

English: She holds the crystal to her ear, then says the name out loud, twice, as if checking it still fits. She does not thank you. She does not need to.
简体中文: 她把晶体贴在耳边，然后大声念出那个名字，念了两遍，像在确认它还合适。她没有道谢。她不需要。

English: The Essence from the last rift has a street in it: cobbles, a bakery, a blue door. A carter in the village swears it is the street he grew up on, in a town the Vale forgot.
简体中文: 上一座裂隙带回的精华里有一条街：鹅卵石、面包房、一扇蓝门。村里一个车夫发誓那是他长大的街道，在一座被山谷遗忘的小镇里。

English: He walks the street in his head all evening, door by door. In the morning he paints his own door blue.
简体中文: 他整晚都在脑中沿着那条街走，一扇门一扇门地走。第二天早上，他把自家的门漆成了蓝色。

English: This Essence hums. The old women in the village know the tune and none of the words. The words were in the rift.
简体中文: 这份精华在哼唱。村里的老妇人认得曲调，却不记得歌词。歌词留在了裂隙里。

English: By nightfall the whole village is singing it, words and all, a little off-key. Wen writes them down.
简体中文: 到傍晚，全村都在唱，连词带调，有点走音。Wen把歌词记了下来。

English: There is a face in this crystal, young and stern, in an Accord ranger's green. The village elder asks to see it and goes very quiet.
简体中文: 这块晶体里有一张脸，年轻而严肃，穿着盟约游侠的绿衣。村里的长者要来看了看，变得一言不发。

English: 'My sister,' the elder says. 'I had forgotten I had one.' The crystal goes home with them and sits in the window.
简体中文: “我的姐姐，”长者说，“我都忘了我有过姐姐。”晶体随他们回了家，摆在窗台上。

English: This Essence smells of bread. The innkeeper says her grandmother's loaf tasted like this, before the Night took the recipe out of everyone's heads.
简体中文: 这份精华有面包的香味。旅店老板娘说，她祖母烤的面包就是这个味道，后来那一夜把食谱从所有人脑中夺走了。

English: The inn smells of it for a week. Your heroes eat there free for the rest of the month, and nobody counts.
简体中文: 旅店里香了一个星期。你的英雄这个月剩下的日子在那儿吃饭全免，也没人算账。

English: The words in this crystal are the Accord's oath, spoken in a voice nobody living remembers. Old Hesper asks to hold it.
简体中文: 这块晶体里的话是盟约的誓言，由一个已无人记得的声音念出。老Hesper请求拿着它。

English: Hesper holds it a long time. 'That was the Grandmaster,' she says, 'before.' She gives it to the village shrine and does not speak of it again.
简体中文: Hesper握了很久。“那是大团长，”她说，“在那之前。”她把它交给了村里的圣坛，此后再没提起。

English: Hesper watches %s split the training post and keep swinging at the stump. 'The Path is choosing for you,' she says. 'You could let it.' They let it. Wen writes a new word under their name: %s.
简体中文: Hesper看着%s劈开训练木桩，又对着树桩继续挥砍。“道途在替你选择，”她说，“你可以顺着它。”他们顺了。Wen在他们名字下写了一个新词：%s。

English: %s used to be first into every rift and first out. This week they stayed behind to walk the slowest hero home. Hesper calls that the moment a Path forks. Wen writes the new word down: %s.
简体中文: %s过去总是第一个冲进裂隙、第一个出来。这周他们留在后面，陪走得最慢的英雄回家。Hesper说，这就是道途分岔的时刻。Wen写下了新词：%s。

English: %s says nothing about it at all. They turn up at the pay table one morning carrying themselves differently, and Hesper nods as if a debt has been paid. Wen asks what to write. Hesper says: %s.
简体中文: %s对此只字未提。某天早上，他们以不一样的姿态出现在发薪桌前，Hesper点了点头，像是一笔债已经还清。Wen问该写什么。Hesper说：%s。

English: %s didn't want it. The Essence settled anyway, the way rain settles on a roof. Hesper sits with them until dark. 'Nobody's ready,' she says. 'The good ones are scared.' Wen writes: %s.
简体中文: %s并不想要。精华还是沉淀了，就像雨落在屋顶。Hesper陪他们坐到天黑。“没人准备好过，”她说，“好的那些都会害怕。”Wen写下：%s。

English: %s prays before every rift, and this time the answer came back as a shape. Hesper says the Vow always answers in its own time. Wen writes it in the chronicle in her best hand: %s.
简体中文: %s每次进裂隙前都祈祷，这一次，回应化作了一个形状。Hesper说誓约总在它自己的时候回应。Wen用她最好的字迹写进编年史：%s。

English: %s has been taking notes on their own Essence for weeks. The notes end mid-sentence on the day it settled. Wen copies the last line into the chronicle and adds the new word: %s.
简体中文: %s几周来一直在记录自己精华的变化。笔记在它沉淀那天戛然而止，停在半句话上。Wen把最后一行抄进编年史，又添上新词：%s。

English:
Mother Ilse of the Last Lantern finds you after dark with a page torn from the Hollow Crown Company's books: a list of rifts, each with a date, a price, and the word opened. Captain Morrow has been opening rifts and selling the contracts to close them.

She will give it to the Crown's herald if you ask. Or the Company will pay well for a guild that keeps quiet, and its contracts would come to you.
简体中文:
末灯会的Ilse嬷嬷趁夜找到你，带来从空洞王冠佣兵团账本上撕下的一页：一列裂隙，每条都有日期、价格和“已开启”字样。Morrow队长一直在开启裂隙，再把封闭它们的契约卖出去。

只要你开口，她会把它交给王冠的传令官。或者，佣兵团会为保持沉默的公会出个好价钱，它的契约也会归你。

English:
The herald reads Morrow's page aloud in the square. By evening the Hollow Crown Company's banners are down in three villages. By morning a rift has opened on the road to your camp, which is how you know the page was real.

(+10 Renown. A Riftbreak is coming to your door.)
简体中文:
传令官在广场上大声宣读了Morrow的那一页。到傍晚，空洞王冠佣兵团的旗帜已在三个村子被扯下。到早上，一座裂隙在通往你营地的路上开启，你由此知道那一页是真的。

（+10声望。一场裂隙崩溃即将来到你门前。）

English:
Morrow's contracts start arriving on your board, generous ones. Hesper reads the first, folds it, and doesn't say anything. She doesn't have to.

(Contracts pay 25% more Gold for the rest of the campaign.)
简体中文:
Morrow的契约开始出现在你的告示板上，报酬丰厚。Hesper读了第一份，折起来，什么也没说。她不必说。

（本战役余下时间，契约多付25%金币。）

English:
The herald reads one name, and it is yours. Orla Venn is the first to shake your hand; Kael Ashborn asks for a job; Mother Ilse is already gone, which is how you know she was pleased. The Charter hangs in your hall, and the villages bring their troubles to a door they know.

(Contracts pay 20% more Gold and Essence.)
简体中文:
传令官念出一个名字，正是你的。Orla Venn第一个与你握手；Kael Ashborn来讨份差事；Ilse嬷嬷早已离开，你由此知道她很满意。特许状挂在你的大厅里，村民们把麻烦带到他们熟悉的门前。

（契约多付20%金币和精华。）

English: The herald reads a name, and it isn't yours. %s hangs the Royal Charter in their hall. The rifts don't care whose name is on the wall. Neither, in the end, do the villagers, as long as somebody comes.
简体中文: 传令官念出一个名字，不是你的。%s把王室特许状挂在了他们的大厅里。裂隙不在乎墙上写的是谁的名字。说到底，村民也不在乎，只要有人来就行。

English: %s and %s have stopped needing to talk in a fight. Wen noticed first. She has started writing their names in the chronicle as one entry, with an ampersand, and neither of them has complained.
简体中文: %s和%s在战斗中已经不需要说话了。Wen最先注意到。她开始在编年史里把他们的名字写成一条，中间用一个&连着，两人都没有抱怨。

English: %s and %s sat up past the last candle arguing about a fight they won. Dobbs charged the guild for the candle. Hesper paid it herself and told him to let them be.
简体中文: %s和%s熬到最后一支蜡烛燃尽，争论一场他们打赢了的仗。Dobbs把蜡烛钱记到公会头上。Hesper自掏腰包，叫他别管他们。

English: Ten rifts together. %s still can't say %s's full name right, and %s still lets it go. Wen has written down both versions.
简体中文: 一起闯过十座裂隙。%s还是念不对%s的全名，而%s依旧随他去。Wen把两种念法都记了下来。

English: %s took a hit meant for %s last week and has refused to talk about it since. Wen has written it down anyway. Hesper says that's how the old guilds started.
简体中文: 上周%s替%s挡了一击，此后一直拒绝谈起此事。Wen还是记了下来。Hesper说，旧公会就是这样开始的。

English: %s went first into every rift. Somebody had to.
简体中文: %s总是第一个进裂隙。总得有人去。

English: %s never once asked how deep a rift went before stepping in.
简体中文: %s进裂隙前从没问过它有多深。

English: %s was always first out of the rift, and always went back for whoever wasn't.
简体中文: %s总是第一个走出裂隙，又总是回头去接没出来的人。

English: %s never sat still at the pay table. The chair is still pushed back.
简体中文: %s在发薪桌前从来坐不住。那把椅子至今还推在后面。

English: %s said very little and meant all of it.
%s held the line. That is the whole entry, and it is enough.
简体中文: %s守住了防线。这就是全部记录，足够了。

English: %s was afraid of every rift and walked into all of them.
简体中文: %s害怕每一座裂隙，却走进了每一座。

English: %s checked every strap twice. It wasn't the straps.
简体中文: %s每根皮带都检查两遍。问题不在皮带。

English: %s prayed before every rift. We hope someone answered.
简体中文: %s每次进裂隙前都祈祷。愿有人回应了。

English: %s kept the candles lit in the hall. We have kept them lit since.
简体中文: %s总让大厅里的蜡烛亮着。从那以后，我们一直让它们亮着。

English: %s left a notebook full of questions. Wen is working through them.
简体中文: %s留下一本写满问题的笔记。Wen正在逐一作答。

English: %s understood the Hollow better than any of us, and went to see it anyway.
简体中文: %s比我们任何人都更了解空洞，却还是去见了它。

English: Morrow's sellswords, sent to settle a debt. The crossbowman snipes from the back; close on him first.
简体中文: Morrow的雇佣兵，来讨一笔债。弩手在后方狙击，先冲向他。

English: Captain Morrow, of the Hollow Crown
简体中文: 空洞王冠佣兵团的Morrow队长

English: Word comes as you set out: Captain Morrow is at the bottom of this rift, and he has brought friends.
简体中文: 出发时传来消息：Morrow队长就在这座裂隙的底部，还带了帮手。

English:
Morrow goes down laughing, which is somehow worse. On his belt hangs an old iron key with the Accord's sigil: the key Pip swears she stole from a rift-lord, and the one he has been opening rifts with. By the end of the week the Company's banners are gone from the Vale.

(+300 Gold, +10 Renown. No more Company ambushes.)
简体中文:
Morrow倒下时还在笑，这反倒更糟。他腰间挂着一把带盟约纹章的旧铁钥匙：Pip发誓是她从某个裂隙领主那儿偷来的，也正是他用来开启裂隙的那把。不到一周，佣兵团的旗帜就从山谷里消失了。

（+300金币，+10声望。佣兵团不再伏击。）

English: a street with a blue door

%s has been quiet since you kept the echo. There was %s in it, and %s knew it, from a life they don't remember living.

(%s is Echo-Touched: +6%% ability power.)
简体中文:
自从你留下那段回响，%s就一直很沉默。回响里有%s，而%s认得它，来自一段他们不记得活过的人生。

（%s获得回响之触：+6%%技能强度。）

English: A pale man with a lantern has been following the echoes. Ezra studies what the rifts take from people, and he keeps a little of it in the lantern, for safekeeping. He asks what you did with yours. When you tell him, he bows, which nobody in the Vale has seen him do.
简体中文: 一个提灯的苍白男人一直在追寻回响。Ezra研究裂隙从人们身上夺走的东西，并在灯里存下一点，说是代为保管。他问你怎么处理了你的那些。听完后他鞠了一躬，山谷里还没人见他这样做过。

English: A pale man with a lantern has been following the echoes. Ezra studies what the rifts take from people. He asks to see your vault, goes very still, and asks how much of it you have spent, and on what, and whether you kept a list. 'It was yours to spend,' he says at the door. 'I hope it was worth what it cost them.'
简体中文: 一个提灯的苍白男人一直在追寻回响。Ezra研究裂隙从人们身上夺走的东西。他要求看看你的金库，随即一动不动，问你花了多少、花在什么上、有没有留一份清单。“那是你的，你可以花，”他在门口说，“希望它值得他们付出的代价。”

English: In the weeks after, people stop in the street and say names out loud. A song nobody knew is sung at every harvest. The empty guild halls fill with flowers, and yours gets the most, from people who never met you.
简体中文: 此后几周，人们会在街上停下，大声念出一些名字。一首无人知晓的歌在每次丰收时被传唱。空荡的公会大厅摆满了鲜花，你的大厅收到的最多，来自从未见过你的人。

English: Something leaves the Vale with the last of the rifts, quietly, and nobody can say what. Your guild is the strongest the Vale has ever had. Ezra's lantern is found on your doorstep one morning, empty, with no note.
简体中文: 随着最后的裂隙，有什么东西悄悄离开了山谷，没人说得清是什么。你的公会是山谷有史以来最强的。某天早上，Ezra的灯出现在你家门口，空的，没有字条。

English: Wen asks %s for a line for the chronicle: something learned in fifty rifts. %s thinks about it for a long time. 'Bring more bandages than you think,' they say. Wen writes it down exactly.
简体中文: Wen请%s为编年史留一句话：五十座裂隙里学到的东西。%s想了很久。“绷带要比你以为的多带些，”他们说。Wen一字不差地记了下来。

English: Fifty rifts. Dobbs works out what %s has cost the guild in wages and what they have brought home, then quietly tears up the page. Wen asks why. 'Some sums you don't show anyone,' says Dobbs. %s pretends not to hear.
简体中文: 五十座裂隙。Dobbs算出了%s花了公会多少薪水、又带回了多少，然后悄悄撕掉了那一页。Wen问为什么。“有些账不给任何人看，”Dobbs说。%s假装没听见。

English: Hesper gives %s her old Accord pin for their fiftieth rift. It is bent and tarnished and nobody has ever seen her take it off. %s wears it on the inside of their coat.
简体中文: Hesper把她的旧盟约徽章送给%s，纪念他们的第五十座裂隙。徽章弯了，也失去了光泽，没人见过她摘下它。%s把它别在外套内侧。

English: As the Vale knows guilds: three heroes and 280 Gold.
简体中文: 山谷所熟知的公会：三名英雄和280金币。

English: Hired swords: start with 320 more Gold. Contracts pay 20% more Gold, wages are 15% higher, and Renown comes 20% slower. The Hollow Crown Company will make you an offer.
简体中文: 雇佣之剑：开局多得320金币。契约多付20%金币，薪水高15%，声望增长慢20%。空洞王冠佣兵团会向你开价。

English: Sworn to mend: start with 80 less Gold. Wages are 20% lower and downed heroes are back a run sooner. An echo given back earns twice the Renown; one kept, half the Essence.
简体中文: 立誓疗愈：开局少80金币。薪水低20%，倒下的英雄提前一轮归队。归还回响获得双倍声望；留下回响，精华减半。

English: Mother Ilse's people: start with 350 Gold. Shop prices are 25% lower, the Last Lantern is never your rival, and keeping quiet in the Charter War pays 40% more Gold instead of 25%.
简体中文: Ilse嬷嬷的人：开局350金币。商店价格低25%，末灯会永远不会成为你的对手，在特许状之争中保持沉默可多得40%金币，而非25%。

English: Deserters' wages: start with 100 less Gold. Every recruit board holds a ranger, rangers deal 10% more damage, and Riftbreaks warn you a day earlier. The Iron Chorus won't compete with deserters.
简体中文: 逃兵的薪水：开局少100金币。每次招募都有一名游侠，游侠伤害提高10%，裂隙崩溃提前一天预警。钢铁合唱团不会与逃兵竞争。

English: Keepers of the sky: Essence gains are 20% lower, but every seal earns 1 more Renown, echoes turn up twice as often and every kept echo touches a hero, and the Arcane Lab starts at level 1.
简体中文: 天空的守护者：精华获取降低20%，但每次封印多得1声望，回响出现频率翻倍且每段留下的回响都会触及一名英雄，奥术实验室从1级起步。

English: Old Hesper's own guild: the Grandmaster's ledger pages turn up twice as often, but the Hollow knows you, and Riftbreaks come a day sooner.
简体中文: 老Hesper自己的公会：大团长的账簿残页出现频率翻倍，但空洞认得你，裂隙崩溃会提前一天。

English: Kept quiet in a Charter War
简体中文: 在特许状之争中保持沉默

English: Hesper had a fever on the Night of Breaking and missed it. Every other guild of the Accord went into the rifts that night, hers too, and none came back. Twenty years on she has a hall again, three recruits, and the old oath: close what opens, share what you find, never sell a rift. She means to keep it this time.
简体中文: 破碎之夜那天Hesper发了烧，错过了。盟约的其他所有公会那晚都走进了裂隙，包括她的公会，无一归来。二十年后，她又有了一座大厅、三名新兵和那句古老誓言：开启的必须关闭，所得的必须分享，绝不出卖裂隙。这一次她打算守住它。

English: Captain Morrow sends a man with a ledger and a good coat. The Hollow Crown Company would take your contracts off your hands, and your guild with them, at a fair price. He leaves the paper on the table. Nobody signs it. Dobbs reads it twice.
简体中文: Morrow队长派来一个带着账本、穿着好外套的人。空洞王冠佣兵团愿以公道价格接手你的契约，连同你的公会一起。他把文书留在桌上。没人签字。Dobbs读了两遍。

English: The Accord's own rule: in the Charter War, keeping quiet is not an option.
简体中文: 盟约自己的规矩：在特许状之争中，不能选择保持沉默。

English: No Quick fight: every fight is played, or set to Auto.
简体中文: 禁用快速战斗：每场战斗都要亲自打，或设为自动。

English: Medical Bay beds don't speed recovery.
简体中文: 医疗所床位不加快恢复。

English: Fragments of the Vale's story turn up twice as often, and every story branch costs half again as much.
简体中文: 山谷故事的残篇出现频率翻倍，每条故事分支的花费提高一半。

English: The Iron Oath trained shield-walls. Their drill yard is still marked out in white stones, and Hesper walks it once, end to end, before she lets the recruits in.
简体中文: 铁誓训练盾墙。他们的操练场至今还用白石标着边界，Hesper从头到尾走了一遍，才让新兵进去。

English: The Green Hand were healers. Their shelves still smell of feverfew. Wen finds a ledger of everyone they ever patched up, and reads names out loud for an hour.
简体中文: 绿手是治疗者。他们的架子上仍有小白菊的气味。Wen找到一本记录他们救治过的所有人的账簿，大声念了一个小时的名字。

English: Quiet Coin kept the Accord's accounts. Dobbs is in their counting room before the dust settles, and comes out holding a pen like a holy relic.
简体中文: 静币曾为盟约管账。灰尘还没落定，Dobbs就钻进了他们的账房，出来时捧着一支笔，像捧着圣物。

English: The Ninth Lamp studied Essence. Their lamps still hold a little of it, and light themselves when someone they would have liked walks in.
简体中文: 第九灯研究精华。他们的灯里仍存着一点，每当有他们会喜欢的人走进来，灯就自己亮起。

English: Long Roads took in strays and taught them a trade. Word gets around: heroes ask to work for the guild that opened it again, and ask for less.
简体中文: 长路收留流浪者，教他们一门手艺。消息传开了：英雄们主动要求为重开大厅的公会效力，要的薪水也更少。

English: The Open Hand traded with every village in the Vale. The merchants remember the sign over the door, and start giving the guild their old prices.
简体中文: 敞手曾与山谷每个村子做生意。商人们记得门上的招牌，开始给公会按老价钱算。

English: The title Keepers of the Vale, and 20 Laurels

The last hall is the one the Accord was sworn in. Its doors open with the key Pip stole from Morrow. Inside is a long table, forty-one chairs, and one that someone has dusted every year. The Vale has its keepers again.
简体中文: 最后一座大厅是盟约立誓之地。大门用Pip从Morrow那儿偷来的钥匙打开。里面有一张长桌、四十一把椅子，其中一把每年都有人擦拭。山谷再次有了守护者。

English: Standing heroes mend 6% of their max HP after every won fight; campfires restore 1 more Resolve
简体中文: 每场胜利后，站着的英雄恢复6%最大生命值；营火额外恢复1点决心

English: Tempering costs 25% less; combining three items keeps the best stat line of the three
简体中文: 回火便宜25%；合成三件物品时保留三者中最好的一条数值

English: Shrines and a trainer's echo teach twice as much
简体中文: 圣坛和导师的回响教得翻倍

English: Elites pay 50% more; one free Rally order in every rift
简体中文: 精英奖励提高50%；每道裂隙一次免费的集结命令

English: Knockouts never leave scars; a downed hero is back after one day
简体中文: 倒下不会留下伤疤；倒下的英雄一天后就能归队

English: +1 equipped relic slot; Path relic offers show 4, not 3
简体中文: +1遗物栏位；道途遗物的选项从3个变为4个

English: Every page of the Grandmaster's ledger
简体中文: 集齐大团长账簿的每一页

English: Five tides of the Open Hollow held
简体中文: 守住五次敞开空洞之潮

English: Strikes harder the longer the fight drags on (past round 4).
简体中文: 战斗拖得越久打得越狠（第4回合后）。

English: Its first two rounds of retaliation can't be dodged.
简体中文: 它的前两轮反击无法闪避。

English: Heals a portion of its health back each round it survives.
简体中文: 每存活一回合恢复部分生命值。

English: Hits harder than expected from the very first round.
简体中文: 从第一回合起就打得比预想更狠。
我早饭时吃过更狠的苦头。

English: Ha! Another one for the wall.
Is that the best the Rift can do?
Point me at the next one.
I don't want to die here!
Should we run? We should run.

简体中文: 我们活下来了！真的活下来了！

English: Huh. I'm getting better at this.
Maybe I'm not so bad after all.
My faith holds, if my body won't.
I am given more to give.
简体中文: 我得到更多，便能给予更多。

English: The weave is fraying. So am I.
I need a moment to recompute!
简体中文: 我需要点时间重新计算！

English: That was not in the plan!
Worth a page in my notes.
The Rift has patterns. I see them now.
简体中文: 裂隙有规律。我现在看清了。

English: At half health, two foes answer its call.
简体中文: 生命值降至一半时，两名敌人响应它的召唤。

English: %s howls, and the rift answers with reinforcements!
At half health it hits 20% harder and winds up heavy blows more often.
简体中文: 生命值降至一半时，伤害提高20%，并更频繁地蓄力重击。

English: At half health it raises a ward worth 12% of its health.
简体中文: 生命值降至一半时，生成相当于其12%生命值的护盾。

English: Heals for 25% of the damage it deals.
简体中文: 按造成伤害的25%恢复生命。

English: Reflects 15% of the damage it takes back at the attacker.
简体中文: 将受到伤害的15%反弹给攻击者。

English: Starts behind a ward worth 20% of its health.
简体中文: 开局带有相当于其20%生命值的护盾。

English: Heavily armored: shrugs off 35% of basic attacks.
Its hits can set heroes ablaze.
简体中文: 它的攻击可能点燃英雄。

English: Acts twice each round (each hit a little weaker) and never winds up.
简体中文: 每回合行动两次（每击稍弱），且从不蓄力。
总会带着两名（较弱的）护卫。

English: Hits every hero for %d%% of a normal hit. Defend halves it for whoever Defends.
简体中文: 对所有英雄造成普通攻击%d%%的伤害。防御者所受伤害减半。

English: A heavier shot at the most-hurt hero in the back row. Guard can take it for them.
简体中文: 对后排受伤最重的英雄进行一次更重的射击。守护可替其承受。

English: No damage, but the target deals 40%% less for 2 rounds. Sanctuary cleanses it.
简体中文: 不造成伤害，但目标2回合内伤害降低40%%。圣所可以净化。

English: Shields its most-hurt ally for 20%% of their max HP. Aimed Shot ignores wards.
简体中文: 为受伤最重的友方提供其最大生命值20%%的护盾。瞄准射击无视护盾。

English: Heals its most-hurt ally. Kill or stun it first.
简体中文: 治疗受伤最重的友方。先击杀或击晕它。

English: Every foe hits 20%% harder for the rest of the fight (up to twice). Stun it to stop it.
简体中文: 本场战斗剩余时间内所有敌人伤害提高20%%（最多两次）。击晕它可以阻止。

English: Hits every hero and heals the boss for half of it. Defend, or ward the party.
简体中文: 攻击所有英雄，并为首领恢复造成伤害的一半。防御，或为小队加护盾。

English: Chills and weakens every hero (they act late and deal 40%% less next round). Sanctuary or a Healing Tonic cleanses it.
简体中文: 冰冻并削弱所有英雄（下回合行动靠后，伤害降低40%%）。圣所或治疗药剂可以净化。

English: Tears the wards off every front-row hero and hits them hard. Move a hurt hero back, or Defend.
简体中文: 撕掉前排所有英雄的护盾并重击他们。把受伤的英雄移到后排，或防御。

English: Marks a hero: they take 50%% more damage for 2 rounds. Guard them.
简体中文: 标记一名英雄：2回合内受到的伤害提高50%%。守护他们。

English: Sets every hero burning for 3 rounds. Sanctuary or a Healing Tonic puts it out.
简体中文: 使所有英雄燃烧3回合。圣所或治疗药剂可以扑灭。

English: The Warden wards its friends and the Wisp mends them. Take the Wisp first, or strip the wards.
简体中文: 守卫为同伴加护盾，鬼火为它们治疗。先打鬼火，或剥掉护盾。

English: Criers curse and roar from the back. Silence them before the roars stack.
简体中文: 啼者在后方诅咒和咆哮。在咆哮叠加前让它们闭嘴。

English: The Thrall's sweeps hit the whole party. Defend, or stun its wind-up.
简体中文: 奴仆的横扫会打中全队。防御，或击晕它的蓄力。

English: The Crawler mends the Reaver while the Crier curses. Break the healer, then the brute.
简体中文: 爬虫为掠夺者治疗，啼者施加诅咒。先打掉治疗者，再收拾蛮兽。

English: Poison stacks fast. A Healing Tonic or Sanctuary washes it out.
简体中文: 毒素叠得很快。治疗药剂或圣所可以洗去。

English: The Hounds go for your most-hurt back-row hero and their bites fester, while the Crier curses. Guard the back row.
简体中文: 猎犬专咬后排受伤最重的英雄，伤口会溃烂，啼者还在诅咒。守护后排。

English: The Wight wards and mends the Reaver from the back. Snuff the lantern first, or the Reaver never falls.
简体中文: 尸妖在后方为掠夺者加护盾和治疗。先灭了灯，否则掠夺者永远不倒。

English: The Priest keeps the Wretches fed. Kill it first.
简体中文: 祭司一直在喂养沼泽怪。先杀它。

English: Snipers hunt the back row behind their Anchorite. Guard your healer, or Taunt.
简体中文: 狙击手躲在隐士身后猎杀后排。守护你的治疗者，或使用嘲讽。

English: The Fiend reflects basic hits and the Bell curses. Skills and Aimed Shot go around the mirror.
简体中文: 镜魔反弹普通攻击，钟施加诅咒。技能和瞄准射击可以绕过镜子。

English: Three drainers heal off every hit. Volley and Frost Nova hit them all.
简体中文: 三个吸血者每次攻击都会回血。齐射和冰霜新星能打中全部。

English: Chills slow your turns and the Priest mends. Burst the Priest down.
简体中文: 冰冻拖慢你的回合，祭司负责治疗。集火打掉祭司。

English: The Caller's waves chill the whole party while the Brute winds up. Stun the wind-up, then drown the Caller.
简体中文: 召唤者的浪潮冰冻全队，蛮兽在蓄力。击晕蓄力，再淹没召唤者。

English: Two armored drainers and a Priest to feed them. Break the armor, and kill the Priest before it mends.
简体中文: 两个重甲吸血者，加一个喂养它们的祭司。破甲，并在祭司治疗前杀掉它。

English: The Oracle wards the Golem, and the Golem's sweeps burn. Take the Oracle first.
简体中文: 先知为魔像加护盾，魔像的横扫带火。先打先知。

English: Harriers snipe and hit harder when hurt. Finish each one quickly.
简体中文: 猎鹰会狙击，受伤后打得更狠。逐个速杀。

English: Everything here burns. Keep a cleanse ready.
简体中文: 这里的一切都在燃烧。随时准备净化。

English: The Reaver winds up while the Sprites harry. Break the wind-up.
简体中文: 掠夺者蓄力时小妖不断骚扰。打断蓄力。

English: Two armored brutes. Armor breakers and stuns shine here.
简体中文: 两个重甲蛮兽。破甲和眩晕在此大显身手。

English: The Hounds roar each other on and grow wild when hurt. Stun the roar and finish each Hound quickly.
简体中文: 猎犬互相咆哮助威，受伤后变得狂野。击晕咆哮，逐只速杀。

English: The Sentinel reflects basic hits and wards the Harriers. Skills go around the glass; drop the Harriers first.
简体中文: 哨兵反弹普通攻击并为猎鹰加护盾。技能可以绕过玻璃；先打掉猎鹰。

English: The Priest mends the Brute while the Wisp heals. Take the healers first.
简体中文: 祭司为蛮兽治疗，鬼火也在回血。先打治疗者。

English: Two Snipers aim at your back row. Close in, or guard it.
简体中文: 两名狙击手瞄准你的后排。贴近它们，或守护后排。

English: The Crabs drain what they hit. Burst one down at a time.
简体中文: 螃蟹会吸取所击中目标的生命。一次集火一只。

English: The Tidewalker chills and the Crier curses. Cleanse, then strike.
简体中文: 踏潮者施加冰冻，啼者施加诅咒。先净化，再出手。

English: The Hounds get wilder as they bleed. Finish each one quickly.
简体中文: 猎犬越流血越疯狂。逐只速杀。

English: The Moths shoot from the back while the Thrall sweeps. Stun its wind-up.
简体中文: 飞蛾在后方射击，奴仆在横扫。击晕它的蓄力。

English: A Brute and a Thrall wind up heavy blows together. Answer one, guard the other.
简体中文: 蛮兽和奴仆同时蓄力重击。应对一个，守护另一个。

English: The Watchman wards its friends. Strip the wards, or go around them.
简体中文: 守夜人为同伴加护盾。剥掉护盾，或绕过它们。

English: The Bellringers chill and curse from the back. Silence them first.
简体中文: 敲钟人在后方冰冻和诅咒。先让它们闭嘴。

English: The Harriers snipe your back row. Guard it, or kill them fast.
简体中文: 猎鹰狙击你的后排。守护后排，或速杀它们。

English: The Sprite and the Oracle burn you from behind a Golem. Burst the back row.
简体中文: 小妖和先知躲在魔像身后灼烧你。集火后排。

English: The Hounds roar each other into a frenzy. Take them one at a time.
简体中文: 猎犬互相咆哮陷入狂乱。逐只击破。

English: The Wights mend and ward each other. Kill one before the other can help.
简体中文: 尸妖互相治疗和加护盾。在另一个能帮忙前先杀掉一个。

English: The Sentinel wards and the Reaver hits hard. Strip the ward and stun the wind-up.
简体中文: 哨兵加护盾，掠夺者打得很狠。剥掉护盾并击晕蓄力。

English: Her Harvest hits everyone and heals her. At half health she calls a Crier and a Warden. Defend through the Harvest; kill the Crier fast.
简体中文: 她的收割打中所有人并为她回血。生命值降至一半时，她召来一名啼者和一名守卫。防御挡过收割，速杀啼者。

English: The Drowning Tide chills and weakens the whole party, and her ward shrugs off early defence. Cleanse the curse; save your burst for after her barrier rises.
简体中文: 溺亡之潮冰冻并削弱全队，她的护盾会抵消前期攻势。净化诅咒；屏障升起后再爆发。

English: Sunder tears the wards off the front row and hits hard, and he angers every round. Rotate the front row and end it quickly.
简体中文: 破甲撕掉前排的护盾并重击，他每回合都愈发愤怒。轮换前排，速战速决。

English: Brand marks a hero to take 50% more damage. At half health he calls fire cultists. Guard the branded hero.
简体中文: 烙印标记一名英雄，使其受到的伤害提高50%。生命值降至一半时，他召来火焰邪教徒。守护被烙印的英雄。

English: Morrow brands his mark and his crossbowmen take the shot. At two-thirds and again at one-third health he whistles up more sellswords. Guard the branded hero.
简体中文: Morrow为目标打上烙印，他的弩手随即开火。生命值降至三分之二和三分之一时，他会吹哨召来更多雇佣兵。守护被烙印的英雄。

English: The bargain fights with every move it ever bought: Harvest, the Drowning Tide, Brand and Immolate. At half health it calls up what it has claimed. Cleanse, guard the branded, and keep the pressure on.
简体中文: 这笔交易用它买来的每一招作战：收割、溺亡之潮、烙印和献祭。生命值降至一半时，它召出它所夺取的一切。净化、守护被烙印者，并持续施压。

English: Immolate sets the whole party burning while she regenerates and grows angrier. Cleanse the burns and never let up.
简体中文: 献祭使全队燃烧，她则不断再生并越发愤怒。净化燃烧，绝不松懈。

English: The Falling Sky sets the whole party burning while it mends itself and grows angrier. Cleanse the burns and never let up.
简体中文: 天坠使全队燃烧，它则不断自愈并越发愤怒。净化燃烧，绝不松懈。

English: Brand marks a hero to take 50% more damage. At half health he calls the City's choir down from the rooftops. Guard the branded hero.
简体中文: 烙印标记一名英雄，使其受到的伤害提高50%。生命值降至一半时，他从屋顶召下城中的唱诗班。守护被烙印的英雄。

English: the one who stands in front.
from the front row, takes 25% of every hit aimed at a back-row ally.
简体中文: 在前排时，承受瞄准后排友方的每次攻击的25%。

English: until the round ends, takes every hit aimed at the back row, at 30% less.
简体中文: 直到本回合结束，承受所有瞄准后排的攻击，伤害降低30%。

English: the first time an ally would fall, they take the blow instead, gain a ward of 30% max HP, and every foe must attack them for 2 rounds.
简体中文: 友方首次将要倒下时，由其代为承受，获得30%最大生命值的护盾，且所有敌人2回合内必须攻击它。
守护者也会掩护前排友方。

English: +1% damage for every 2% of HP missing.
pay 15% HP (no Momentum): +2 Momentum and the next hit does +50%.
简体中文: 支付15%生命值（不耗气势）：+2气势，下一击伤害+50%。

English: the first time they drop below 30% HP, for 3 rounds their attacks hit every foe, they can't be stunned, and they can't be healed.
简体中文: 首次生命值低于30%时，3回合内攻击命中所有敌人，免疫眩晕，且无法被治疗。

English: builds a rhythm on one foe.
简体中文: 在一个敌人身上建立节奏。

English: each hit in a row on the same foe adds +12% (up to 4); switching targets resets it.
简体中文: 连续攻击同一敌人每次+12%（最多4层）；更换目标则重置。

English: three quick strikes at the target, each adding a Combo stack.
简体中文: 对目标快速攻击三次，每次叠加一层连击。

English: the first time Combo reaches 4, they act twice next round.
简体中文: 连击首次达到4层时，下回合行动两次。

English: switching targets no longer resets Combo.
简体中文: 更换目标不再重置连击。

English: No hero is ready yet: the first training opens at Rank D.
简体中文: 还没有英雄准备好：第一次训练于D阶开放。

English: Every rolled stat on a piece grows %d%% a temper, up to %d. Each costs more than the last.
简体中文: 每次回火，装备上的每项随机数值提高%d%%，最多%d次。每次都比上次贵。

English: Everything the heroes wear is fully tempered.
简体中文: 英雄身上的装备都已回火到满。

English: Combining and reforging come with the smith's apprentice, in Act III.
简体中文: 合成与重铸要等铁匠的学徒来，在第三幕。

English: Three spare items of one category and rarity become one of the next rarity up.
简体中文: 同一类别和稀有度的三件多余物品合成为下一稀有度的一件。

English: No spare Common or Rare items.
简体中文: 没有多余的普通或稀有物品。

English: poisons its target for a few rounds
starts the fight behind a ward
heals itself from the damage it deals
简体中文: 从造成的伤害中恢复自身

English: reflects part of the damage it takes
Brings a random warden mechanic each fight. %s
简体中文: 每场战斗带来一种随机的守卫机制。%s

English: Heroes are hired as base classes and train into a Path at the Training Yard: stage 1 at Rank D, stage 2 at Rank B, stage 3 at Rank S. Each subclass is a stage of one Path with its own Twist. Unlocked subclasses are remembered; a new guild can carry them over with Laurels.
简体中文: 英雄以基础职业受雇，并在训练场训练进入道途：第1阶段于D阶，第2阶段于B阶，第3阶段于S阶。每个子职业都是某条道途的一个阶段，各有其变奏。已解锁的子职业会被记住；新公会可用桂冠继承它们。
%s · 第%d天 · 封印%d座裂隙 · +%d桂冠%s
真相 · 已知%d/%d · 找到%d个残篇

English: Fragments turn up in rifts, letters, relics and at the pay table, and they're kept for every guild after this one. Any two of a truth's fragments make it known. Some only turn up after a past guild did something.
简体中文: 残篇会出现在裂隙、信件、遗物和发薪桌旁，并为此后的每个公会保留。一个真相的任意两个残篇即可使其揭晓。有些只有在过去的公会做过某事后才会出现。

English: Everyone tells the Night of Breaking their own way. What each witness has told you, across every guild. A truth you learn strikes a claim through, or confirms it.
简体中文: 每个人讲述破碎之夜的方式都不同。这里是各位证人跨越所有公会告诉你的话。你得知的真相会推翻或证实某个说法。

English: %d empty chair%s: witnesses you haven't heard yet
简体中文: %d把空椅子%s：你尚未听取的证人

English: What this guild can still finish · +%d Laurels each
简体中文: 本公会仍可完成的事项 · 每项+%d桂冠

English: Tides of the Open Hollow: %d held of %d
Pages turn up in sealed rifts as the campaign goes on; a finale always yields one.
简体中文: 随着战役推进，账页会出现在封印的裂隙中；终章必定掉落一页。
勇者们的记忆 — 已解放%d/%d

English: Each act's finale frees a champion of the old guilds; more wait in the Endless Rift.
简体中文: 每一幕的终章都会解放一位旧公会的勇者；更多勇者在无尽裂隙中等待。

English: Items are hero-bound gear. Weapon items fill a hero's weapon slots (1, or 2 for a dual-wield class); Armor and Focus items share one "gear" slot pool that grows with hero rank. A Common rolls one stat, a Rare one bigger stat and a named effect, an Epic two stats and a stronger effect (some effects only come on Epics). Legendaries are unique.
简体中文: 物品是英雄专属的装备。武器类物品占用英雄的武器栏（1个，双持职业为2个）；护甲和专注类物品共用一个"装备"栏位池，随英雄阶级增长。普通物品随机一项属性，稀有物品一项更高的属性和一个命名效果，史诗物品两项属性和更强的效果（部分效果仅出现在史诗上）。传奇物品独一无二。

English: Relics bend a rule for the whole guild: each is one of a kind, found from Act I's finale on (finales, an elite's loot, a rift shop, events, the Tower). They sit on the Relic Altar (Inventory), 3 slots and more with the Relic Vault. Path relics are different: a hero of the relic's Path carries it, and it works while they fight.
简体中文: 遗物为整个公会改写一条规则：每件都独一无二，从第一幕终章起可获得（终章、精英的战利品、裂隙商店、事件、试炼之塔）。它们放在遗物祭坛（物品栏）上，有3个栏位，遗物库可增加更多。道途遗物不同：由该道途的一位英雄携带，在其战斗时生效。

English: An act's finale, an elite, a rift shop or an event
简体中文: 某一幕的终章、精英、裂隙商店或事件

English: The Smithy combines three spare items of one category and rarity into one of the next rarity up (from Act III).
简体中文: 铁匠铺把同一类别和稀有度的三件多余物品合成为下一稀有度的一件（从第三幕起）。

English: Items: three of the same category (Weapon, Armor or Focus). The new item rolls fresh stats at the best rank among the three.
简体中文: 物品：三件同类别（武器、护甲或专注）。新物品以三者中最高的阶级重新随机属性。

English: Relics aren't combined: each is a rule of its own.
简体中文: 遗物不能合成：每一件都是一条独立的规则。

English: Equipped gear never goes in. Legendaries can't be crafted or fed in: they are fixed finds.
简体中文: 已装备的装备不会被投入。传奇无法制作或投入：它们是固定的发现。

English: Nothing yet: no three spare pieces of one kind and rarity.
简体中文: 暂无：没有三件同类同稀有度的闲置物品。

English: Your camp was an Accord hall once. Its 13 rooms are rebuilt with Gold, a few at a time as the guild grows: Operations after two seals, Infrastructure, Logistics and Wardcraft in Act II, Research in Act III. Every level adds its effect and a little upkeep; some levels unlock a perk (a first-strike bonus, a boss Essence cache, extra relic slots…). Guild Tier, and the hall's art, track total levels. At the end of Acts I, III and V you are offered two of the six wings and build one, 3 of 6 per guild. A room damaged by a breach works a level lower until you repair it with Gold.
简体中文: 你的营地曾是盟约的一座大厅。它的13个房间用金币重建，随公会成长逐步开放：两次封印后是作战，第二幕是设施、后勤和守御术，第三幕是研究。每一级都增加效果和一点维护费；有些等级会解锁加成（先手伤害加成、首领精华宝藏、额外遗物栏位……）。公会等级和大厅的样貌随总等级提升。在第一、三、五幕结束时，会从六翼中提供两翼供你建造其一，每个公会6选3。被破口损坏的房间在用金币修复前会低一级运作。

English: From Act III, the Rift Ladder offers a twist each day: a rule and a starting boon that come from the date, so every guild faces the same one. Tick it and your next ladder rift (any rank) carries it; one try a day. Sealing it pays bonus Essence and grows your streak. Records (Guild > Records) track achievements, lifetime statistics and your last 30 runs; the Memorial remembers heroes lost for good.
简体中文: 从第三幕起，裂隙天梯每天提供一个变奏：一条规则和一个初始恩赐，由日期决定，因此每个公会面对的都相同。勾选后，你的下一个天梯裂隙（任意阶级）将带上它；每天一次机会。封印后可获得额外精华并延续连胜。记录（公会 > 记录）会追踪成就、生涯统计和你最近30次裂隙行动；纪念碑铭记永远逝去的英雄。

English: A real-time survival run in the region you pick, and only champions go in (up to 4). You steer the first (WASD, arrows, drag or stick); the rest follow and fight on their own, and each fires their signature move on a timer (the ring over their head fills as it recharges). Your equipped relics come along. Every five minutes the rift runs the same cycle: the horde, a swarm, an elite pack (its leader carries a chest), archers and casters, then a lull with a chest nearby, and a warden at the end of it. At 20:00 the Rift Warden comes: beat it to seal the rift. The rift's strength (shown before you enter) starts gentle and grows with every champion you free and every act you pass. A run pays Essence and a little Gold, and costs the guild a day.
简体中文: 在你选择的区域进行的实时生存行动，只有勇者可以进入（最多4位）。你操控第一位（WASD、方向键、拖动或摇杆）；其余的会跟随并自行战斗，每位都会定时释放其招牌技能（头顶的圆环随充能填满）。你装备的遗物也会随行。每五分钟裂隙重复相同的循环：兽群、虫群、精英群（其首领携带宝箱）、弓手与施法者，然后是附近有宝箱的间歇，最后是一名守卫。20:00时裂隙守卫降临：击败它以封印裂隙。裂隙强度（进入前显示）起初温和，并随你解放的每位勇者和经过的每一幕增长。一次行动可获得精华和少量金币，并花费公会一天时间。

English: Collect shards to level up and pick 1 of 3; one card is always a signature pick while any are left. Party upgrades (damage, speed, health…), a champion's role skill, a rank in their signature (up to 3: sooner and harder), or one of their two signature mods once it has a rank (Aftershock, Kindled, Frostbite, Expose, Stagger, Leech, Shrapnel, Radiance, Bulwark, Fervor, Renewal, Smokescreen). From level 10, two champions whose signatures are rank 2 can fuse: they fire together, 25% harder, and carry each other's mods. Max an upgrade and the matching role's attack can evolve (Whirlwind, Thousand Cuts, Arrow Storm, Starfall, Sanctum). Chests give one of three rift relics for the run.
简体中文: 收集碎片升级，并从3张卡中选择1张；只要还有剩余，其中一张必定是招牌技能卡。可选小队强化（伤害、速度、生命……）、勇者的职业技能、招牌技能的一级（最多3级：更快更强），或招牌技能已有等级后的两种改造之一（余震、点燃、霜咬、破绽、踉跄、吸血、弹片、光辉、壁垒、热忱、复苏、烟幕）。从10级起，两位招牌技能达到2级的勇者可以融合：一同发射，伤害提高25%，并带有彼此的改造。将某项强化升满后，对应职业的攻击可以进化（旋风、千刃、箭雨、星落、圣所）。宝箱提供三选一的裂隙遗物，用于本次行动。

English: The Vale has pillars that block foes, the Marches have pools that slow everyone, the Wastes have lava that burns foes and your lead. Braziers break when you walk into or hit them, dropping a heal, a magnet for shards or a bomb. Elites and wardens slam: step out of the red circle before it fills. Your first 5, 10 and 15 minutes and your first sealed rift each pay once, with two Endless relics and guild titles.
简体中文: 山谷有阻挡敌人的石柱，沼泽有减速所有人的水洼，荒原有灼烧敌人和你的首领英雄的熔岩。火盆在你走入或攻击时破碎，掉落治疗、碎片磁铁或炸弹。精英和守卫会猛击：在红圈填满前离开。你的首个5、10、15分钟和首次封印裂隙各奖励一次，包括两件无尽遗物和公会称号。

English: A hero's born quirk sets their personality (Bold, Quick, Stoic, Nervous, Devout or Scholarly), shown on their sheet. They speak up in fights when they land a big kill, hang on at low health or see an ally fall, and one of them sums up every win.
简体中文: 英雄天生的特质决定其性格（勇敢、敏捷、坚忍、紧张、虔诚或博学），显示在其资料上。他们在完成漂亮击杀、低血坚持或看到友方倒下时会开口，每次胜利也会有一人总结。

English: Every boss changes once it drops to half health: Call the Horde (two foes join), Fury (hits 20% harder and winds up more often) or Last Bastion (a ward worth 12% of its health). Its plate shows which, and the warning bar calls it out as it gets close, so save burst and Defend for the turn.
简体中文: 每个首领在生命值降至一半时都会变化：召唤兽群（两名敌人加入）、狂怒（伤害提高20%并更频繁地蓄力）或最后堡垒（相当于其12%生命值的护盾）。其铭牌会显示是哪一种，接近时警告条也会提示，所以留好爆发，在那回合防御。

English: Elites roll an affix: Vampiric, Thorned, Shielded, Venomous, Juggernaut, Blazing, Hasted (acts twice) or Commander (brings two escorts). Rank B+ rifts give them two. Hover the badges on their plate to read them.
简体中文: 精英会随机一个词缀：吸血、荆棘、护盾、剧毒、主宰、炽燃、迅捷（行动两次）或指挥官（带两名护卫）。B+阶裂隙中有两个。悬停其铭牌上的徽章可查看。

English: Beating an elite in a rift offers 1 of 3 boons that last until that rift ends. Boons come in seven families (Ember, Frost, Blood, Steel, Storm, Shadow, Holy); owning 2 of a family adds a set bonus and 4 a strong capstone, so a run can grow into a build. Not offered in the Tower.
简体中文: 在裂隙中击败精英可三选一获得恩赐，持续到该裂隙结束。恩赐分为七个家族（余烬、冰霜、鲜血、钢铁、风暴、暗影、神圣）；同一家族拥有2个可获得套装加成，4个可获得强力终极效果，因此一次行动可以逐渐成型。试炼之塔中不提供。

English: Lv2 of the Infirmary, Drill Yard, Trade Network and Scouts' Lodge each unlock an order you can call inside a rift: Supply Drop (heal 35% between fights), Rally (act first and hit 30% harder this round), Requisition (reroll a fight's loot) and Scout Ahead (reroll a fork). 1 order per rift, 2 at Renowned tier, 3 at Legendary.
简体中文: 医务室、操练场、贸易网络和斥候小屋的2级各解锁一个可在裂隙中发动的指令：空投补给（战斗间恢复35%）、集结（本回合先手且伤害提高30%）、征用（重掷一场战斗的战利品）和前方侦察（重掷一个岔路）。每座裂隙1个指令，声名远扬等级2个，传奇等级3个。

English: Rifts come in ranks, F to SSS. F-D are Lesser rifts, C and up Greater rifts (open after Act I). Each rank hits harder than the last and pays more; from B up they add rules (more elites, harsher hazards, fewer shops, bosses with two mechanics). Seal a rank to open the next. Gear drops at the rank of the rift it came from.
简体中文: 裂隙分为F到SSS阶。F-D为次级裂隙，C及以上为高级裂隙（第一幕后开放）。每一阶都比上一阶更强、报酬更高；从B阶起会增加规则（更多精英、更凶险的险境、更少商店、拥有两种机制的首领）。封印一阶以开放下一阶。装备按掉落裂隙的阶级生成。

English: Heroes who seal rifts together grow a bond: level 1, 2 and 3 after 2, 5 and 10 rifts. Each level adds 2% party damage while both stand in a fight (up to the cap). Bonds show on the hero sheet's History tab.
简体中文: 一起封印裂隙的英雄会建立羁绊：在2、5、10座裂隙后分别达到1、2、3级。两人都在战斗中站着时，每级使小队伤害+2%（有上限）。羁绊显示在英雄资料的历史页。

English: Spend Skill Points once to give a hero's Ability a secondary effect (by ability: +2 Momentum back, a lingering debuff, a party dodge boost, a self-shield, or a small damage stack).
简体中文: 花费一次技能点，为英雄的技能增加次要效果（视技能而定：返还2气势、持续减益、小队闪避加成、自身护盾或少量伤害叠加）。

English: Heroes stand in the front or back row. Foes aim most attacks at the front row; Snipes hunt the back. Warriors and rogues hit at half strength with a basic attack from the back row, and some skills need a row. Move (7) switches rows for a turn. Back-row foes take less damage from attacks.
简体中文: 英雄站在前排或后排。敌人大多攻击前排；狙击专打后排。战士和盗贼在后排的普通攻击只造成一半伤害，部分技能需要特定排。移动(7)可在一回合内换排。后排敌人受到的攻击伤害较低。

English: Keyboard: 1-5 switch camp tabs; in a fight 1 Attack, 2-4 skills, 5 Defend, M opens More (6 Guard, 7 Move, 8 Tonics, 9 Call; their keys work either way), Space repeats the last action, Tab cycles targets, A toggles Auto, Esc goes back. Gamepad: D-pad and A work every menu, B goes back, LB/RB switch camp tabs. In a fight A repeats the last action, X Defends, Y uses the Ability, LB/RB the two skills, Start opens More (Guard, Move, Tonics, Call), the D-pad cycles targets, Select toggles Auto.
简体中文: 键盘：1-5切换营地标签页；战斗中1为攻击，2-4为技能，5为防御，M打开更多（6守护、7移动、8药剂、9召唤；这些按键两种方式都可用），空格键重复上一个行动，Tab切换目标，A切换自动，Esc返回。手柄：十字键和A键可操作所有菜单，B返回，LB/RB切换营地标签页。战斗中A重复上一个行动，X防御，Y使用主动技能，LB/RB使用两个技能，Start打开更多（守护、移动、药剂、召唤），十字键切换目标，Select切换自动。

English: Momentum is the party's shared pool (up to 10, starting at 3). Each basic attack adds 1, each kill 1, and each hit taken while Defending or Guarding 1 (2 for a heavy blow). Every hero has two role skills (Lv1 and Lv6) and their subclass Ability (Lv3). Skills cost 2-4 Momentum, Abilities 4.
简体中文: 气势是小队的共享池（最多10，初始3）。每次普通攻击+1，每次击杀+1，防御或守护时每次受击+1（重击+2）。每位英雄有两个职业技能（1级和6级）和子职业技能（3级）。职业技能消耗2-4气势，子职业技能消耗4。

English: Each round a foe shows its next move above its health bar: an attack on a hero, a wind-up (a heavy blow next round), or a special move: Sweep (hits everyone), Snipe (the most-hurt back-row hero), Curse (40% less damage for 2 rounds), Ward, Mend or Roar. Shield Bash stuns a foe; Shield Bash and Frost Nova break wind-ups.
简体中文: 每回合敌人会在血条上方显示下一招：攻击某名英雄、蓄力（下回合重击），或特殊招式：横扫（命中所有人）、狙击（后排受伤最重的英雄）、诅咒（2回合内伤害降低40%）、结界、治疗或咆哮。盾击可眩晕敌人；盾击和冰霜新星可打断蓄力。

English: About six regular fights in ten are one of a region's named encounters (Scarecrow Line, Reed Snipers, Forge Guard...), groups whose members play off each other: a warder shielding a brute, a healer behind a wall, snipers behind a tank. The name and a tactical hint open the fight log; hover the round label to read the hint again.
简体中文: 大约十场普通战斗中有六场是该区域的命名遭遇（稻草人防线、芦苇狙击手、锻炉卫队……），成员之间互相配合：护盾者保护蛮兽、治疗者躲在墙后、狙击手藏在坦克身后。遭遇名称和战术提示会出现在战斗记录开头；悬停回合标签可再次查看提示。

English: Each boss is always the same fight. Vaelith's Harvest hits everyone and heals her, and she calls a Crier and a Warden at half health. Nyxara's Drowning Tide chills and weakens the party. Korrath's Sunder tears the wards off the front row. Drevok Brands a hero to take 50% more damage and calls fire cultists. Sythrane Immolates the party while she regenerates and enrages. Their signature moves are telegraphed like any other.
简体中文: 每个首领的战斗总是相同的。Vaelith的收割打中所有人并为她回血，生命值降至一半时她召来一名啼者和一名守卫。Nyxara的溺亡之潮冰冻并削弱小队。Korrath的破甲撕掉前排的护盾。Drevok为一名英雄打上烙印使其受到伤害提高50%，并召来火焰邪教徒。Sythrane对小队施放献祭，同时再生并狂暴。它们的招牌招式和其他招式一样会被预示。

English: Every monster, boss, and hazard you've encountered is tracked as a silhouette-to-full-color reveal — pure record-keeping, no reward tied to completion.
简体中文: 你遭遇过的每个怪物、首领和险境都会被记录，从剪影逐步揭示为全彩——纯粹的记录，完成不附带奖励。

English: Opens with Act IV, in the Rift Hall. 100 fixed floors, one fight each: a floor is always the same fight, so a loss is something to plan around. Heroes fight at full HP and leave as they came (no downing, scars or days passing). Most floors carry a rule (armored or burning foes, a swarm, a party cap). Every 10th floor is a guardian that gives a unique relic, and floors 10/25/50/75/100 earn guild titles. Only a first clear pays; floors 91-100 reshuffle their rules every week and pay half for a re-clear.
简体中文: 第四幕开放，在裂隙大厅。100层固定楼层，每层一场战斗：同一层永远是同一场战斗，所以失败是可以计划应对的。英雄满血战斗，离开时与进入时一样（没有倒下、伤疤或时间流逝）。大多数楼层带有一条规则（重甲或燃烧的敌人、一群敌人、小队人数上限）。每第10层是守卫，掉落一件独特遗物，第10/25/50/75/100层可获得公会称号。只有首次通关有奖励；第91-100层每周重新洗牌规则，重复通关奖励减半。

English: Each rift is in a region (the Vale, the Marshes, the Ashen Wastes) with its own foes. Some foes wind up a heavy blow a turn ahead (x2.5, stuns unless the target Defends); armored foes shrug off part of every basic attack (each hit chips the armor; abilities ignore it); fire foes can burn and frost foes can chill (act late). A Field Tonic cleanses burn, chill, poison and stun.
简体中文: 每座裂隙位于一个区域（山谷、沼泽、灰烬荒原），各有其敌人。有些敌人会提前一回合蓄力重击（×2.5，目标不防御则眩晕）；重甲敌人会抵消每次普通攻击的一部分（每次攻击会削弱护甲；技能无视护甲）；火焰敌人会造成燃烧，冰霜敌人会造成冰冻（行动靠后）。野战药剂可净化燃烧、冰冻、中毒和眩晕。

English: Six acts, each ending in a finale rift against a named foe. Meet an act's objectives (shown in the Rift Hall) to open its finale; sealing it pays a reward and a unique relic. Act I opens Greater Rifts, Act II the Endless Rift.
简体中文: 共六幕，每一幕都以对抗一名有名有姓之敌的终章裂隙收尾。达成一幕的目标（显示在裂隙大厅）即可开启其终章；封印终章可获得奖励和一件独特遗物。第一幕开启大型裂隙，第二幕开启无尽裂隙。

English: Six acts, each ending in a finale rift against a named foe. Meet an act's objectives (shown in the Rift Hall) to open its finale; sealing it pays a reward and a unique relic. Act I opens Greater Rifts, Act II the Descent.
简体中文: 共六幕，每一幕都以对抗一名有名有姓之敌的终章裂隙收尾。达成一幕的目标（显示在裂隙大厅）即可开启其终章；封印终章可获得奖励和一件独特遗物。第一幕开启大型裂隙，第二幕开启深渊下行。

English: Relics bend rules: each is one of a kind, found from Act I's finale on (finales, elites, shops, events and the Tower's guardians), and sits on the Relic Altar for the whole guild. Stats live on gear. A sealed Rank D+ rift offers a Path relic instead, carried by a hero of that Path (one each) and passed between them at camp; it works while they fight. Declining one pays the seal's Essence.
简体中文: 遗物改写规则：每件都独一无二，从第一幕终章起可获得（终章、精英、商店、事件和试炼之塔的守护者），放在遗物祭坛上，为整个公会生效。数值在装备上。封印D阶及以上的裂隙会改为提供一件道途遗物，由该道途的英雄携带（每人一件），可在营地相互传递；在其战斗时生效。放弃道途遗物则改为获得封印的精华。

English: Everything personal about a hero beyond class, skills and gear: at most one born quirk (it sets their voice), up to 2 scars from being knocked out (a wound with a small upside), and quirks earned by what they've done. Bad born quirks and scars can be treated for Gold at the Arcane Lab.
简体中文: 英雄在职业、技能和装备之外的一切个人特征：最多一个天生特质（决定其语音）、最多2道被击倒留下的伤疤（附带小小好处的伤口），以及因其事迹获得的特质。不好的天生特质和伤疤可以在奥术实验室花金币治疗。

English: From Act II a rift swells every so often: a rank, a place and a countdown in days (Rift Hall and the camp's status board). Seal a rift of that rank or higher before it runs out to close it, for a little Essence. Otherwise it breaks, and every rift run waits until your guild holds it: a breach rift of back-to-back fights (a fight, an elite and the breach's warden; the Inverted City's gate adds an elite) with no camp, shop or campfire between them. Ranks below S break out in a region; from S up they break at your camp. Holding pays Gold and Essence. Falling or turning back costs a share of your Essence and of the Gold beyond the coming payday's wages, and damages a building (two at the camp). The Accord Hall's Wardcraft rooms soften all of it.
简体中文: 从第二幕起，时不时会有一座裂隙膨胀：显示阶级、地点和以天计的倒计时（裂隙大厅和营地状态板）。在倒计时结束前封印一座同阶或更高阶的裂隙即可将其关闭，获得少量精华。否则它会破开，所有裂隙行动都要等你的公会守住它：一座连续作战的裂口裂隙（一场战斗、一个精英和裂口的守卫；倒悬之城的城门多一个精英），中间没有营地、商店或营火。S阶以下在某个地区破开；S阶及以上在你的营地破开。守住可获得金币和精华。倒下或撤退会损失一部分精华，以及超出下个发薪日薪水之外的一部分金币，并损毁一座建筑（在营地则为两座）。盟约大厅的守御术房间可减轻这一切。

English: Foes walk the roads toward the goal. Build towers on the round pads with supplies (you start with some and earn more for every kill); click a tower to upgrade or sell it. Ballistas shoot far, Fire Braziers splash and burn, Frost Totems slow, Ward Stones shield nearby heroes, Chapels mend them; research in the Defenses branch opens the last three and tier 3. Idle heroes stand at posts: warriors and rogues hold foes in place, rangers and mages shoot. Steer one champion by clicking where to go. Every foe that gets through costs integrity (an elite 3, a warden 10); at 0 the defense is lost. Call a wave early for bonus supplies.
简体中文: 敌人沿着道路走向目标。用补给在圆形平台上建塔（初始有一些，每次击杀还能获得更多）；点击塔可升级或出售。弩车射程远，火盆溅射并灼烧，冰霜图腾减速，结界石为附近英雄提供护盾，礼拜堂为他们治疗；防御分支的研究可开放后三种塔和3级。空闲的英雄站在岗位上：战士和盗贼拖住敌人，游侠和法师射击。点击目标位置来操控一位勇者。每个突破的敌人都会消耗完整度（精英3，守卫10）；降到0则防守失败。提前召来一波可获得额外补给。

English: Each new guild meets twelve champions, drawn from a pool of twenty-four: three are freed at the end of Acts I, II and III, and nine are lost, each held in a pillar of light (in the Descent, and in ladder rifts from Rank B; reach one to free them). A champion never joins the roster. In rift runs one oversees the party: their Boon lifts everyone, and any hero can spend a turn on their Call (once a rift, twice from level 3). Essence levels them up (to 5).
简体中文: 每个新公会会遇到十二位勇者，从二十四位中抽取：三位在第一、二、三幕结束时获释，九位失落，各自困在一道光柱中（在深渊下行中，以及B阶起的天梯裂隙中；抵达光柱即可解放）。勇者从不加入名册。在裂隙行动中，由一位勇者担任小队的督军：其恩赐提升全员，任何英雄都可花一个回合发动其召唤（每座裂隙一次，3级起两次）。精华可提升其等级（最高5级）。

English: Might (damage, HP), Agility (speed, dodge, first strike) and Focus (ability power, mend). Heroes gain 3 points per level to spend on the Roster's Hero tab; gear adds more, and better gear needs a minimum in its attribute to equip. Train up to 8 extra points at the Training Yard, or reset a hero's points for 5 Essence per level (gear they no longer qualify for comes off).
简体中文: 力量（伤害、生命）、敏捷（速度、闪避、先手）和专注（技能强度、回复）。英雄每升一级获得3点，在名册的英雄页分配；装备会额外增加，更好的装备需要对应属性达到最低值才能装备。可在训练场额外训练最多8点，或以每级5精华重置英雄的点数（不再满足要求的装备会被卸下）。

English: The quest board posts 6 quests (hunts, boss bounties, rift seals, trials); take up to 3 at a time. Unaccepted postings are replaced every 3 days (a day passes with each rift run or rest). Milestones are a static checklist, auto-granted the moment they're met. A rare escort NPC can also tag along on a fight — surviving pays a small bonus.
简体中文: 任务板发布6个任务（狩猎、首领悬赏、裂隙封印、试炼）；最多同时接3个。未接的委托每3天更换一次（每次裂隙行动或休息过去一天）。里程碑是固定清单，达成即自动发放。偶尔还会有稀有的护送NPC随队参战——活下来可获得一小笔奖励。

English: Every 7 days (a day = one rift run or rest) heroes draw wages by rank and level, and every hall room level costs upkeep; see Guild > Ledger. Unpaid upkeep costs Renown. The Training Yard trains only a few attribute points a week (more with the Drill Yard), and a feast seats a limited number of heroes, lowest morale first (more with the Trade Network). The unpaid lose morale, and a hero unpaid twice in a row, or at rock-bottom morale on payday, walks out. Morale (0-100) rises with sealed rifts and feasts and falls with defeats, knockouts, idle weeks and failed contracts: Inspired heroes deal +10% damage, Shaken -10%, Breaking -20%. Taken contracts are due in 6-10 days. A rival guild gains Renown daily, and once a week it may make a move you answer before payday: court one of your heroes (match their offer, or they choose, staying only at morale 50 or above), dare you to seal a rift by payday (Renown rides on it), or go for a posted contract (take it on or lose it). Requests and the rival's moves pop up at camp and wait in the Ledger, whose week board shows each day to payday. At payday, the leader on Renown gets the better recruits. Every 28 days, whichever guild gained more Renown wins a prize.
简体中文: 每7天（一天 = 一次裂隙出征或休息）英雄按等级和级别领取薪水，每级大厅房间都要维护费；见公会 > 账簿。拖欠维护费会损失声望。训练场每周只能训练几点属性（操练场可增加），宴会只能招待有限的英雄，士气最低的优先（贸易网络可增加）。未领到薪水的英雄士气下降，连续两次未领薪水，或发薪日士气跌到谷底的英雄会离开。士气（0-100）随封印裂隙和宴会上升，随失败、倒下、闲置的周和失败的契约下降：振奋的英雄伤害+10%，动摇的-10%，崩溃的-20%。接下的契约在6-10天内到期。对手公会每天获得声望，每周可能出一招，你需在发薪日前回应：拉拢你的一位英雄（开出同样的条件，或由英雄选择，士气50以上才会留下），挑战你在发薪日前封印一道裂隙（声望押在上面），或抢一份已发布的契约（接下或失去）。请求和对手的动向会在营地弹出，并在账簿中等待，账簿的周表显示到发薪日的每一天。发薪日时，声望领先者得到更好的招募。每28天，声望增长更多的公会赢得奖品。

English: Twice a week a hero may ask for something: time off, a raise, Gold for kit, a Training Yard slot, a partner, a rift of their own, your side in a feud, and more. Saying yes costs something and can leave them a title, a quirk or a bond; saying no costs morale. Answer in the Ledger before payday, or it counts as a no.
简体中文: 每周两次，英雄可能会提出请求：休假、加薪、买装备的金币、训练场名额、一个搭档、一座属于自己的裂隙、在争执中站在其一边，等等。答应要付出代价，可能让其获得称号、特质或羁绊；拒绝则损失士气。须在发薪日前于账簿中回应，否则视为拒绝。

English: From two seals, the Quest board's Expeditions tab posts three jobs off the map: a safe one, a hard one and (from Act II) a perilous one, each with a Need in power, a length of 1-3 days and a party of up to 3. Heroes you send are away for those days and still draw wages. The odds show before they go: 50% at the Need, better above it. Success pays in full; a partial pays half and someone comes back hurt; a failure pays nothing and hurts the party, and on a perilous job it can leave a scar. Every class and every Path brings something on the road, once per party: a warrior's muscle and a ranger's scouting raise the odds, a mage appraises (+50% Essence), a rogue pockets more (+25% Gold), a cleric halves the hurt, and each Path adds its own. Heroes are gone for the whole days while rifts and breaches go on without them. Everyone learns on the road, as at the Training Yard. One party out at a time, two with a Scouts' Lodge at level 3.
简体中文: 封印两座裂隙后，任务板的远征页会发布三份地图之外的任务：一份安全、一份困难，以及（第二幕起）一份凶险，每份都有战力需求、1-3天的时长，小队最多3人。派出的英雄在这几天里不在，但仍领薪水。出发前会显示成功率：刚好达到需求时为50%，超出越多越高。成功则全额支付；部分成功付一半，且有人负伤归来；失败则分文不得，全队受伤，凶险任务还可能留下伤疤。每个职业和每条道途在路上都有所助益，每支小队各计一次：战士的蛮力和游侠的侦察提高成功率，法师负责鉴定（精华+50%），盗贼多揣一些（金币+25%），牧师让伤势减半，每条道途另有加成。英雄整天不在，裂隙和裂口照常推进。每个人都能在路上有所长进，与训练场相同。同一时间只能派出一支小队，斥候小屋达到3级后可派两支。

English: On about a third of days something happens at camp, and each is a choice: a travelling merchant, a renowned hero who drills one of yours, a wandering recruit, a relic peddler, a smith's apprentice, a scholar; a festival, refugees, a debt, the rival's quartermaster. Threats (fire, fever, bandits, a storm, a rift tremor) are foretold the evening before (the status board and the week's calendar): pay, send a hero who stays home that day, or take the loss. An event left unanswered takes its last option the next day. Act I brings only opportunities.
简体中文: 大约三分之一的日子营地会发生些什么，每件事都是一个选择：游商、来操练你手下英雄的知名英雄、流浪的新兵、遗物小贩、铁匠学徒、学者；节庆、难民、债务、对手的军需官。威胁（火灾、热病、强盗、风暴、裂隙震动）会在前一晚预示（状态板和本周日历）：付钱、派一名英雄当天留守，或承受损失。未答复的事件会在第二天采取最后一个选项。第一幕只会带来机遇。

English: A ranked rift is a map of lanes: Ranks F-E have 3, D-B 4, A and up 5. Each node leads on to its own lane and one or both neighbours on the next floor, so plan a route: an elite on the way to a treasure, a shop before the boss. Every route ends at a campfire before the boss. Anvils temper a worn piece for free, a Path's shrine teaches the party (its Path's heroes most), and a trainer's echo gives one hero a level. From Rank S, floors more than two ahead are unseen unless a Trapper or a Stalker scouts.
简体中文: 有阶级的裂隙是一张路线图：F-E阶3条路线，D-B阶4条，A阶及以上5条。每个节点通往下一层的同一路线及相邻的一条或两条，所以要规划路线：去宝藏的路上打一场精英，首领前逛一次商店。每条路线都在首领前以营火结束。铁砧可免费淬炼一件磨损的装备，道途圣坛会指导小队（该道途的英雄收获最多），训练师的回响可使一名英雄升一级。从S阶起，除非有陷阱师或潜猎者侦察，否则看不到两层以外的楼层。

English: Day %d  ·  Taken %d/%d  ·  new postings in %d day%s
简体中文: 第%d天  ·  已接%d/%d  ·  %d天%s后发布新任务

English: A day passes with every rift run or rest. Unaccepted postings are replaced when the board refreshes; quests you've taken stay.
简体中文: 每次裂隙行动或休息都会过去一天。任务板刷新时，未接受的任务会被替换；已接的任务保留。

English: Nothing posted — new postings in %d day%s.
简体中文: 暂无任务 — %d天%s后发布新任务。

English: You already have %d quests — finish or abandon one first
简体中文: 你已有%d个任务——请先完成或放弃一个

English: Only progress made after taking it counts
简体中文: 只有接取后的进度才算数

English: Keepers of the Vale · %d/%d halls restored
简体中文: 山谷守护者 · 已修复%d/%d座大厅

English: The rifts are shut. The old Accord guilds' halls stand empty across the Vale; restore them, and each keeps giving.
简体中文: 裂隙已经关闭。旧盟约公会的大厅空置在山谷各处；修复它们，每一座都会持续带来好处。

English: The Open Hollow · %d tides held of %d
简体中文: 敞开的空洞 · 已守住%d/%d次浪潮

English: The Hollow is out. A tide breaks every week, and each one held makes the next stronger. Every tidewall holds a little of it back.
简体中文: 空洞已经出来了。浪潮每周袭来，每守住一次，下一次就更强。每道潮墙都能挡住一点。

English: The next tide: %d%% of the first one's strength, %d%% against your walls
简体中文: 下一波浪潮：第一波强度的%d%%，对你的潮墙为%d%%

English: Every tide is %d%% weaker against the guild for each wall.
简体中文: 每道潮墙使每波浪潮对公会减弱%d%%。

English: Endow the next guild · %d so far
简体中文: 为下一个公会捐赠 · 已有%d

English: Dobbs sets coin aside for whoever founds the next guild. Each Laurel costs more than the last.
简体中文: Dobbs为下一个公会的创建者存下钱财。每顶桂冠都比上一顶更贵。

English: The next wing is offered at the end of Act %s: a choice of two, built with Gold.
简体中文: 下一翼将在第%s幕结束时提供：两选一，用金币建造。

English: Two wings could stand again. Build one: the other stays a ruin, so choose what kind of guild you are.
简体中文: 有两翼可以重新立起来。建造其中一个：另一个仍是废墟，所以选择你想成为怎样的公会。

English: Rooms · rebuilt with Gold; each level adds upkeep
简体中文: 房间 · 用金币重建；每一级都会增加维护费

English: Damaged in a Riftbreak: works at Lv %d until repaired.
简体中文: 在裂隙崩溃中受损：修复前以%d级运作。

English: Each level: %s · upkeep +%d Gold a week
简体中文: 每级：%s · 维护费每周+%d金币

English: ⌂ Camp: the %s is rebuilt at Lv3 and Lv5 (now tier %d/3)
简体中文: ⌂ 营地：%s在3级和5级时重建（当前等级%d/3）

English: ⌂ Camp: every level grows the Guild Hall (guild tier)
简体中文: ⌂ 营地：每一级都会扩建公会大厅（公会等级）

English: Send heroes on a job off the map. They are gone for its whole days and still draw wages, while rifts and breaches go on without them. Success pays in full; a partial pays half and someone comes back hurt; a failure pays nothing and hurts the party. Every class and Path brings something (hover a hero); each counts once, so a mixed party does best. Parties out at once: %d.
简体中文: 派英雄去地图之外接活。任务期间他们整天不在，仍领薪水，裂隙和裂口照常推进。成功则全额支付；部分成功付一半，且有人负伤归来；失败则分文不得，全队受伤。每个职业和道途都有所助益（悬停英雄查看）；每种只计一次，所以混搭的小队效果最好。可同时外出的小队：%d。

English: Nothing posted until the board is renewed.
简体中文: 任务板更新前没有新委托。
%s · %d天%s · 最多%d名英雄%s · 需求%d

English: %d lost champions still wait in the rift.
简体中文: 还有%d位迷失的勇者在裂隙中等待。

English: Every lost champion has been found.
简体中文: 所有迷失的勇者都已找到。

English: Rift strength %d%% — it grows with every champion you free and every act you pass.
简体中文: 裂隙强度%d%% — 随你解放的每位勇者和经过的每一幕增长。

English: You have no champions yet. The first is freed at the end of Act I.
简体中文: 你还没有勇者。第一位将在第一幕结束时解放。

English: Add at least one hero to the party.
简体中文: 请至少在小队中加入一名英雄。

English: Wounded: %s — they start the rift hurt.
简体中文: 受伤：%s — 他们将带伤进入裂隙。

简体中文: 无尽裂隙：你操控%s（你挑选的第一位英雄）；其余的会跟随并自行战斗。你的配置也会随行：装备、技能、已装备的遗物、闪避和治疗，以及每位英雄的技能。在波次中存活，并在20:00击败裂隙守卫以封印裂隙。

English: Your best time in %s. It sets the foes you'll meet and the Rift Warden at 20:00 (%s).
简体中文: 你在%s的最佳时间。它决定了你将遇到的敌人和20:00的裂隙守卫（%s）。

English: ⚠ A Rank %s rift near %s breaks in %d day%s — seal a Rank %s rift or higher to close it
简体中文: ⚠ 一座%s阶裂隙（%s附近）将在%d天%s后破开 — 封印一座%s阶或更高的裂隙以关闭它

English: Or let it break and hold it: back-to-back fights with no camp between them (Guild > Manage > Wardcraft softens them).
简体中文: 或者任它破开再守住：连续战斗，中间没有营地（公会 > 管理 > 守御术可以减轻）。

English: The rift has broken! Rank %s near %s
Monsters are pouring out. Rift runs wait until your guild defends.
简体中文: 怪物正在涌出。在你的公会完成防守前，裂隙行动需等待。

English: Foes walk the roads toward your outpost. Build towers on the round pads with supplies: you start with some and earn more for every kill. Tap a built tower to upgrade or sell it. Heroes at posts stand by the road: warriors and rogues hold foes in place, rangers and mages shoot. Tap the ground to send your champion. Every foe that gets through costs integrity; at 0 the defense is lost.
简体中文: 敌人沿着道路走向你的前哨。用补给在圆形平台上建塔：初始有一些，每次击杀还能获得更多。点击已建的塔可升级或出售。在岗位上的英雄守在路边：战士和盗贼拖住敌人，游侠和法师射击。点击地面派遣你的勇者。每个突破的敌人都会消耗完整度；降到0则防守失败。
