English: Holding pays Gold and Essence. If it falls, you lose %d%% of your spare Gold and your Essence, %d building%s is damaged, and posted heroes who fell come back wounded.
简体中文: 守住可获得金币和精华。若失守，你将失去%d%%的闲置金币和精华，%d座建筑%s受损，倒下的驻守英雄会带伤归来。

English: No idle heroes can stand guard: towers and your champion will have to hold.
简体中文: 没有空闲英雄可以站岗：只能靠塔和你的勇者守住。

English: The Night of Breaking: how the old guilds vanished. About a minute; Esc skips.
简体中文: 破碎之夜：旧公会是如何消失的。约一分钟；按Esc跳过。

English: The narrator reads the story cards, and the guild's people speak at the pay table and in rival letters. English only for now.
简体中文: 旁白会朗读剧情卡片，公会的人们会在发薪桌旁和对手的信件中说话。目前仅有英语。

English: Fights resolve with no animation; the screen updates when it's your turn
简体中文: 战斗无动画直接结算；轮到你时画面更新

English: The game fits your browser window automatically.
简体中文: 游戏会自动适应你的浏览器窗口。

English: No screen shake, zooms, knockbacks, idle sway or flashing in fights
简体中文: 战斗中无屏幕震动、缩放、击退、待机摇摆或闪烁

English: Blue instead of green wherever it sits against red (HP, fight readouts, stat changes), and a rarity letter on every item
简体中文: 在与红色相邻处（生命值、战斗读数、属性变化）用蓝色代替绿色，并在每件物品上标注稀有度字母

English: Show each fight command's key (1-9, Space, A) on its button. Off, the keys still work and every tooltip names them.
简体中文: 在每个战斗指令按钮上显示其按键（1-9、Space、A）。关闭后按键仍然有效，每个提示框也会注明。

English: Sounds that tell you something also show as captions at the bottom of the screen (a boss arriving, a heavy blow, a hero going down, a wind-up, a chest dropping), and the biggest ones pulse the screen's edges
简体中文: 传达信息的声音也会以字幕形式显示在屏幕底部（首领到来、重击、英雄倒下、蓄力、宝箱掉落），最重要的还会使屏幕边缘闪动

English: Saves live in this browser/device only; clearing site data erases them. Export one to keep a copy or move it to another device. The previous save is also kept automatically in case one gets damaged.
简体中文: 存档仅保存在此浏览器/设备中；清除网站数据会将其删除。导出存档可保留副本或转移到其他设备。上一个存档也会自动保留，以防存档损坏。

English: Saves live in the Guildhold folder on this computer. Export one to keep a copy in its backups folder or move it to another device. The previous save is also kept automatically in case one gets damaged.
简体中文: 存档保存在这台电脑的Guildhold文件夹中。导出存档可在其backups文件夹中保留副本，或转移到其他设备。上一个存档也会自动保留，以防存档损坏。

English: Nothing to export in this slot yet.
简体中文: 此栏位还没有可导出的内容。

简体中文: 已下载，并已复制到剪贴板。

English: Saved to the backups folder, and copied to the clipboard.
简体中文: 已保存到backups文件夹，并已复制到剪贴板。

English: Copied to the clipboard — paste it somewhere safe.
简体中文: 已复制到剪贴板——请粘贴到安全的地方。

English: Paste an exported save below%s. It replaces Slot %d%s.
简体中文: 在下方粘贴导出的存档%s。它将替换栏位%d%s。

English: Gives you a code (and a QR code) to open this guild on your phone or another computer.
简体中文: 生成一个代码（和二维码），用于在你的手机或其他电脑上打开这个公会。

English: On your other device, scan this with the camera, or open Guildhold, choose Receive a guild and type the code. It works once, for the next 15 minutes.
简体中文: 在你的另一台设备上用相机扫描，或打开Guildhold，选择接收公会并输入代码。仅可使用一次，有效期15分钟。

English: %s arrived (%d rifts sealed). Where should it go?
简体中文: %s已到达（封印了%d座裂隙）。要放到哪里？

English: Nothing to send in this slot yet.
简体中文: 此栏位还没有可发送的内容。

English: Couldn't reach the transfer service. Check your connection and try again.
简体中文: 无法连接到传输服务。请检查网络连接后重试。

English: A transfer code is 6 letters and numbers.
简体中文: 传输代码为6位字母和数字。

English: That code has expired or was already used. Send the guild again from the other device.
简体中文: 该代码已过期或已被使用。请从另一台设备重新发送公会。

English: Combat — 1-3 monsters. Gold, Essence and a loot pick.
简体中文: 战斗 — 1-3只怪物。金币、精华和一次战利品选择。

English: Elite — one tough foe (double HP, harder hits). +40% rewards.
简体中文: 精英 — 一个强敌（双倍生命，攻击更重）。奖励+40%。

English: Shop — spend Gold on items and relics. No fighting.
简体中文: 商店 — 花金币购买物品和遗物。没有战斗。

English: Hazard — a trap that hurts the party (hazard guard helps). May drop Gold or Essence.
简体中文: 险境 — 伤害小队的陷阱（险境防护有帮助）。可能掉落金币或精华。

English: Boss — the rift's warden, with a special mechanic. Win to seal the rift.
简体中文: 首领 — 裂隙的守卫，带有特殊机制。获胜即可封印裂隙。

English: Campfire — rest (heal), train (XP) or sharpen (abilities ready). No fighting.
简体中文: 营火 — 休息（治疗）、训练（经验）或磨砺（技能就绪）。没有战斗。

English: Event — a strange encounter with a few choices; each says what it does.
简体中文: 事件 — 一次奇异的遭遇，有几个选项；每个都会说明效果。

English: Treasure — pick one of two loot drops. No fighting.
简体中文: 宝藏 — 从两份战利品中选一份。没有战斗。

English: Pillar — a lost champion is held in this light. Its keeper fights like a rift warden; win to free them.
简体中文: 光柱 — 一位迷失的勇者被困在这道光中。其看守者的战斗方式如同裂隙守卫；获胜即可解放勇者。

English: Anvil — temper one piece your party wears, one Forge level, free. No fighting.
简体中文: 铁砧 — 免费淬炼小队穿戴的一件装备，提升一级锻炉等级。没有战斗。

English: Shrine — a Path's shrine: XP for the party, most for heroes on that Path. No fighting.
简体中文: 圣坛 — 某条道途的圣坛：小队获得经验，该道途的英雄最多。没有战斗。

English: Trainer's echo — one hero trains with an old master's echo and gains a level. No fighting.
简体中文: 训练师的回响 — 一名英雄与老师傅的回响一同训练，升一级。没有战斗。

English: Unseen — too deep to make out. A Trapper or a Stalker in the party scouts the whole rift.
简体中文: 未知 — 太深了，看不清。小队中有陷阱师或潜猎者可侦察整座裂隙。

English: Resolve: -%d after the fight, and -%d for the floor
Resolve: -%d pushing through or -%d risking it, and -%d for the floor
Resolve: +%d if you rest (+%d otherwise), then -%d for the floor
简体中文: 决心：休息 +%d（其他选择 +%d），随后本层 -%d

English: Choose your path — click a node on the map.
简体中文: 选择你的路线——点击地图上的节点。

English: Choose your path — click a lit node on the map.
简体中文: 选择你的路线——点击地图上亮起的节点。

English: This rift's region sets which foes you'll meet.
简体中文: 这座裂隙所在的区域决定你会遇到哪些敌人。

English: Yours once the party is home. If the party falls, %d%% of it is lost; fleeing a fight drops %d%%. Leaving between floors keeps it all.
简体中文: 小队回家后才归你所有。若小队倒下，将失去其中%d%%；从战斗中逃跑会丢失%d%%。在楼层之间离开可全部保留。

English:
The party's grit. Each floor costs %d, an elite won %d more, a hazard %d (%d if you risk it), fleeing a fight %d. A campfire's Rest gives back %d (its other choices %d), a shrine %d.
At %d or less the party wavers: foes act first in round 1. At 0 it breaks: also no starting Momentum and %d%% less damage.
简体中文:
小队的韧劲。每层消耗%d，赢下精英再消耗%d，险境%d（冒险则%d），从战斗中逃跑%d。营火休息恢复%d（其他选项%d），圣坛%d。

English: Climb out of the Descent? You keep everything it has earned.
简体中文: 爬出深渊下行？你将保留所得的一切。

English: Leave the rift? You keep your loot but miss the sealing reward.
简体中文: 离开裂隙？你会保留战利品，但得不到封印奖励。

English: Leave the rift now — keep your loot, no sealing reward
简体中文: 现在离开裂隙——保留战利品，没有封印奖励

English: This rift is on the rift ladder at Rank %s. Its rules:
简体中文: 这座裂隙在裂隙天梯上为%s阶。其规则：

English: Gear, attributes and skills. Or click a hero.
简体中文: 装备、属性和技能。或点击一名英雄。

English: Orders from your hall's rooms. You get %d per rift (more at Renowned and Legendary guild tier).
简体中文: 来自大厅房间的指令。每道裂隙你有%d个（公会等级为著名和传奇时更多）。

English: Free once a rift (the War Room).
简体中文: 每道裂隙免费一次（作战室）。

English: Training rift — shorter and gentler than a real one. Beat the boss at the end to seal it.
简体中文: 训练裂隙——比真正的裂隙更短、更温和。击败最后的首领即可封印。

English: Each floor offers a choice. Fights give gold and loot; elites hit harder and pay more; shops, campfires, events and treasure help in other ways. The last floor is the boss.
简体中文: 每层都提供一个选择。战斗给予金币和战利品；精英更强但报酬更高；商店、营火、事件和宝藏以其他方式提供帮助。最后一层是首领。

English: What this run has earned is only safe once the party is home. If the party falls, half of it is lost; fleeing a fight drops a quarter. Leaving between floors keeps it all, so a hurt party can take its haul home instead of facing the boss.
简体中文: 本次行动所得只有在小队回家后才安全。若小队倒下，将失去一半；从战斗中逃跑会丢失四分之一。在楼层之间离开可全部保留，所以受伤的小队可以带着战利品回家，而不必面对首领。

English: Heroes and foes act in the turn order shown under the arena. The tag above each foe shows its next move: who it hits, or a Sweep, Snipe, Curse, Ward, Mend or Roar. Attacks build Momentum (the pips under the hero's name); skills (2-4) spend it. Defend (5) halves damage and Guard (6) takes a hit for an ally, both earning Momentum. Foes "winding up" land a heavy blow next round: Defend, or break it with Shield Bash or Frost Nova. Melee heroes hit at half strength from the back row.
简体中文: 英雄和敌人按竞技场下方显示的回合顺序行动。每个敌人头顶的标签显示其下一招：攻击谁，或横扫、狙击、诅咒、结界、治疗、咆哮。攻击积攒气势（英雄名字下方的小点）；技能(2-4)消耗气势。防御(5)使伤害减半，守护(6)为友方承受一击，两者都能获得气势。"蓄力"的敌人下回合会重击：防御，或用盾击或冰霜新星打断。近战英雄在后排只造成一半伤害。

English: Choose one reward. Items are worn by one hero: equip them on the hero's page (click a hero in the bar at the top); relics go on the Relic Altar and help the whole party.
简体中文: 选择一个奖励。物品由一名英雄穿戴：在英雄页面装备（点击顶部栏中的英雄）；遗物放在遗物祭坛上，帮助全队。

English: Couldn't reach the board. Try again later.
简体中文: 无法连接榜单，请稍后再试。

简体中文: 将你的公会名称和此得分公开发布到今日榜单。

English: in the chest until a hero of its Path takes it
简体中文: 放在箱子里，直到该道途的英雄取走

简体中文: 一件道途遗物回应了封印。由该道途的英雄携带，在其战斗时生效。选择一件：

简体中文: 替换所有尚未购买的商品。每次费用递增。

English: The party carries them home. A day passes and the quest board moves on.
简体中文: 小队把他们抬回家。过去一天，任务板也会更新。

English: Needs %d idle hero%s at camp (not in this rift, not recovering).
简体中文: 需要营地有%d名空闲英雄%s（不在此裂隙中，也不在恢复中）。

English: Back up at %d%% HP, %d%% less max HP until the rift ends. Once per rift.
简体中文: 以%d%%生命值复起，直到裂隙结束最大生命值降低%d%%。每座裂隙一次。

English: Needs a Rank %s+ Cleric in the party, a Cleric Champion, or Field Triage (Medical) — once per rift.
简体中文: 需要小队中有%s+阶牧师、牧师勇者，或战地分诊（医疗）——每座裂隙一次。

English: They stay in the rift. Seal it and they're found alive; retreat or fall and they're lost for good.
简体中文: 他们留在裂隙中。封印裂隙即可找到他们生还；撤退或倒下则永远失去他们。

English: A new guild can't leave anyone behind (seal 3 rifts first).
简体中文: 新公会不能丢下任何人（先封印3座裂隙）。

English: A sheltered corner of the rift. There's time for one thing before moving on.
简体中文: 裂隙中一个有遮蔽的角落。继续前进前有时间做一件事。

English: The next fight starts with +4 Momentum
You take your pick and pack it away.
A forgotten stash. There's only room to carry one of these.
简体中文: 一处被遗忘的藏匿点。只能带走其中一件。

English: A smith's anvil, still warm, left in the rift. One piece your party wears can be tempered here, free.
简体中文: 一座铁匠的铁砧，余温尚存，被留在裂隙中。小队穿戴的一件装备可以在此免费淬炼。

English: Nothing the party wears can take more tempering.
简体中文: 小队穿戴的装备都无法再淬炼了。

English: A shrine to the %s Path, its candles still lit. Kneel, and the party learns: %d%% of a level for heroes on this Path, %d%% for the rest.
简体中文: 一座供奉%s道途的圣坛，蜡烛仍亮着。跪下，小队便能学到东西：该道途的英雄获得%d%%级经验，其余英雄%d%%。

English: The echo of an old guild's trainer still drills in this hall. One hero can train with it and gain a level (at level 10: attribute points).
简体中文: 一位旧公会训练师的回响仍在这座大厅中操练。一名英雄可以与其一同训练并升一级（10级时：获得属性点）。

English: Your Anchor Artifact blocks it — no damage
简体中文: 你的锚定神器挡住了它——没有伤害

简体中文: 在D阶时，该英雄可以在训练场训练进入以下道途之一。

English: Seasoned: +%d%% HP and damage for %d rank%s climbed
简体中文: 老练：生命值和伤害+%d%%，因晋升%d阶%s

简体中文: 以%s阶回到1级：永久变强，接下来的裂隙行动经验+%d%%，共%d次。

English: No deeds yet — send this hero into a rift.
简体中文: 尚无事迹——派这名英雄进入裂隙吧。
